CSL Senior Project Officer & Project Officer Recruitment 2025 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL)
Post Name Senior Project Officer & Project Officer (Mechanical, Electrical, Safety)
No of Posts 4
Salary ₹49,100 to ₹71,500 (Consolidated Pay per month plus compensation for extra hours)
Qualification Relevant Engineering Degree/Diploma with minimum 60% marks and specific post-qualification experience
Age Limit Max 35 years (SPO) / Max 30 years (PO) as on 31 Dec 2025
Start Date for Apply  16-12-2025
Last Date for Apply  31-12-2025
Official Website www.cochinshipyard.in

CSL Senior Project Officer & Project Officer Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of posts No of Vacancy
Senior Project Officer (Mechanical) 1
Senior Project Officer (Electrical) 1
Senior Project Officer (Safety) 1
Project Officer (Safety) 1
Total 4

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications for SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering with minimum 60% marks from a recognized University.
  • Qualifications for SPO (Safety): Degree in Safety Engineering OR Engineering Degree (any branch) OR Degree in Physics/Chemistry OR Diploma in Engineering (any branch).
  • Qualifications for PO (Safety): Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Industrial Safety recognized by State Govt. (requirements may vary based on base degree/diploma).
  • Essential qualifications (Experience):
    • SPO (Mechanical/Electrical): Minimum 4 years post qualification experience in Ship Building/Repair/Marine related/Port/Engineering/Govt/Semi-Govt company.
    • SPO (Safety): 4 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 7 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
    • PO (Safety): 2 years experience for Engineering Degree holders; 5 years experience for other Degree/Diploma holders in safety/production/maintenance department of a Shipyard/Factory handling HSE activities.
  • Desirable: Proficiency and experience of working in a computerized environment (for Mech/Elect SPO). Proficiency in Computer Applications like AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc. is preferred in general.
  • Experience: Experience acquired after the stipulated qualification date is considered, reckoned as on 31st December 2025. Training with remuneration is treated as experience. Certificates from registered companies/foreign companies are considered.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹63,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹65,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹67,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹69,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹71,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
  • Project Officer:
    • First Year: ₹49,100/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Second Year: ₹51,200/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Third Year: ₹53,300/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fourth Year: ₹55,400/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.
    • Fifth Year: ₹57,500/- pm Consolidated Pay + ₹3,000/- pm Compensation for Extra Hours.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • For the post of Project Officer, age shall not exceed 30 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • For the post of Senior Project Officer, age shall not exceed 35 years as on 31 December 2025.
  • Age limit after applying all relaxations (Ex-servicemen etc.) shall not exceed 50 years.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹400/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) should be remitted online.
  • Applicants belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Scheduled Tribe (ST) are exempted from payment of application fee.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 16th December 2025
Last Date of Online Application 31st December 2025
Application Fee Payment Window closes 31st December 2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through Power Point Presentation (80 marks for assessing work experience) and Personal Interview (20 marks).
  • Total marks for final selection: 100 marks.
  • CSL reserves the right to hold an objective type test for shortlisting if many applications are received. These test marks will not be used in the final rank list preparation.
  • Certificate verification will be conducted before the Presentation and Interview.
  • Rank lists will be prepared based on aggregate marks in Presentation and Interview, with tie-breaking based on Presentation marks first, then age seniority.

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts are purely temporary on a contract basis for a maximum period of five years.
  • Posting shall be at CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands/ any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL.
  • The posts are not identified as suitable for Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) due to job requirements (working at heights, confined spaces, etc.).
  • Candidates must meet eligibility requirements before applying. Upload all necessary certificates with the online application.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Call letters will be sent by e-mail/published on the CSL website only.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must visit the website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page→ CANSRU, Andaman) and follow the User Manual/FAQ.
  • Complete the one-time registration on the SAP Online portal and submit the application against the post from 16 December 2025 to 31 December 2025.
  • Ensure all certificates and a recent passport size colour photograph are uploaded.
  • Ensure the application status shows "In process" after final submission.
  • Retain a soft copy/printout of the online application with the unique registration number for future correspondence.
  • Do not send the application printout/certificates by post.

A&N UT Health Mission Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post No. of Post Consolidated Salary (In Rs.)
Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization) 01 Rs. 25,000/-

Eligibility Criteria

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science, knowledge of logistic and supply management or public health or ITI in R/AC TRAT and PGDCA.
  • Experience: At least 2–3 years of experience in cold chain management, logistics, or a related field.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong technical knowledge of cold chain management, including equipment maintenance and temperature monitoring.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated Salary (In Rs.): Rs. 25,000/- per month is payable for the post of Cold Chain Assistant (Immunization).

Age Limit

  • Age: Not more than 60 years.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the vacancy notice.

 

Selection Process

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Only the eligible candidates who have submitted application are required to attend the interview.
  • No individual call letters will be issued for appearing in the interview.
  • No TA/DA shall be payable for appearing in the interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment will be made purely on merit basis.
  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other norms and that the particulars furnished by him/her are correct in all respects; suppression of information would lead to disqualification at any stage.
  • Interested candidates shall be ready to work in remote / hard areas as and when directed and also may have to travel to remote/hard areas as required.
  • Incomplete/defective applications, applications without photograph of the candidates shall be summarily rejected.
  • The engagement will be on Contract basis for period of 11 months from the day of signing the contract within the stipulated period as per the offer of appointment letter.
  • Any extension or renewal of appointment beyond 11 months will be subject to a review on performance and contribution in work and an agreement on mutually agreed terms.
  • This would not be construed in any manner a promise for the regular appointment under State Health Society (A&N Islands).

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility are requested to apply in the prescribed format in A4 size paper.
  • Attested photocopies of Mark Sheets and Certificates in support of Educational Qualifications (Degree, Post-graduation, Professional Qualifications etc. as applicable) must be enclosed.
  • Experience certificate(s) specifying nature and period of experience should be enclosed.
  • Application should be sent in a cover superscripted “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF “……………………………………”
  • Applications should be addressed to: A & N Union Territory Health Mission, Office of State Health Society (A&N Islands), Quarter No. AP-III, Atlanta Point, Sri Vijaya Puram-744104, Telefax: 03192-234965, e-mail: [email protected].

Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) Project Assistant Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Category No of Vacancy
UR (Unreserved) 2
OBC (Other Backward Class) 1
Total 3

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Pass in 3-year Bachelor’s Degree in Arts (other than fine arts/performing arts) or in Commerce or in Science or in Computer Applications or Business Administration with minimum 60% of marks from a recognized university.
  • Essential qualifications: Minimum of two years post qualification experience in a Shipyard, Engineering Company, Commercial Organization, or Government/Semi Government company/Establishment.
  • Desirable: Proficiency in Computer Applications like AutoCAD, SAP, MS Project, MS Office etc.
  • Experience: Minimum of two years post qualification experience is essential. Period of completed Apprenticeship Training or training with remuneration is treated as experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • A consolidated pay of ₹24,400/- per month for candidates meeting the minimum experience requirement (2 years).
  • Eligibility for compensation for extra hours of work up to ₹6,100/- per month.
  • Higher pay may be offered for completed years of on-roll experience over and above the minimum required experience in CSL or similar Shipyards.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • The upper age limit shall not exceed 45 years as on 31st December 2025.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates in posts reserved for them.
  • Age relaxation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Ex-servicemen shall be as per Government of India Guidelines, not exceeding 50 years after all relaxations.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of ₹300/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra) should be remitted using Online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.).
  • Applicants belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/ Scheduled Tribe (ST)/ Person with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from payment of application fee.

Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 13th December 2025
Last Date of Online Application 31st December 2025
Application Fee Payment Window 13th December 2025 to 31st December 2025

Selection Process

  • The method of selection shall be through Written Tests (Objective Type Test and Descriptive Type Test) for a total of 100 marks.
  • The Objective Type Test is 90 Minutes (80 Multiple Choice Questions, no negative marks).
  • The Descriptive Type Test is 45 minutes duration (Writing skills - 20 Marks).
  • Objective Test Syllabus areas: General Knowledge (5 M), Reasoning (5 M), Quantitative Aptitude (10 M), General English (10 M), Discipline related (50 M).
  • Descriptive test answer sheets will be evaluated only if minimum pass marks are secured in the objective test.
  • Rank lists are prepared based on aggregate marks secured in both tests. Tie-breaking rules involve Discipline marks and age seniority.
  • Selection is subject to verification of eligibility requirements and medical fitness.

General Information/Instructions

  • The posts are temporary in nature for a maximum period of five years on contract basis.
  • Posting is at CSL AN Ship Repair Unit (CANSRU), Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman & Nicobar Islands. Candidates are transferable to other CSL units/work sites.
  • The post is reserved only for candidates domiciled in Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
  • Applicants must ensure they meet eligibility requirements before applying online.
  • Applicants should not submit more than one application.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Call letters for selection will be sent via e-mail/published on the CSL website only.
  • Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination prescribed by CANSRU.

How To Apply

  • Applicants should visit the website www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page→ CANSRU, Andaman) and go through the User Manual/FAQ.
  • Complete the one-time Registration and then submit the application online from 13th December 2025 to 31st December 2025.
  • Ensure all entries are correct and the application status shows "In process" after submission.
  • Retain a printout/soft copy of the online application containing the unique registration number for future correspondence.
  • Applicants do not need to send the application printout/certificates/fee payment receipt by post to CSL/CANSRU.

Date Description
12/12/2025 Opening Date for On-Line Application

  • Junior Assistant (HR): Written Exam (Computer Based Test). Duration of Exam-2 (Two) hours. Computer Literacy test in MS Office.

  • No application through any other mode will be accepted.

AAI also reserves the right to modify/cancel the recruitment process, if need so arises without issuing any further notice or any reasons what so ever. The decision of the Management will be final and binding and no appeal shall be entertained.
  • Definition of various categories of disability identified suitable for the post shall be defined under RPwD Act. 2016 and subsequent amendments thereof.
  • Ex-Servicemen who have already secured employment in civil sector under Center Government/State Government of in Group-‘C’ & ‘D’ posts on regular basis after availing the benefits of reservation given of Ex-Servicemen to their re-employment are not eligible for reservation for appointment under Ex-Servicemen categories. However, they are eligible for age relaxation only. Age relaxation/ESM reservation is not admissible to sons, daughter and dependent of ESM. Therefore, such candidates should not indicate their category as Ex-Servicemen.

  • The vacancy reserved for Ex-SM/Ex-Agniveers/PWD will be filled from any category and adjusted horizontally against respective categories viz-UR/SC/ST/OBC as the case may be depending upon the category to which the selected candidate belongs to, within the respective total vacancies of the posts.

  • Excluding of Bank Charges & Service Tax.
  • For detailed Notification, Please refer AAI website.
  • Candidates should have a valid personal e-mail ID & Mobile No. and must ensure that it is active during the entire recruitment process.
  • The eligibility with respect to Age, Education Qualification and Experience etc. will be determined as on 06/12/2025.
  • Where CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI etc. is awarded in the essential qualification degree examination, percentage (%) of marks shall be arrived by applying the following formula Eg: If CGPA/OGPA/DGPA/CPI is 6.75 (Out of 10), then equivalent percentage (%) of marks would be 6.75*9.5=64.125%.
  • The date of declaration of result/issuance of mark sheets shall be deemed to be the date of acquiring of qualification and there shall be no relaxation on this account.
  • The education and other qualification must be obtained from Govt. recognized institutions as per laid down criteria by Central Govt. for the purpose.
  • AAI will not bear any liability on account of salary/leave salary/pension contribution etc. if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Government/Autonomous Institution/State Government.

How to Apply

  • Candidates shall apply only ONLINE through Airports Authority of India website www.aai.aero under tab “CAREERS” for the above posts.
  • Post submission, the candidate will be re-directed to make the online payment of application fee.
  • Kindly verify the details and make the payment for application fee via the different payment modes.
  • After successful payment of application fee, candidate will be redirected to his/her application form.

Advertisement
Company Name Principal District and Sessions Court, Nellore
Post Name Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class
No of Posts 6
Salary Rs.45,000 per month and Rs.5,000 per month towards conveyance
Qualification As per the prescribed qualifications for Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class
Age Limit Above 45 years to below 65 years
Last Date 03 January 2026
Official Website spsrnellore.dcourts.gov.in

Vacancy Details

S. No. Name of the Post Number of Vacancies
1 II Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class, Nellore 1
2 Additional Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class (Excise), Nellore 1
3 Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class, Gudur 1
4 Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class, Sullurpeta 1
5 Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class, Kavali 1
6 Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class, Atmakur 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • A person shall be qualified for appointment as Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class if the person held any post in Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service and retired or resigned.
  • A person shall be qualified if the person held a post in the Andhra Pradesh Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service not below the rank of Superintendent (Category-III of Andhra Pradesh Judicial Ministerial Subordinate Service Rules, 2019) in the State of Andhra Pradesh and has a law degree.
  • A person shall be qualified if the person held a post of Section Officer and above in the Andhra Pradesh High Court Service and has a law degree.
  • A person shall be qualified if the person practiced as an advocate at least for five years and at present is not on the rolls of the Bar Council.
  • A person shall be qualified if being any retired Gazetted Officer possessing law degree or who has passed the criminal judicial test in full consisting of Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure or the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 conducted by the Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission and who has exercised Magisterial powers during the tenure of service for not less than three years, with preference to a suitable retired Judicial Officer.

Salary/ Stipend

  • The honorarium or remuneration payable to the Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class shall be Rs.45,000 per month.
  • The Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class shall be paid Rs.5,000 per month towards conveyance, subject to enhancement by the Government from time to time.

Age Limit (as on date of notification)

  • Non-practicing advocates with a practice at the Bar of not less than five years and who are above 45 years and below 65 years of age shall be eligible.
  • Retired persons who have at least one and half years to complete 65 years of age as on the date of notification shall be eligible.

Important Dates

Last Date for Receipt of Applications 03 January 2026 up to 05:00 PM

Selection Process

  • The Principal District Judge shall issue notification for filling up the post of Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class six months prior to completion of tenure of appointment of the sitting Magistrate in the District.
  • On receipt of applications from the candidates, the Principal District Judge, after scrutiny of the applications, shall send only those applications which are in order to the High Court.
  • The Committee of Judges for the appointment and other conditions of service of Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class will conduct either written test or interview or both and select the candidates.
  • The Chief Judicial Magistrate shall issue orders under Section 12 and 13 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, defining the local limits of the areas within which the Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class may exercise powers and as to the distribution of business among the Magistrates.

General Information / Instructions

  • Notification is issued in view of the enforcement of rules namely The Andhra Pradesh Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class Service Rules, 2024.
  • The unit of appointment shall be the respective judicial districts of the candidate to which the candidate belongs within the State of Andhra Pradesh.
  • The Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class shall hold court work for five days in a week from Monday to Friday on working days between 07:30 AM and 10:30 AM.
  • The Special Judicial Magistrates of II Class will be under the administrative control of the Chief Judicial Magistrate in matters such as grant of leave, drawal of honorarium, inspection of court and permission to assume charge.
  • If any complaint as to the misconduct of the Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class is received by the High Court, the same shall be placed before the Committee dealing with the subject for appropriate action including recommendation for termination of services, if warranted.
  • On appointment and while in service, a Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class may be removed without being called upon to show cause if the officer fails to attend three consecutive sittings of the court without written permission of the concerned Chief Judicial Magistrate.
  • The powers conferred by the Court on Special Judicial Magistrate of II Class shall automatically stand withdrawn on attaining the age of 65 years.

How to Apply

  • Applications shall reach the Principal District Judge, Nellore, in the prescribed proforma along with necessary attested copies of certificates mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications must be submitted so as to reach on or before 03 January 2026 by 05:00 PM; applications received thereafter will not be considered.
  • The candidates are directed to submit a single application clearly indicating order of preference for the place of posting instead of submitting multiple applications for each individual vacant post.
  • Candidates shall enclose attested copy of SSC certificate for proof of age.
  • Candidates shall enclose attested copies of educational qualifications including law degree and technical courses.
  • Candidates who are advocates shall enclose attested copy of enrollment certificate at the Bar, a certificate of previous practice for not less than five years, a certificate of suspension of practice issued by the State Bar Association and a certificate of suspension of practice issued by the Bar Association where the candidate practiced previously.
  • Retired employees shall enclose attested copy of Departmental Tests passed, attested copies of retirement proceedings and pension payment order.
  • Candidates who worked as Gazetted Officers in Revenue Department and exercised magisterial powers shall enclose certificate of exercising magisterial powers for not less than three years during their tenure.
  • Candidates shall enclose necessary fitness certificate regarding state of health.

  • Officers selected on deputation will have the option either to get their pay fixed in the deputation post under normal rules or to draw pay of the post held in parent department plus deputation (duty) allowance as per applicable government orders.
  • Dearness Allowance, local allowances, residential accommodation charges, and other benefits during deputation will be regulated as per Visakhapatnam Port Authority rules and the deputation terms.

Age Limit (as on 19-01-2026)

Application Fee

  • The vacancy circular does not mention any application fee for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) on absorption/deputation basis.

Selection Process

  • Applications will be considered from eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations.
  • No advance copy of application from the applicant will be accepted; only applications forwarded by the Competent Authority within due date will be considered.
  • Incomplete applications, applications received after the last date, or without ACRs/APARs or required enclosures will not be considered.
  • The officer selected for the post will be appointed on absorption/deputation basis and will be governed by the terms and conditions of deputation as per Annexure-VII.
  • VPA reserves the right to cancel or change the number of vacancies without assigning reasons; decision of the Appointing Authority is final in all recruitment matters.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited for filling up three vacant posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) (Class-I) in Civil Engineering Department, Visakhapatnam Port Authority on absorption/deputation basis from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities.

  • Applications must be accompanied by certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020–2021 to 2024–2025) duly attested, with No Report/Non-availability certificate where APAR for a year is not available.

  • Undertaking of the applicant that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected; withdrawal after selection may lead to debarment from future selection in VPA for two years.
  • Applications must include No Objection Certificate from competent authority, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, verification of university certificates and recognition of degrees, and complete service details in prescribed formats.
  • Vacancy circular along with Annexures is also available on VPA website www.vizagport.com.

How to Apply

  • Eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities should submit their applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-II) through proper channel.
  • Envelope should be superscribed “Application for the post of Executive Engineer (Civil)” and sent to: Secretary, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, 1st Floor, Administrative Office Building, Port Area, Visakhapatnam – 530035.
  • Applications must be forwarded by the Competent Authority of the respective organizations; advance copies from applicants will not be accepted.
  • Along with the application, forward certified copies of ACRs/APARs for last 5 years, attested copies of educational and experience certificates, undertaking of non-withdrawal of candidature, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance/Administrative clearance, certificate of verification of degree and university recognition, details of penalties if any, and complete service details.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications Required for Each Post:

  • Office Subordinate: Must have passed SSC or equivalent examination from a recognized Board.
  • Anesthesia Technician: Must possess Intermediate with science Groups and 2 years Diploma in Anaesthesia Technician. Must be registered in APPMB.
  • Cardiology Technician: B.Sc Degree from a Recognized University with 2 years Diploma in Cardiology Technician with 2 years Diploma in Electrocardiography from a Recognized Institution OR B.Sc in Cardiovascular Technology from a Recognized Institution. Must be registered in APPMB.
  • Lab Technician: Must possess DMLT or B.Sc (MLT) OR Intermediate (VOC) with one year apprenticeship in Govt. Hospitals. Must be registered in APPMB. In case of candidate possessing both DMLT and B.Sc MLT, the maximum percentage secured in any of the above shall be considered.
  • Operation Theatre Technician: Must possess Diploma in Medical Sterilization Management & Operation Theatre Technician. Must be registered in APPMB.
  • General Duty Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th Class or its equivalent from a recognized Board.
  • Store Attendant: Must have passed SSC or its equivalent.
  • Lab Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th or its equivalent. Must possess Lab Attendant Course or Intermediate (Lab Attendant Vocational Course) conducted by the Board of Inter Education, AP or from any other institution recognized by the Govt of AP.
  • ECG Technician: Must have passed intermediate examination or its equivalent. Must possess Diploma in ECG Technician course from a recognized institution. Must be registered in APPMB.
  • Library Assistant: Must possess Intermediate with CLISc (Certificate in Library Science) from a recognized university.

Essential Qualifications:

  • The candidate should possess prescribed academic/technical/professional qualifications for the post they are applying for as on the date of this notification.
  • If the applicant possesses an equivalent qualification to prescribed qualification in this notification, applicant shall enclose a copy of the Government orders to that effect to the application, failing which their application will be rejected.
  • Registration in APPMB is mandatory for posts such as Anesthesia Technician, Cardiology Technician, Lab Technician, Operation Theatre Technician, and ECG Technician.

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 42 years (Age will be reckoned as on 01.12.2025)
  • Age Relaxation for SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates: 05 (Five) years
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-service Men: 03 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces
  • Age Relaxation for Differently Abled Persons: 10 (Ten) years
  • Maximum Age Limit with all relaxations: 52 years

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
OC Candidates Rs.300/- (Rupees Three Hundred Only)
BC/SC/ST/EWS/Ex-Service Candidates/PWD (Other than OC) Rs.200/- (Rupees Two Hundred Only)
  • Applicant must enclose a Demand Draft towards application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram.
  • If any candidate wants to apply for more than one post he/she is required to enclose separate demand draft for each post and apply for each post separately for both Government Medical College and Government Teaching General Hospital, Rajamahendravaram.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 22.12.2025
Application Form Available From 26.12.2025 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Submission of Applications 09.01.2026 (04:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • Total Marks: 100
  • Marks Allocation: 75% will be allocated for aggregate of marks obtained in all the years in qualifying examination or any other equivalent qualification.
  • Waiting Period Weightage: Up to 10 marks @ 1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring requisite Qualification as mentioned in the pass certificate. Weightage will be reckoned up to date of notification.
  • Service Weightage: Weightage up to 15% will be given to the candidates working on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis including COVID-19 service subject to their Satisfactory service certified by the competent authority.
  • Weightage Based on Working Area:
    • 2.5 marks per Six Months in Tribal Area
    • 2.0 marks per Six Months in Rural Area
    • 1.0 marks per Six Months in Urban Areas
    • No weightage will be given for the services less than six months for Non-COVID service
  • COVID-19 Weightage: If any individual worked less than 6 months for COVID, 0.8 marks per completed month will be awarded. The COVID-19 weightage shall be applicable only to the persons who have rendered their services for COVID-19 on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis and are appointed by the District Collector or any other competent authority.
  • Service Certificate: The candidates claiming service weightage shall submit original contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium service certificate in the enclosed proforma issued by competent authority along with copy of appointment orders.

General Information/Instructions

  • Proforma of application will be available on the portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ from 10:00 am on 26.12.2025 to 04:00 pm on 09.01.2026.
  • Filled in applications shall be submitted in the specified counters in office of the Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram.
  • All candidates are advised to apply as soon as possible without waiting till last date to avoid last hour rush.
  • Candidates are advised to obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority.
  • No applications will be accepted by post or through email.
  • District Jurisdiction for this recruitment is Erstwhile District Only. Candidates studied from Erstwhile East Godavari District will only be considered as local candidates based on 4th to 10th study certificates as per the Presidential order.
  • Counseling will be conducted separately for Government Medical College and Government Teaching General Hospital, Rajamahendravaram. Hence candidates have to submit separate application form for Government Medical College posts and Government Teaching General Hospital posts.
  • The Final Merit Lists of this notification is valid for one year from the date of issue of this notification.
  • Reservations are applicable as per Rule 22 of AP State and Subordinate Services Rules and instructions issued from time to time including BC, SC and ST reservations.
  • The tenure for the contract/outsourcing posts is initially one year from the date of joining in the post and may be extended for further period as per the instructions issued by the Government from time to time.
  • The District Selection Committee reserves all the rights to terminate the contract/outsourcing services of any candidate/candidates at any time with one month notice or as per directions of the Government from time to time.
  • If selected, he/she should stay at the bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily.
  • If selected and appointed he/she should abide to the Government rules in force regularly from time to time.
  • Candidates are advised to follow official website of the District from time to time for further information.
  • Candidates should make sure of their eligibility to the post applied for and that the declaration made by them in the format of application regarding their eligibility in all aspects.
  • Any candidate furnishing incorrect information or making false declaration regarding his/her eligibility at any stage or suppressing any information is liable to be debarred from recruitment conducted by the department and summarily rejection of their candidature for this recruitment & future recruitment.

How to Apply

  • Download the application proforma from the official portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ from 10:00 am on 26.12.2025 to 04:00 pm on 09.01.2026.
  • Fill the application form completely with all required details.
  • Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates including SSC certificate for date of birth, pass certificates of qualifications, marks memos of all years, study certificates from class IV to X, valid caste certificate (if applicable), EWS certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), service certificate for claiming weightage (if applicable), and any other relevant certificates.
  • Prepare a Demand Draft for the application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram (Rs.300/- for OC candidates and Rs.200/- for BC/SC/ST/EWS/Ex-Service/PWD candidates).
  • If applying for multiple posts, prepare separate application forms and separate demand drafts for each post.
  • Submit the filled application form along with all self-attested documents and demand draft at the specified counters in the office of the Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram before 04:00 PM on 09.01.2026.
  • Obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority after submission.
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application and acknowledgement for future reference.
  • Candidates must submit clear, visible self-attested documents, failing which application will be summarily rejected.
  • Applications without the required documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Do not wait until the last date to avoid last hour rush.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Under graduation (Regular – Full time) in any discipline from a University / Institution recognized by AICTE / DOTE / UGC. The candidates should have appeared for the examination, passed and received the degree certificate in any of the years from July 2021 to 2025.
  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.
  • Government share of Stipend of Rs. 4500 will be directly credited to the Apprentices Bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines.
  • The stipend shall be paid to Apprentices each month after adjusting Loss of pay, If any.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age—21 years
  • Maximum Age -28 years
  • [i.e. candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2004 (both days inclusive)]
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application Starting Date 18.12.2025
Last date for applying “UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD” 20.01.2026
Physical appearance for verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd Call letter will be sent through Registered Email ID

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • Office Subordinate: Must have passed SSC or equivalent
  • Anesthesia Technician: Must possess Intermediate with science Groups and 2 years Diploma in Anaesthesia Technician. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Cardiology Technician: B.Sc Degree from a Recognized University with 2 years Diploma in Cardiology Technician with 2 years Diploma in Electrocardiography from a Recognized Institution OR B.Sc in Cardiovascular Technology from a Recognized Institution. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Lab Technician: Must possess DMLT or B.Sc (MLT) OR Intermediate (VOC) with one year apprenticeship in Govt. Hospitals. Must be registered in APPMB. In case of candidate possess both DMLT and B.Sc MLT, the maximum percentage secured in any of the above shall be considered
  • Operation Theatre Technician: Must possess Diploma in Medical Sterilization Management & Operation Theatre Technician. Must be registered in APPMB
  • General Duty Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th Class or its equivalent from a recognized Board
  • Store Attendant: Must have passed SSC or its equivalent
  • Lab Attendant: Must have passed SSC/10th or its equivalent. Must possess Lab Attendant Course or Intermediate (Lab Attendant Vocational Course) conducted by the Board of Inter Education, AP or from any other institution recognized by the Govt of AP
  • ECG Technician: Must have passed intermediate examination or its equivalent. Must possess Diploma in ECG Technician course from a recognized institution. Must be registered in APPMB
  • Library Assistant: Must possess Intermediate with CLISc (Certificate in Library Science) from a recognized university

Essential Requirements:

  • The candidate should possess prescribed academic/technical/professional qualifications for the post they are applying for as on the date of this notification
  • If the applicant possesses an equivalent qualification to prescribed qualification in this notification, applicant shall enclose a copy of the Government orders to that effect to the application, failing which their application will be rejected
  • For posts requiring APPMB registration, valid certificate of registration in A.P. Para Medical Board is mandatory

Age Limit (as on 01.12.2025)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 42 years
  • Age Relaxations:
    • For SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates: 05 (Five) years
    • For Ex-service Men: 03 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces
    • For differently abled persons: 10 (Ten) years
    • Maximum age limit with all relaxations put together: 52 years
  • Age Calculation Date: Age will be reckoned as on 01.12.2025 as per G.O.Ms.No.105 GA (Ser-A) dept., dated 27.09.2021

  • Applicant must enclose a Demand Draft towards application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram

Selection Process

  • Total Marks: 100
  • Marks Distribution for Qualifying Examination: 75% will be allocated for aggregate of marks obtained in all the years in qualifying examination or any other equivalent qualification
  • Weightage for Experience: Up to 10 marks @ 1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring requisite Qualification as mentioned in the pass certificate. Weightage will be reckoned up to date of notification
  • Weightage for Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium Service: Up to 15% will be given to the candidates working on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis including COVID-19 service subject to their Satisfactory service certified by the competent authority
  • Weightage Based on Working Area:
    • 2.5 marks per Six Months in Tribal Area
    • 2.0 marks per Six Months in Rural Area
    • 1.0 marks per Six Months in Urban Areas
    • No weightage will be given for the services less than six months for Non-COVID service
  • COVID-19 Weightage: If any individual worked less than 6 months for COVID, 0.8 marks per completed month will be awarded. Applicable only to the persons who have rendered their services for COVID-19 on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis and are appointed by the District Collector or any other competent authority
  • The candidates claiming service weightage shall submit original contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium service certificate issued by competent authority along with copy of appointment orders

General Information/Instructions

  • Proforma of application will be available on the portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ from 10:00 am on 26.12.2025 to 04:00 pm on 09.01.2026
  • Filled in applications shall be submitted in the specified counters in office of the Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • All candidates are advised to apply as soon as possible without waiting till last date to avoid last hour rush
  • Candidates are advised to obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority
  • No applications will be accepted by post or through email
  • District Jurisdiction for this recruitment is Erstwhile District Only. Candidates studied from Erstwhile East Godavari District will only be considered as local candidates based on 4th to 10th study certificates as per the Presidential order
  • Counseling will be conducted Separately for Government Medical College and Government Teaching General Hospital, Rajamahendravaram
  • Candidates have to submit separate application form for Government Medical College posts and Government Teaching General Hospital posts
  • The Final Merit Lists of this notification is valid for one Year from the date of issue of this notification
  • Reservations are applicable as per Rule 22 of AP State and Subordinate Services Rules and instructions issued from time to time including BC, SC and ST reservations
  • The tenure for the contract/outsourcing posts is initially one year from the date of joining in the post and may be extended for further period as per the instructions issued by the Government from time to time
  • The District Selection Committee reserves all the rights to terminate the contract/outsourcing services of any candidate/candidates at any time with one month notice
  • If selected, he/she should stay at the bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily
  • If selected and appointed, he/she should abide to the Government rules in force regularly from time to time
  • Candidates are advised to follow official website of the District from time to time for further information
  • Candidates should make sure of their eligibility to the post applied for and that the declaration made by them in the format of application regarding their eligibility in all aspects
  • Any candidate furnishing in-correct information or making false declaration regarding his/her eligibility at any stage or suppressing any information is liable to be debarred from recruitment conducted by the department and summarily rejection of their candidature for this recruitment & future recruitment

How to Apply

  • Download the application proforma from the official portal https://eastgodavari.ap.gov.in/ between 26.12.2025 (10:00 AM) and 09.01.2026 (04:00 PM)
  • Fill the application form completely with accurate information
  • Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates including:
    • SSC or its equivalent (for date of birth)
    • Pass certificates of qualifications prescribed for the posts concerned
    • Marks memos of all years of qualifying examination or its equivalent
    • Valid certificate of registration in A.P. Para Medical Board (wherever applicable)
    • Study Certificates from class IV to X
    • Copy of valid latest caste certificate (if applicable)
    • Latest EWS certificate (if applicable)
    • Certificate of disability issued in SADAREM (if applicable)
    • Service certificate for claiming weightage (if applicable)
    • Any other relevant certificates
  • Enclose Demand Draft towards application processing fee in favor of Principal, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • Submit the filled application form with all documents and DD at the specified counters in the office of Principal/Addl. DME, Government Medical College, Rajamahendravaram
  • Submit separate application forms for GMC posts and GTGH posts if applying to both
  • Obtain dated acknowledgement from the receiving authority
  • Candidates must submit clear, visible self-attested documents, failing which application will be summarily rejected

Advertisement

Age Limit Not more than 36 years.
Last Date for Apply  03/01/2026
Official Website  

IIT Tirupati Principal Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Field Details
Position Principal Project Scientist
Number of vacancies 01
Project No. PHY2425004DSTXARIJ
Project Title A multi-node quantum repeater network for entanglement distribution based quantum communication.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Ph.D. in Physics or equivalent degree with minimum 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA during Ph.D. (graduate) and above 6.5 CGPA during M.Sc./B.E/B.Tech./M.E/M.Tech. coursework.
  • Relaxation in CGPA/percentage:
    • 7.0 CGPA or 70% for OBC/EWS.
    • 6.5 CGPA or 65% for SC/ST/PWD.
  • Ph.D. in Physics / Electronics / Instrumentation / Optical Engineering / other related areas. Candidates who have submitted/defended their Ph.D. thesis and are waiting for final degree can also apply.
  • Must have worked for either:
    • 2 years at RA II / RA III level, and/or
    • 2 years at RA I level and 1 year at RA II level, and/or
    • 3 years at RA I level.
  • Having at least two original research papers in SCI and/or a peer-reviewed journal; preference to candidates with more than two publications in a SCI indexed journal.
  • Prior demonstrated experience of working in experimental optics and/or experimental atomic and molecular physics.
  • Prior demonstrated experience with precision laser spectroscopy / laser cooling / ion trapping / atom trapping and related areas.
  • Experience with supervision of PhD/Masters students and/or postdoctoral candidates at RA I/RA II level.
  • Good knowledge (M.Sc. Physics and PhD level) in more than one of:
    • Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics.
    • Electronics.
    • Quantum Mechanics.
    • Quantum Optics.
    • Electromagnetic Theory.
    • Atomic and laser spectroscopy.
    • Finite Element Modelling and Simulation using COMSOL/ANSYS.
    • Knowledge of ORCAD/EAGLE.
    • Hands-on experimental exposure in AMOP experiments at PhD level.
  • Experience in programming with at least one of: Python / MATLAB / Mathematica / VHDL / Verilog / LabVIEW / SolidWorks / COMSOL / ANSYS / digital & analog electronics / optics / fabrication.
  • Exceptional candidates with a very strong publication record having only a theoretical background in light-matter interaction in warm atomic vapor / cold atom / ion trap systems and/or physics of cold atom / warm vapor quantum memories / repeaters, etc., will also be considered.
  • Must demonstrate highest work ethics, commitment and dedication to the project, with good oral and written communication skills evident through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations.

Salary/Stipend

  • Principal Project Scientist: INR 1,25,000/- per month + HRA as applicable (9% for Tirupati city).

Age Limit 

  • Age limit: Not more than 36 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Notification Date 19-12-2025
Application Last Date 03-01-2026
Interview Date Will be notified by email to shortlisted candidates.

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on CV, Statement of Purpose (SOP), motivation letter, research proposal and Letters of Recommendation received.
  • Online interview of the shortlisted candidates.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for the shortlisted/selected candidates for interview (online or offline).
  • Candidate needs to join duty within 7 days of intimation of selection by the committee.
  • Selection will be based on qualification, experience and interview performance.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from eligible Indian nationals for the Principal Project Scientist position in a time-bound sponsored project in the Department of Physics.
  • The selected candidate will work on a multi-node quantum repeater network for entanglement distribution-based quantum communication.
  • Nature of work includes:
    • Research and development.
    • Design and development of laser spectroscopy set-up.
    • Data recording and documentation of research work.
    • Critical analysis of experimental results.
    • Assisting in associated experiments.
    • Offline on-campus physical presence (remote work not possible).
    • Supervision and mentoring of PhD research students and postdoctoral fellows.
    • Attending meetings, workshops, conferences and presenting project outcomes.
    • Preparation of peer-reviewed manuscripts.
    • Preparation of administrative documents, progress reports, and assistance in procurement.
    • Teaching responsibilities and supervision of undergraduate and postgraduate students.
    • Overall coordination of multiple work packages.
  • The selected candidate will get opportunity to work on interdisciplinary areas such as simulation, design, fabrication, testing of instruments in lasers & optics, low-noise electronics, FPGA-based systems, ultra-high vacuum, mechanical and software development, neutral atom trapping, etc.
  • The work involves laser cooling techniques with neutral rubidium (Rb) atoms, precision laser spectroscopy, experimental quantum optics and quantum information processing protocols, aiming to develop a cold atom quantum memory node for quantum repeater applications.
  • IIT Tirupati reserves the right to discontinue the position with one month notice if performance is not satisfactory.

How to Apply

  • Apply online through the application link: https://forms.gle/gQ95b79gmaHK3PBj9 on or before 03-01-2026.
  • Required supporting material:
    • Self-attested academic certificates and transcripts from undergraduate to postgraduate level.
    • A copy of the current CV, Statement of Purpose (SOP) and motivation letter.
    • A brief research proposal on cold atom quantum memory.
    • Two Letters of Recommendation – one from PhD thesis supervisor and one from last postdoctoral supervisor at RA I/RA II/RA III level.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email only; interview date will be notified by email.
  • For queries, candidates may send mail to: [email protected].

HSL Various Posts 2025 – Important Details

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL)
Post Name General Manager (Technical/HR), Deputy General Manager (HR), Manager (HR), Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance), Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical), Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) and other posts as per detailed advertisement
Total Vacancies 11 Posts 
Salary/Pay Scale IDA pay scales from Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 (E2) up to Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000 (E7) with Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances etc. and consolidated pay of approx. Rs. 2,15,000/- per month for FTC and Rs. 1,20,000/- per month for Consultant.
Educational Qualification Full-time Graduate/Engineering/PG Degree/Diploma in relevant disciplines with minimum prescribed percentage (generally 60% marks) from recognized University/Institute as per post-wise requirements.
Age Limit Maximum age 52 years for General Manager posts, 45 years for Deputy General Manager/Manager HR, 35 years for Deputy Manager posts, 56 years for Senior Chief Project Superintendent and 62 years for Senior Consultant, as on 23/12/2025 (relaxations as per rules).
Application Start Date 23/12/2025 from 10:00 hrs
Application End Date 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs
Application Mode Online only through the official website; no other mode is accepted.
Official Website hslvizag.in

HSL Various Posts 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HSL Recruitment 2025 as per the detailed advertisement is distributed as follows:

  • On Permanent Absorption Basis:
    • P1 – General Manager (Technical) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM01 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P2 – General Manager (HR) (E7) – Post Code 04/2025/GM02 – 01 Post (OBC)
    • P3 – Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5) – Post Code 04/2025/DGM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P4 – Manager (HR) (E3) – Post Code 04/2025/MGR01 – 03 Posts (01 OBC; 01 SC; 01 ST)
    • P5 – Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM01 – 01 Post (UR)
    • P6 – Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2) – Post Code 04/2025/DM02 – 01 Post (UR)
  • On Fixed Term Contract (FTC) Basis:
    • F1 – Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) [Equivalent to CGM (E8)] – Post Code 04/2025/CGM01 – 02 Posts (01 UR; 01 OBC)
  • Consultant on Fixed Term Contract & Part Time Basis:
    • C1 – Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works) – Post Code 04/2025/CON01 – 01 Post

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • General Manager (Technical) (E7): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines from a recognised University/Institute registered with AICTE. Desirable – Post-graduation in Engineering/Management.
  • General Manager (HR) (E7): Full-time Graduate in any discipline with not less than 60% marks and full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare from UGC-recognised University/Institute with not less than 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Deputy General Manager (HR) (E5): Full-time Graduate with 60% marks and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management specializing in HR/Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Welfare with 60% marks. Desirable – Degree in Law.
  • Manager (HR) (E3): Full-time Graduate with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST) and full-time PG Degree/Diploma in Management with specialization in HR/Personnel Management/Labour Laws from UGC-recognised University/Institute. Desirable – LLB/LLM.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety) (E2): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in any discipline from AICTE-recognised University/Institute and full-time Diploma (not less than 1 year) in Industrial Safety from recognised University/AICTE.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance) (E2): Graduate with Qualified/Passed Final Examination from ICAI/ICWAI; MBA Finance desirable.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) (FTC): Full-time Engineering Graduate with not less than 60% marks in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Naval Architecture disciplines; Post-graduation in Engineering/Management desirable.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Engineering Graduate or equivalent in Civil Engineering from AICTE-recognised University/Institute; Post-graduation in Civil Engineering and Marine works course from IIT/other reputed institute desirable.

2. Experience

  • GM (Technical/HR): At least 22 years of post-qualification experience in Indian Navy/PSUs/large reputed private companies with specified shipbuilding/HR experience and minimum 3 years in immediate lower grade or equivalent CTC and level in private sector.
  • DGM (HR): At least 15 years’ post-qualification HR/Personnel/IR experience with required lower grade/CTC experience.
  • Manager (HR): Minimum 9 years’ post-qualification experience in HR/Personnel/IR/Legal/Administration in Govt/PSU/large private companies; preference for legal and RTI experience.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety): Minimum 5 years’ experience in Safety department in PSUs/large industrial establishments with statutory compliance exposure under Factories Act and AP Factory Rules.
  • Deputy Manager (Finance): Minimum 5 years’ post-qualification experience in Finance/Cost Accounting/Management/Funds/Budgeting/Auditing/Cost control in Govt/PSU/Private of repute.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): At least 24 years’ post-qualification experience with shipbuilding/design/repairs/warships/submarines and specified minimum service in lower grade/CTC levels.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): At least 25 years’ experience in planning/construction of defence projects, marine works (jetties/bridges), with structural design knowledge; retired Group A officers in pay level 13 of 7th CPC preferred.

3. Age Limit (as on 23/12/2025)

  • GM (Technical/HR): Maximum 52 years.
  • DGM (HR) & Manager (HR): Maximum 45 years.
  • Deputy Manager (Safety/Finance): Maximum 35 years.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical): Maximum 56 years.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Maximum 62 years.
  • Relaxations: 5 years relaxation in age and 1 year in lower-grade experience for internal permanent employees; age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-servicemen as per Government rules.

Selection Process

  • Candidates meeting essential qualification, experience and grade/CTC criteria will be shortlisted for interview, conducted either online (VC mode) or physically at HSL, Visakhapatnam.
  • The selection process may include group discussion, preliminary screening interview and final selection interview; decision of the selection committee will be final.
  • Shortlisting may be in a ratio not exceeding 06 times the number of vacancies, based on percentage of marks in essential qualification/graduation if large number of applications are received.
  • Shortlisted candidates called for physical interview will be reimbursed 1st AC train fare (P1–P4 posts) and 2nd AC train fare (P5–P6 etc.) by shortest route; air travel is allowed at candidate’s option but reimbursement limited to train fare.
  • Detailed scrutiny of applications will be done and mere issuance of call letter does not imply eligibility; management reserves right to change selection criteria or cancel the recruitment process.

Application Fee

  • Application fee: Rs. 300/- (Rupees Three Hundred only).
  • No registration fee for SC/ST/PH and internal candidates.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates must verify eligibility before applying.
  • Payment should be made through online mode; receipt of online payment is to be saved for future reference.

How To Apply

  • Visit the official website: hslvizag.in.
  • Go to “Careers” under “Human Resources” and open “Current Openings” to view the advertisement and posts.
  • Read the detailed advertisement and ensure you meet all eligibility criteria as on 23/12/2025.
  • Submit application online only via https://www.hslvizag.in; no other mode is accepted.
  • Register and complete three stages: Personal Details, Educational Details and Payment Details.
  • Upload mandatory self-attested documents: SSC/Intermediate/Diploma/Degree/PG mark sheets and certificates, proof of date of birth, caste/PH certificate, experience certificates, latest salary certificate, Annexure-I and other relevant documents.
  • Upload photograph (20–50 KB) and signature (10–20 KB) in prescribed size and format.
  • Select “Experienced” or “Management Trainee” appropriately against “Type of post” as per instructions.
  • Use SAVE button to avoid data loss and SUBMIT only after verifying all details; once submitted, editing is not allowed.
  • After successful submission, receive confirmation message and email with Registration ID and link to view submitted application; take a print-out for future reference.
  • For registration issues or clarifications, contact [email protected] electronically.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement / Cut-off Date (Age & Experience) 23/12/2025
Date of commencement of ONLINE application for all posts 23/12/2025 from 10:00 hrs
Last Date for ONLINE submission for all posts 13/01/2026 up to 17:00 hrs (once submitted, editing not allowed)
Possible extension for selective posts May be extended at the discretion of HSL (if decided)

Salary/Stipend

  • Permanent Positions: IDA pay scales – E7: Rs. 1,00,000 – 2,60,000; E5: Rs. 80,000 – 2,20,000; E3: Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000; E2: Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000.
  • In addition to Basic Pay, regular officers are entitled to Industrial DA, HRA, Allowances (27% of Basic Pay under cafeteria approach subject to Govt review), Contributory PF, Gratuity, reimbursement of medical expenses at CGHS rates for in-patient treatment, leave encashment, subsidized lunch and other benefits as per company policies/Govt regulations.
  • Senior Chief Project Superintendent (Technical) – FTC: Approx. consolidated pay of Rs. 2,15,000/- per month on fixed term contract for 3 years extendable by 1+1 years or till 60 years of age, whichever earlier.
  • Senior Consultant (Marine Technical Works): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month with retention incentive of Rs. 3,000/- on completion of every year till contract closure, with TA/DA, travel arrangements (for non-Vizag residents) and accommodation as per E7-equivalent rules.

Instructions

  • Indian Nationals only are eligible to apply.
  • All vacancies are primarily for Visakhapatnam; selected officers may be transferred to project locations for up to 2 years in one stretch and may undertake outstation duties to Delhi/Yards/Vendor premises as required.
  • Applications submitted other than the prescribed online method will be rejected; incomplete applications or those lacking requisite documents will be summarily dismissed.
  • Aggregate percentage of marks shall not be rounded off; for CGPA/OGPA/Grade, conversion to percentage must follow University formula or factor 10 with documentary proof where no formula is prescribed.
  • Training period, teaching experience, apprenticeship/internship and sabbatical/extraordinary leave will not be counted toward required experience.
  • Reservation rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS will apply; category certificates must be in prescribed format and within one year from date of advertisement for OBC (non-creamy layer) and EWS “Income & Asset” certificates.
  • Candidates from Govt/PSU/private sector must submit NOC/CTC and turnover proof as applicable; failure to do so may lead to summary rejection.
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview; non-production will debar the candidate from interview and travel fare reimbursement.
  • Management reserves the right to create and operate a panel, increase/decrease number of posts, consider candidates for lower posts/grades, relax qualification/experience/age in exceptional cases, or cancel the recruitment process without notice.
  • All correspondence including interview call letters will be through email only; candidates must keep the registered email active and also check spam/junk folders.
  • Appointments are subject to medical fitness and submission of dependents’ medical history declaration and medical test reports prior to joining; canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature.

Dt.01.11.2021 and GO RtNo.07 HM&FW(B2)dept. Dt.06.01.2022. Govt.Memo.no. 3740784/B2/2020 of HM&FW (B2) Dept., dt. 14.02.2022, Circular No.03/CHFW/2022, of CHFW, AP, dated.11.02.2022.

  • The decision of the department regarding acceptance or rejection of the candidature, conduct of counseling and at all consequent stages culminating in the selection or otherwise of any candidates shall be final in all respects and binding on all concerned under the powers vested with.
  • The department also reserves its right and modify regarding time and conditions laid down in the notification for conducting the various stages up to selection duly Intimating details thereof to all concerned as warranted by any unforeseen circumstances arising during the course of this process.
  • All interested and eligible candidates shall apply after satisfying themselves that they are eligible as per the terms and conditions of this recruitment notification.
  • Any application sent through any mode other than the prescribed offline mode (physical application)will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Submission of application form by the candidate is authentication that he / she has read the notification and shall abide by the terms and conditions laid down there under.
  • Candidates should make sure of their eligibility to the post applied for and that the declaration made by them in the format of application regarding their eligibility in all aspects.

  • The department is vested with duty of conducting recruitment and selection as per rules duly maintaining utmost secrecy and confidentiality in this process and any attempt by any one causing or likely to cause breach of this duty in such manner or such action as to violate or likely to violate the fair practices followed and ensured by the department will be sufficient for rendering such questionable means ground for debarment.
  • If selected, he/she should stay at the bonafide Head Quarters compulsorily. If selected and appointed he/she should be abide by the Government rules in force regularly from time to time. Candidates are advised to follow official website of the District from time to time for further information.

How to Apply

  • Proforma of application will be available on the portal https://krishna.ap.gov.in/ from 22/12/2025 to 31/12/2025 by 05:00PM. Last Date for submission of applications is 05:00PM on 31.12.2025.

Andhra Pradesh.contentHtml:
Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Tirupati (IISER Tirupati) has released the IISER Tirupati Multiple Posts Recruitment 2025 notification for filling 22 vacancies across Group A, B, and C posts. The recruitment drive includes positions such as Assistant Executive Engineer, Medical Officer, Assistant Registrar, Nurse, Private Secretary, Superintendent, Technical Assistant, Junior Library Superintendent, Junior Translator, Junior Office Assistant, and Lab Assistant. This is a significant opportunity for candidates with qualifications ranging from B.Sc. to Master’s Degree, MBBS, B.E., and B.Tech, seeking a stable career in a premier central autonomous institute.

Selected candidates will receive attractive pay scales under the 7th Central Pay Commission, with monthly salaries ranging from ₹21,700 to ₹56,100, along with allowances like HRA, Transport Allowance, medical benefits, and pension under the NPS. The online application process starts on 20 December 2025, and eligible candidates must submit their applications by 02 February 2026 (17:00 Hrs) through the official IISER Tirupati website. Selection will be based on written test, skill test, and/or interview, as decided by the Institute.

Medical Officer - Post Code 002

  • Essential Qualifications: MBBS Degree or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 and must be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register
  • OR Employees with at least 5 years of post-qualification experience after completing compulsory rotating internship in a recognized large / multi-specialty hospital with MBBS Degree
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, or equivalent qualification and must be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register

Assistant Registrar - Post Code 003

  • Qualifications: Master's Degree with at least 55% of marks or an equivalent grade in UGC's grade point scale
  • OR Employees serving at Pay Level 6 for 7 years or Pay Level 7 for 5 years as Superintendent / Section Officer / Private Secretary or equivalent with experience in handling Administrative / Finance & Accounting / Academic / Legal / Statutory / Audit / Stores & Purchase / Establishment matters with Master's Degree with at least 55% marks

  • OR First class bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognized University in any discipline
  • OR Employees with 5 years of experience at Pay Level-5 in functional areas of office administration / establishment / personnel / facilities and service management / finance and accounts / engineering and estate management / academic administration with Master's Degree 50% marks

Technical Assistant (IT) - Post Code 007

  • Qualifications: B.E. / B.Tech. / Diploma in Engineering of 3 years duration / MCA or M.Sc. / BS-MS with at least 55% marks in appropriate field
  • OR Employees with 5 years experience in relevant fields in Software development / Hardware / System Administration / IT & Networking / AV / AI / Data Science and Engineering in reputed companies with B.E. / B.Tech. / Diploma / MCA with at least 55% marks

Technical Assistant (Biology) - Post Code 008

  • Qualifications: B.E. / B.Tech. / Diploma in Engineering of 3 years duration / MCA or M.Sc. / BS-MS with at least 55% marks in appropriate field
  • OR Employees with 5 years experience in proven research / laboratory experience in relevant field, operation of scientific / technical equipment with B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA or M.Sc. / BS-MS Degree with at least 55% marks

Junior Library Superintendent - Post Code 009

  • Qualifications: Master's Degree in Library Science / Library and Information Science with 55% marks from a recognized University
  • OR Employees with 5 years of experience in the field of Library & Information Science in Digital Library Management / Library Automation and Library Networking with Master's Degree in Library Science with 55% marks
  • Desirable: Diploma / Certificate in Computer Application / Digital Library Management / Library Automation from a recognized Institute or enough working experience in Library Digitization and Library Networking

Junior Translator (Rajbhasha) - Post Code 010

  • Qualifications: Master's degree of a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level
  • OR At least 5 years office environment and typing skills in Hindi / English with excellent computer skills with Master's degree in Hindi with English as compulsory or elective subject

Junior Office Assistant (Multi Skill) - Post Code 011

  • Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree with 50% in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency in Office Applications like Word, Excel, Power Point
  • OR Employees with 4 years relevant experience with Bachelor's Degree with 50% in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency

Lab Assistant (Biology) - Post Code 012

  • Qualifications: B.Sc. (Biology) with 50% of marks from a recognised University / Institute
  • OR Employees with 3 years service in handling Laboratory equipment and experiments with B.Sc. (Biology) with 50% of marks

Lab Assistant (Chemistry) - Post Code 013

  • Qualifications: B.Sc. (Chemistry) with 50% of marks from a recognised University / Institute
  • OR Employees with 3 years service in handling Laboratory equipment and experiments with B.Sc. (Chemistry) with 50% of marks

Lab Assistant (Physics) - Post Code 014

  • Qualifications: B.Sc. (Physics) with 50% of marks from a recognised University / Institute
  • OR Employees with 3 years service in handling Laboratory equipment and experiments with B.Sc. (Physics) with 50% of marks

Salary/Stipend

Category Group A Posts Group B & C Posts

OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate Validity Issued on/after 01/04/2025 but not later than 02/02/2026
