Selection Process

  • The selection process will be based on Written Test / Skill Test / Interview as decided by the Institute
  • Written test and interview / personality test / skill test will be held offline or online as per the requirements and decision of the Institute
  • Candidates will be duly informed about the selection process through appropriate notification on the official website only
  • Where the number of applications is large, the Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for written exam / skill test / interview on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed

  • Any discrepancy between uploaded certificates and those produced at verification will result in rejection of candidature

  • OBC applicants must possess valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate and their caste must be listed in the central list of OBCs

  • Experience certificates must clearly mention starting date, ending date, duration, pay scale with basic pay for complete period served
  • Appointment letters, pay slips, transfer orders, unsigned experience certificates shall not be considered as valid proof of experience
  • Appointment will be subject to being found medically fit as per Institute requirements
  • The Institute shall verify antecedents or documents at any time. Fake documents or suppressed information will lead to termination and legal action
  • The Institute reserves the right to revise or modify any conditions by issuing suitable amendment or corrigendum
  • All information regarding selection process shall be uploaded on the Institute's website only. No separate written correspondence will be sent
  • It is the sole responsibility of applicants to ensure all uploaded documents are clear and legible
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification
  • Application submitted without supporting documents, with unclear scans, or incomplete in any respect will be summarily rejected

  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Courts of Law at Tirupati

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to submit the application online only through the official link: https://iisertirupatint.samarth.edu.in
  • Fill the online application form carefully with all required details
  • Upload recent passport size photograph
  • Upload photocopies of relevant certificates and testimonials in support of age, qualification, experience etc.
  • Pay the application fee online as per your category while filling the application
  • Provide active Mobile Number and Email ID in the application form for all future communications
  • Check email regularly including spam folder as shortlist notifications will be sent via email only
  • Ensure all uploaded documents are clear, legible and in prescribed format

The selection process of Indian Oil Corporation Limited includes a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT), where SPPT is of qualifying nature and final merit is prepared refinery-wise based on CBT scores only among candidates who qualify SPPT. Candidates who get selected will be appointed in the Non-Executive cadre in the pay scale of Rs. 25,000–1,05,000/- after having been found medically fit as per IOCL’s pre-employment medical standards.

This recruitment offers excellent career growth opportunities, competitive salary, and strong job security in India’s leading Maharatna PSU in the energy sector. The selected candidates will be posted across IOCL refineries at Guwahati (Assam), Barauni (Bihar), Gujarat (Vadodara), Haldia (West Bengal), Mathura (Uttar Pradesh), Panipat (Haryana), Digboi (Assam), Bongaigaon (Assam) and Paradip (Odisha) and will be responsible for safe and efficient operation, maintenance, quality assurance, and fire & safety of refinery units. Work arrangements may involve one, two or three shifts including continuous operations based on work exigencies.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.iocl.com from 20-12-2025 to 09-01-2026 by completing both registration and application steps, including payment of fee where applicable. The application fee for General/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates is Rs. 300/-, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

  • Send the hard copy to “The Registrar, Gauhati University, Guwahati-781014, Assam” so as to reach by 12/01/2026 (5:00 PM), superscribing the envelope as “Application for the post of Scientific Officer, Department of Communication & Journalism, Gauhati University, Advt. No. NTS-14/2025”.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official NABARD website. The last date to submit the application form is 12-01-2026. NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
Post Name Young Professional (14 Disciplines)
No of Posts 44
Salary ₹70,000/- Per Month (All Inclusive Stipend)
Qualification Bachelor's/Master's degree as per discipline requirement
Age Limit 21 to 30 years
Start Date for Apply 26th December 2025
Last Date for Apply 12th January 2026

NABARD Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Discipline/Post Name Total Vacancies Location
Climate Action & Sustainability 3 Mumbai (1), Lucknow (1), Shimla (1)
Economics 3 Mumbai (2), Ranchi (1)
Data Science 4 Mumbai (3), Dehradun (1)
Cyber Security 1 Mumbai (1)
Academic Administration 2 Lucknow (1), Mangaluru (1)
Graphic Designing 1 Lucknow (1)
PR, Outreach and Documentation 2 Mumbai (1), Guwahati (1)
Information Technology 12 Mumbai (9), Guwahati (1), Aizawl (1), Kolkata (1)
Geoinformatics 1 Shimla (1)
Development Management 3 Lucknow (1), New Delhi (2)
Project Monitoring 4 Mumbai (1), Chennai (2), Chandigarh (1)
Finance 6 Mumbai (6)
UI/UX Designing 1 Mumbai (1)
Software Testing 1 Mumbai (1)
Total 44

Note: A candidate shall be permitted to apply only for one discipline/location. Multiple applications under the same/different disciplines shall lead to cancellation of candidature.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Engineering/Environmental Science/Climate Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Economics: Post Graduate Degree in Economics/Applied Economics/Financial Economics/Statistics/Data Science/Finance/Public Policy with minimum 55% marks
  • Data Science: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with minimum 60% marks
  • Cyber Security: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/IT/Cyber Security/Electronics and Communications Engineering with minimum 60% marks OR Postgraduate degree with minimum 55% marks
  • Academic Administration: Bachelor's degree in Education/Business Administration/Computer Science/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Master's degree in Education (M.Ed.)/Educational Management/HRD/MBA (HR)/PGDM-HR with minimum 55% marks
  • Graphic Designing: Bachelor's degree in Digital Media/Multimedia/Graphic Design with minimum 60% marks
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Post graduate degree in Mass Media/Development Communication/Visual Communication/Journalism with minimum 55% marks
  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks
  • Geoinformatics: Post graduate degree in Geoinformatics/Geography/Remote Sensing/Environmental Science with minimum 55% marks
  • Development Management: Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate degree in Social Work/Rural Development/Rural Management/Development Studies/Development Management/Development Administration/Project Management/Business Management with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Project Monitoring: Bachelor's Degree or Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture/Soil Science/Agronomy/Horticulture/Land/Water resources with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Finance: BBA (Finance/Banking)/BMS (Finance/Banking) with 60% marks OR Two years full time PGDM (Finance)/Full time MBA (Finance)/MMS (Finance) with minimum 55% marks OR Bachelor of Financial and Investment Analysis with 60% marks OR Bachelor's degree with Membership of ICAI obtained on or before 01-11-2025
  • UI/UX Designing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation
  • Software Testing: Bachelor's OR Master's degree in Computer Science or Information Technology with minimum 60% marks in Graduation or minimum 55% marks in Postgraduation

Essential Qualifications

  • Required educational qualification must be possessed as on 01-11-2025
  • Result of final term/semester/year examination must have been declared on or before 01-11-2025
  • Candidates whose final year/semester results declared after 01-11-2025 are not eligible
  • All degrees must be from recognized University/Institution
  • Minimum percentage as specified for each discipline is mandatory

Desirable

  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Certifications in climate change management, sustainable development, or environmental policy
  • Economics: Working knowledge of Visualisation tools (Tableau & Power BI), advanced quantitative and econometrics skills, knowledge of Stata/R, Excel
  • Academic Administration: Knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in learning and development, Certification in Instructional Design, LMS, ICT in Education
  • Graphic Designing: Certifications in E-Learning tools, Adobe Certified Professional, UX Design, LMS, Articulate or Captivate certifications, SCORM/xAPI training
  • Information Technology: Proficiency in Programming languages (Python, Java), knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, familiarity with web hosting, APIs, wireframing tools like Figma
  • Geoinformatics: Certification in GIS tools like QGIS or ArcGIS
  • UI/UX Designing: Relevant certification in UI/UX design/development

Experience (Mandatory)

  • All Disciplines: Prior relevant experience of minimum 1 year in reputed organizations
  • Climate Action & Sustainability: Minimum 1 year in climate change mitigation, adaptation, or sustainability
  • Economics: Minimum 1 year in forecasting, financial modeling, preparation of impact balance sheets, exposure to domestic and international databases
  • Data Science: Minimum 1 year, preference for projects involving banking technologies
  • Cyber Security: Minimum 1 year in Information and Cyber security domain (preferably having worked in SOC)
  • Academic Administration: Minimum 1 year in training, instructional design, learning experience design & learning and development
  • Graphic Designing: Minimum 1 year in Graphic design, animation, e-learning tools, LMS, Adobe Creative Suite
  • PR, Outreach and Documentation: Minimum 1 year in developmental filmmaking/social work outreach
  • Information Technology: Minimum 1 year with experience in creating BRD or FSD, analyzing processes and designing workflows
  • UI/UX Designing: Minimum 1 year as UI/UX designer and developer
  • Software Testing: Minimum 1 year in reputed organization

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹70,000/- (All Inclusive)
  • Income tax or any other tax liable will be deducted at source as per applicable rules before effecting payment
  • The stipend is paid during the entire engagement period including training
  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • Candidate must be an Indian citizen
  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004
  • No age relaxation mentioned in the notification

Application Fee

  • Application Fee cum Intimation Charges: ₹150/- (exclusive of applicable GST)
  • Application Fee is Non-Refundable
  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances
  • Bank Transaction charges for Online Payment will have to be borne by the candidate
  • Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 26th December 2025
Last Date for Online Application 12th January 2026
Payment of Application Fee/Intimation Charges 26th December 2025 to 12th January 2026
Qualification & Experience Date As on 01-11-2025
Age Calculation Date As on 01-11-2025

Note: NABARD reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

Conduct, Discipline and Confidentiality

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

Samagra Shiksha Axom Procurement Specialist Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the project under which the Procurement Specialist is being engaged?

Ans: The engagement is under the World Bank supported Project “Support School Education in Assam” for implementation through a Project Management Unit in Assam.

2. How many Procurement Specialist posts are advertised under this project?

Ans: One post of Procurement Specialist is advertised for the Project Management Unit.

3. What is the eligibility qualification for the Procurement Specialist post?

Ans: Engineering or Commerce graduate with MBA or Master’s Degree/Post Graduate Diploma (minimum 2 years) in any discipline from a Government recognized university/institution with at least 5 years’ post-qualification experience in project procurement and contract management.

4. What is the age limit for applying to the Procurement Specialist position?

Ans: The candidate must be between 18 and 45 years of age as on 01-01-2025.

5. What is the monthly salary for the Procurement Specialist under this project?

Ans: The monthly fixed remuneration ranges from Rs. 1,20,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/- from the PMU fund of the project.

6. What is the duration of engagement for the Procurement Specialist?

Ans: The selected candidate will initially be engaged for a period of 11 months only, on a purely temporary and contractual basis.

7. Will the contractual engagement under this project be regularised in future?

Ans: No, the contractual engagement will not be regularised under any job/programme of the Government of Assam or Samagra Shiksha Axom and does not confer any right to permanent absorption.

8. What is the application period for the Procurement Specialist post?

Ans: Online applications will be received from 17.12.2025 to 31.12.2025.

9. Through which website can candidates apply for the Procurement Specialist position?

Ans: Candidates must apply through the recruitment portal link available on the Samagra Shiksha website at https://ssa.assam.gov.in.

10. How will candidates be selected for the Procurement Specialist post?

Ans: Eligible candidates will appear in a test/interview where marking will cover general awareness, personality & aptitude, subject matter and experience, and candidates must obtain at least 50% marks to be shortlisted.

Selection Process

  • Stage-I Written examination: 120 marks The written examination (objective type multiple-choice) of 2 hours duration will be conducted on OMR sheets and will test the candidates' proficiency in English language, general knowledge, general aptitude, reasoning and Assamese language (20 marks).
  • The Assamese language proficiency segment will be of qualifying nature. Candidates securing at least 40% marks i.e. 8 out of 20 marks in the Assamese language proficiency segment shall be treated as qualified to appear in the next stage. The marks obtained in the Assamese language segment shall not be taken into account while preparing the merit list.
  • There shall be negative marking in the written examination. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 mark (one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question) will be deducted.
  • Interview/Viva-Voce: 20 marks Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents. A candidate must secure at least 60% i.e. 12 out of 20 marks in the Interview/Viva-Voce in order to be considered qualified.
  • Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination (Stage-I) and Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II). Where more than one candidate obtains same grand total marks, the candidate who obtains more marks in the written examination will get preference. Where the marks obtained by such candidates in the written examination are also same, then the candidate who is senior in age will get preference. The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or alter the cut off mark in written examination and Interview/Viva-Voce.

However, candidates have to produce their original testimonials regarding educational qualification, claim of reservation, date of birth, caste, working experience (if applicable), etc. at subsequent stages when asked for.
  • No person, who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to any of the aforementioned posts.
  • The admission of candidates at all stages of the selection process shall be purely provisional and subject to their satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. If, on verification at any time before or after the selection process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility condition, his/her candidature shall stand cancelled without any notice. Mere calling of candidate to written examination/Interview etc. or issuance of admits cards/call letter etc. does not mean acceptance of candidature of any candidate which shall be further scrutinized at every stage and the High Court reserves the right to reject the candidature of any candidate at any time.
  • The provisional list of the candidates and reject list (if any) will be published in the High Court website for the candidates' reference.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidate for appearing in any stages of the selection process.
  • Valid Disability Certificate for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), if applicable, must be issued by competent authority.

They shall have to produce \"No Objection Certificate\" from their present employer at the time of document verification and \"Release Order\" at the time of appointment.
  • The High Court may decide not to issue any admit card/call letter etc. to any candidate and may decide to call candidates to written examination/Interview etc. by publishing a notification in the official website and notice board of the High Court. Candidates are advised to visit the official website (www.ghconline.gov.in) of the High Court regularly for updates and important information. Unnecessary correspondence should be avoided.

  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

For ST Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) OR Graduate in any discipline with Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management/Materials management/Logistics management/other relevant qualification equivalent to 01-year Diploma in Material Management from a recognized University/Institute.
  • Structural Fitter: ITI & NCTVT (National Apprenticeship Certificate) in Structural Fitter/Fitter/Fitter General/Sheet Metal Worker trade.
  • Welder: ITI in the trade of Welder.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 03 years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Shipwright Fitter: SSC with Training Certificate from Deck/Engine department.

For OBC Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Graduate having passed Intermediate examination from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India OR MBA Finance.
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Minimum 03 years' full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and one-year full time Diploma in Industrial Safety awarded by Board of Technical Education of any State Government/Union territory or CLI, RLI (Ministry of Labour).

Essential Qualifications

  • For Technical Assistant (Mechanical) and Junior Supervisor (Mechanical-safety), diploma in Mechanical engineering is essential requirement. Candidates who have done B.E./B.Tech and do not possess Diploma will not be considered.
  • All qualifications must be from recognized Universities/Institutes/Boards as per UGC/AICTE/Government norms.

Desirable

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): 2 years Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management from a recognized University/Institute. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Structural Fitter: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Welder: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Ability to work on Auto CAD. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Finance recognized by Govt of India. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.

Experience

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Minimum 2 Years Post qualification relevant work experience.
  • Structural Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Welder: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 02 years of experience in the line.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line/trade from Shipbuilding Industry.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience in Finance function.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience.

  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Pay scale of Rs.16,600-3%-63,500 (W-8 Grade)
  • Structural Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Welder: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Shipwright Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • All positions are on regular basis with benefits as per company rules.

  • For ST Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 38 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)
  • For OBC Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 36 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)

  • Internal candidates will get age relaxation as per GSL rules.
  • As on cut-off date, the maximum age after all age relaxations should not be more than 56 years.
  • For the candidates who has completed advance training from GSL, the period of training will be considered as experience for the relevant posts and weightage will be awarded as per the Advance Training Scheme.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC Candidates: Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) to be paid online through SBI e-pay (by Debit card/Credit card/Net Banking, etc.)
  • ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen Candidates: Exempted from payment of application fee, as per Government of India rules
  • Internal Candidates: No fee is required to be paid by internal candidates who apply for the said posts
  • Application without prescribed fees shall be liable for rejection.
  • Application fee is non-refundable; therefore, candidates are requested to verify their eligibility thoroughly before making any payment.
  • The candidature of applicants submitting fee of lesser amount or depositing fee through any other mode other than the prescribed method, will be rejected.
  • After submitting payment information in the online application form, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button in order to avoid double charges.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Candidates have to download and take print of fee receipt.
  • Non-generation of 'Fee Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. In case of failure of payment, candidates are advised to login again and repeat the process payment.

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Date 30/12/2025
Online Application Opens 05/01/2026 (00:00 hrs)

Selection Process

  • The selection process shall consist of Written test, Document Verification and Skill/Trade test.
  • The written test may be conducted through Computer based Test (CBT) or Pen Paper based Test (PBT) internally/externally.
  • Written Test will normally consist of 25% General Aptitude and 75% subject/trade related questions.
  • Outstation candidates who clear the written test and qualify for the Skill/Trade Test after Document verification only will be paid to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to Goa Shipyard Limited only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • ST candidates on being eligible and appearing for written test will be reimbursed to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to GSL/exam venue only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • Payment of TA shall be made through ECS mode after completion of the selection process only.
  • Candidates having "Wait Listed" tickets for Rail journey are NOT entitled for TA Reimbursement.
  • Merely calling of the candidates for the written test/skill test does not confer any right that the candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria mentioned in the Advertisement.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates have to submit caste certificate, in the Prescribed Proforma meant for "Appointment to posts under the Government of India" from the designated authority indicating clearly the candidate's caste.
  • The OBC (NCL) certificate should not be more than 06 months old at the time of joining.
  • The candidates under PwBD category belonging to the reserved category will have to submit the disability certificate from the designated authority as stipulated in Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 indicating clearly the percentage of disability.
  • If the ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English/Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi.
  • Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveer belonging to the reserved category can also apply against the advertised posts subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
  • Concessions & relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates applying against the said posts as per Government guidelines in vogue.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to ST category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial) and Welder posts.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to OBC category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Finance) post.
  • The posting shall be at GSL/any other GSL units/project sites as desired by GSL. However, depending upon project requirements, the candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of GSL.
  • The appointment to the post carries with it the obligation to serve in any department of GSL or on-board ships or in any of the units/work sites/projects undertaken in any part of India or abroad as the case may be.
  • The candidates may note that the applications are to be made only through online application system as per the instructions given. Applications made in any other manner shall not be considered and shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to clearly declare the complete experience while filling the online application from initial appointment to the cutoff date.
  • Management reserves the right to fill or not to fill the posts and also to fill up future vacancies, if any from the valid panel of selected candidates as per the rules of the company.
  • At the sole discretion of GSL Management the number of vacancies notified may be increased or reduced.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualifications and other requirements as laid down does not entitle a candidate to be called for selection process.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of selection process.
  • Management reserves the right to transfer any selected candidate in any position as per requirement of Company, irrespective of position he has been originally selected for.
  • The candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.
  • The Government directives on reservation will be strictly followed.
  • Interim enquiries will not be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Management reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence in support of qualification, experience, etc. of the applicants.
  • In case, at any time, it is found that the candidate is not meeting the eligibility criteria, the candidature will summarily be rejected forthwith.
  • Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for short listing the applications.
  • Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application.

  • Information Technology: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Information Technology with minimum 60% marks OR Post Graduate Degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Computer Applications/Information Technology with minimum 55% marks

  • Young Professionals engaged on purely contractual basis

  • Candidate must have been born not earlier than 01-11-1995 and not later than 01-11-2004

  • Application Fee once paid will NOT be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • Step 1: Application Screening
    • Applications received from interested eligible candidates shall be placed before the Screening Committee
    • Screening for interview based on matrix of identified indicators like academic performance, relevance of work experience, overall profile, statement of intent
  • Step 2: Interview
    • Shortlisted applications shall be placed before Young Professional Selection Committee (YPSC)
    • Final selection based on combined marks in Presentation and Interview conducted by YPSC
    • Interview will be conducted at respective NABARD Regional Offices of the States against which vacancies have been announced
  • Medical Fitness: Final appointment subject to being declared medically fit by Medical Officer(s) appointed/approved by the Bank
  • Document Verification: NABARD shall verify eligibility at stage of interview/joining
  • Final Decision: Final appointment based on decision of Selection Committee constituted for the purpose
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria shall not vest any right to candidate for being called for interviews
  • Decision of NABARD shall be final in all matters
  • Travel for Interview: Candidates may be reimbursed to and fro 2AC rail fare for shortest route for attending interviews

General Information/Instructions

Program Duration

  • Duration of engagement is 1 (one) year, extendable upto maximum three years
  • Extension depends on performance of Young Professional and organizational requirements

Legal Status

  • Young Professionals selected on short-term contract basis
  • Shall not be considered as "staff member" or "official" of NABARD
  • Engagement shall not establish relationship of employee and employer between NABARD and Young Professional
  • No right/claim for placement in NABARD by virtue of engagement under Young Professional Program
  • Appointed on full-time basis and shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during engagement period

Leave Facility

  • Young Professionals entitled to maximum 30 days leave in a calendar year during engagement period
  • Leave provided on proportionate basis

Medical Facility

  • Medical facility available for self only at NABARD Dispensary

Office Facilities

  • Lounge facility, Tea/Coffee provided as per entitlement of officers of the bank
  • NABARD will provide Office Space, Internet Connectivity, and other support facilities

  • Services governed by code of conduct as prescribed by NABARD
  • Internal data must be kept confidential
  • NABARD entitled to all intellectual property rights including patent, copyright, trademark developed during engagement
  • Must furnish undertaking for maintenance of secrecy before commencement
  • Subject to provisions of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
  • Shall not use name, letterhead, emblem or official seal of NABARD without prior permission

Termination

  • NABARD can terminate contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
  • In normal course, NABARD may terminate engagement by giving one month's notice in advance
  • Young Professional can also seek termination by giving one month's notice
  • If notice period not served, Young Professional required to pay sum equivalent to one month's pay
  • Unauthorized absence of more than 8 days (not including public holidays and weekends) without valid explanation can lead to termination

Travel and Official Benefits

  • For official domestic travel, eligible for halting, boarding and incidental allowances same as Grade A officer of NABARD
  • In event of death, injury or illness during engagement, neither Young Professional nor dependents entitled to any compensation or employment
  • Young Professionals solely responsible for maintaining adequate insurance (life, health) at own expense

Mentorship and Review

  • Each Young Professional attached to mentor/supervising officer who acts as Project Guide
  • Mentor responsible for regularly overseeing progress
  • Assessment done jointly by Officer in Charge of Department/RO/TE and supervising officer
  • Letter of Experience/Recommendation given at end of engagement period

Application Guidelines

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens
  • Candidates should check eligibility carefully before applying
  • Applications accepted through ONLINE mode only on www.nabard.org
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Candidate should not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Should not suppress any material information
  • If found guilty of misconduct/unfair means, liable to disqualification/debarment/termination
  • Bank reserves right to increase/decrease/modify/cancel any provisions of vacancy/recruitment process
  • No correspondence will be entertained from ineligible and non-selected candidates
  • Bank's decision shall be final and binding on all matters

For Government/PSU Employees

  • Applicants serving in Government/Quasi Government/PSU/Nationalized Banks required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from employer at time of interview
  • Before appointment, proper relieving letter indicating date of relief and no dues pending must be produced

Legal Jurisdiction

  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai
  • Courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai only shall have sole & exclusive jurisdiction

Communication

  • Notice/communication displayed on Bank's website or sent by Registered/Speed Post or email shall be deemed sufficient
  • Check www.nabard.org regularly for updates
  • Any corrigendum or announcements published only on Bank's website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit NABARD website www.nabard.org
  • Step 2: Under Career Notices, click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • Step 3: Choose "Click here for New Registration" tab
  • Step 4: Enter Name, Contact details and Email-id
  • Step 5: System will generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Step 6: Note down Provisional Registration Number and Password (will also be sent via Email & SMS)
  • Step 7: Before starting, prepare scanned documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 200x230 pixels
    • Signature (with black ink) - 10kb-20kb, jpg format, 140x60 pixels
    • Left thumb impression (on white paper with black/blue ink) - 20kb-50kb, jpg format, 240x240 pixels
    • Hand written declaration (on white paper with black ink) - 50kb-100kb, jpg format, 800x400 pixels
    • Latest CV/Resume in PDF format - 500KB
  • Step 8: Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Step 9: Use "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to save data and continue later if needed
  • Step 10: Carefully fill and verify all details in online application
  • Step 11: Upload Photo & Signature as per specifications
  • Step 12: Fill other details of Application Form
  • Step 13: Click on Preview Tab to verify entire application
  • Step 14: Modify details if required
  • Step 15: Click 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' only after verifying all details are correct
  • Step 16: Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment
  • Step 17: Pay application fee of ₹150/- (plus GST) using Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets
  • Step 18: Wait for intimation from server after payment - DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH
  • Step 19: On successful payment, e-Receipt will be generated
  • Step 20: Click 'Submit' button to complete application
  • Step 21: Take printout of e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference

Important Points for Online Application

  • Apply only for ONE discipline/location - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted
  • Application will be rejected if only photo uploaded without signature
  • Left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged
  • Hand written declaration must be in candidate's handwriting and in English only
  • Keep valid personal email ID and mobile number active till completion of recruitment
  • Name should be spelt correctly as in Certificates/Mark sheets/Identity proof
  • No change possible after clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' button
  • Photo must be uploaded at place of photo and signature at place of signature
  • If photo not uploaded properly, admission for examination will be rejected/denied
  • For any problem, use "Candidate Grievance Lodging and Redressal Mechanism" at https://cgrs.ibps.in/
  • Mention "NABARD – Recruitment of Young Professionals" in subject of email

Action Against Candidates Found Guilty

  • Do not furnish false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • Using unfair means will lead to disqualification
  • Impersonating or procuring impersonation will lead to criminal prosecution
  • Misbehaving in examination/interview hall will lead to disqualification
  • Carrying mobile phones or electronic devices in examination/interview hall not allowed
  • May be debarred permanently or for specified period from any examination conducted by bank
  • If already joined, services may be terminated

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must be registered with the State Medical Council/MCI/NMC.
  • Candidates holding DNB in broad specialties or super specialties as qualifying education must produce documentary evidence issued by competent authority regarding DNB equivalence with MD/MS/DM/MCh as per MCI, New Delhi notification dated 31-10-2018.
  • Those who have undergone DNB training from institutions given under para 2(a) and 2(b) of the MCI notification do not need extra experience after qualifying degree for equivalence.
  • Candidates who have undergone DNB training at institutions given under para 2(c) and 2(d) of the MCI notification require 01 year and 02 years extra experience respectively (total 04 and 05 years’ experience respectively) from MCI recognized/permitted institution for equivalence.
  • Candidates applying for the post(s) must satisfy eligibility for the post(s) and must fulfill all eligibility criteria on or before 15.01.2026.
  • The crucial date for age limit and experience etc. is the last date of receipt of online applications i.e., 15.01.2026.

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Entry Level Pay Matrix 14A (Basic Rs. 1,68,900–2,20,400) as per 7th CPC and all usual allowances, plus NPA for candidates possessing medical qualification.
  • Additional Professor: Entry Level Pay Matrix 13A2 (Basic Rs. 1,48,200–2,11,400) as per 7th CPC and all usual allowances, plus NPA for candidates possessing medical qualification.
  • Associate Professor: Entry Level Pay Matrix 13A1 (Basic Rs. 1,38,300–2,09,200) as per 7th CPC and all usual allowances, plus NPA for candidates possessing medical qualification.
  • Assistant Professor: Entry Level Pay Matrix 12 (Basic Rs. 1,01,500–1,67,400) as per 7th CPC and all usual allowances, plus NPA for candidates possessing medical qualification.
  • For contract appointments of retired faculty as Consultants: A fixed monthly amount shall be admissible, arrived at by deducting basic pension from the pay last drawn at the time of retirement, as per Department of Expenditure OM F.No.3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, with no annual increment or percentage enhancement during contract period.
  • Retired faculty appointed as Consultants shall also be entitled to residential accommodation subject to applicable deductions in respect of such accommodation as per Government instructions.

Age Limit 

  • Professor / Additional Professor (Direct Recruitment): Not exceeding 58 years.
  • Professor / Additional Professor (Deputation): Not exceeding 56 years.
  • Professor / Additional Professor (Retired Faculty on Contract): Not exceeding 70 years.
  • Associate Professor / Assistant Professor: Not exceeding 50 years.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation of 05 years over and above prescribed upper age limit.
  • OBC: Relaxation of 03 years over and above prescribed upper age limit.
  • Economically Weaker Section (EWS): No age relaxation.
  • Central Government Servant fulfilling conditions as prescribed in OM No. 15012/2/2010-Estt.(D) dated 27th March 2012: Relaxation of 05 years.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Age relaxation will be extended as per DoPT guidelines issued on 06.09.2022 (10 years relaxation mentioned for PwBD candidates in reservation section).
  • Ex-serviceman: Age relaxation as per DoPT guidelines issued on 06.09.2022.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of fee.
  • SC/ST category: Rs. 1,000 plus 18% GST = Rs. 1,180/-.
  • Other categories: Rs. 2,000 plus 18% GST = Rs. 2,360/-.
  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid by online NEFT mode only in favor of “Executive Director, AIIMS-Bilaspur”.
  • Bank details for NEFT:
    • Name of Bank: State Bank of India, Bilaspur.
    • Name of Account Holder: Recruitment Fund, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bilaspur.
    • Bank Account Number: 42734198120.
    • IFSC Code: SBIN0063972.
  • Proof of fee payment must be uploaded with the online application and produced at the time of interview.

Important Dates

Advertisement Notice Date 20 December 2025
Closing date of submission of online application in Google Form 15.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
Crucial date for determining eligibility, age, and experience 15.01.2026
Last date for receipt of hard copy (offline) application 27.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM

Selection Process

  • Applications received within the prescribed date and time with requisite fee will be scrutinized by the scrutiny committee of the Institute.
  • Candidates found eligible after scrutiny will ONLY be called for personal interview by the Standing Selection Committee (SSC) of the Institute.
  • Mere fulfilling eligibility criteria does not confer the right to be called for interview or selection; eligibility will be decided based on duration and nature of experience, patient care, teaching/training, research, number and quality of publications, publication metrics, and administrative experience.
  • If the number of applicants is large, the Selection Committee may devise additional criteria and procedure for shortlisting, including holding a written examination if necessary.
  • Only eligible/shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, subject to verification of all requirements and documents; otherwise, they will not be allowed to appear for interview.
  • Interview schedule will be published on the official website of AIIMS Bilaspur.
  • Candidates called for interview must make a presentation on their work/achievements (maximum 05 minutes) in Microsoft PowerPoint as per prescribed proforma, to be submitted in a Pen Drive with the application and updated if required.
  • Candidates must appear personally and physically before the Selection Committee; no online interview through electronic media (e.g., Skype, Viber) will be allowed.
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates will be issued appointment letters subject to being declared medically fit by the Medical Board of the Institute and verification of documents, declarations, and antecedents.

General Information/Instructions

  • AIIMS Bilaspur reserves the right to increase or decrease or not to fill up any post(s)/vacancy and to amend, cancel, or change the advertisement wholly or partly without assigning any reason or notice.
  • Detailed advertisement is available on the website of the Institute and aspiring candidates may visit https://www.aiimsbilaspur.edu.in.
  • Further updates regarding the recruitment process will be available only on the Institute website.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • The posts are whole-time and private practice of any kind is prohibited.
  • Selected candidates will be governed by the New Pension Scheme as per Ministry of Finance Notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22.12.2003.
  • All original certificates/documents will be verified at the time of interview; candidates must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of age, educational qualifications, experience, NOC (if applicable), and other relevant documents.
  • Experience will be counted only after obtaining the prescribed qualification.
  • Candidates in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies must obtain “No Objection Certificate” from their present employer stating expected duration of notice period.
  • If any information or declaration is found false or if material facts are suppressed, candidature will be cancelled and, if detected after appointment, services will be summarily terminated.
  • Separate application is required for each post if a candidate is applying for more than one post.
  • Candidates are advised to visit AIIMS Bilaspur website regularly for further instructions, if any.
  • No age relaxation will be given to SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply under UR category and category once applied cannot be changed later.
  • The Executive Director, AIIMS Bilaspur is the final authority for decisions relating to this recruitment and courts of Himachal Pradesh will have exclusive jurisdiction for any dispute.

How to Apply

  • Application Fees (Step-1)
    • Pay the non-refundable application fee via online NEFT in favor of “Executive Director, AIIMS-Bilaspur” using the specified bank details.
    • Upload proof of fee payment with the application and retain the proof for production at the time of interview.
    • Applications without submission of application fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application Form (Step-2)
    • Download the soft copy of the application form (Appendix-I) from the provided link.
    • Download the career graph form (Appendix-II) in MS Word format, fill it using Times New Roman, font size 12, and create a PDF (not scanned).
    • Download the presentation template in PPT format (Appendix-III) and fill it as per the proforma; rename the file with candidate name, post, and department as illustrated in the notification.
  • Online Application (Step-3)
    • Fill and submit the Google Form available at the link: https forms.gle/UAS4frrMvvQQFdfUA (as provided in the PDF).
    • Upload scanned copy of application forms in the prescribed format along with necessary documents and fee transaction details through the Google Form.
    • Failure to submit the online Google Form application will result in the candidature not being considered and liable to be rejected without notice.
    • Ensure that photo and signature uploaded are clearly visible; unclear or improperly sized images will lead to rejection of application.
  • Offline Application (Step-4)
    • Submit self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (Age, Qualification, Experience, Proof of Payment, Caste Certificate, EWS/PwBD Certificate, NOC, and other testimonials) along with printout of application (Appendix-I) and covering letter.
    • Ensure that the hard copy application reaches the following address on or before 27.01.2026 by 05:00 PM:
      Deputy Director (Administration), Administrative Block, 3rd Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Kothipura, Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh – 174037.
    • Super-scribe the envelope as “Application for the post of ………….., Department of …………………….. for AIIMS, Bilaspur (H.P.).”
    • Applications received through Courier/Ordinary Postal Dak etc. are not acceptable; applications received after the due date will not be accepted and AIIMS Bilaspur will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Through Proper Channel
    • Applicants already employed in Central/State Govt./Autonomous Institutions/Statutory organizations/PSUs should route their applications through proper channel.
    • Forwarding authority must certify that there is “No Objection” if the officer applies and is selected and provide Vigilance, Integrity and Penalty certificates.
    • In case of selection, the officer will join AIIMS Bilaspur only after submitting relieving or resignation certificate from the present employer.
    • Applicants may submit an advance copy of the application to avoid delay, but interview letters will be issued only after receipt of application through proper channel.

In case of visually impaired candidates, 2 hours 10 minutes time is allowed for examination with a Scribe, if request for the same to the Centre Superintendent immediately after receipt of his roll number/admit card

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Online Written Test: The test will consist of 100 questions for 100 marks with total duration of 90 minutes
  • Test Components:
    • General / Financial Awareness: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • English Language: 25 questions, 25 marks (Qualifying nature only)
    • Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • Computer Knowledge: 25 questions, 25 marks
  • Language: All tests except English Language will be available bilingually (English and Hindi)
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by Bank. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates entitled to 5% relaxation
  • Stage 2 - Test of Local Language: Conducted after qualifying the online written examination. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the local language of the state
  • Exemption from Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language
  • Final Merit List: Drawn state wise and category wise based on marks obtained in online examination in descending order
  • Tie Breaker: If marks are equal, merit order will be on the basis of Date of Birth (senior by age placed higher)

  • This is neither an employment nor a contract employment in the Bank. Engaged apprentices will only be "Trainees" and not treated as employees/workers
  • Period of engagement shall be restricted to One Year Apprenticeship Training Programme
  • Apprenticeship period shall not give the apprentice any lien/right on permanent employment with the Bank
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours

  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

  10. Step 10: Keep the printed application and documents ready to produce at the time of SPPT and document verification, if shortlisted.

Important Links

  • Official Notification PDF: Click Here
  • Employment Notification PDF: Click Here
  • Apply Online: Click Here
  • Official Website: www.iocl.com

Important Instructions for Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

  • Ensure all eligibility criteria (age, qualification, category, medical standards) are met before applying; candidature is purely provisional and subject to verification.
  • Fill the application form carefully; once submitted, no change/edit in details will be allowed and multiple applications for more than one post/refinery will be rejected.
  • Upload all required documents clearly as single, legible PDF files under correct categories; incomplete or illegible uploads will lead to rejection from selection process.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) before the deadline; fee once paid is non-refundable and not adjustable against any future recruitment.
  • Keep multiple copies of the submitted application form and e-receipt for future reference and verification during SPPT/document verification.
  • Check registered email ID, mobile number, and IOCL website regularly for updates on admit card, examination schedule, SPPT and results; call letters will not be sent by post.
  • Use a valid personal email ID and mobile number that remain active throughout the recruitment process; communication failures due to wrong details are the candidate’s responsibility.
  • Only one application per candidate per refinery/post is allowed; in case of multiple applications, only the last successfully submitted application will be considered.
  • Selection is subject to successful document verification, meeting IOCL’s pre-employment medical standards, and verification of identity and eligibility at all stages.
  • Any form of canvassing, use of unfair means in CBT/SPPT, or furnishing false information may lead to disqualification, cancellation of candidature and possible debarment from future IOCL recruitment.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online and pay the application fee is 09-01-2026 (23:55 Hrs).

Q2. What is the age limit for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A2. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 26 years for General/EWS candidates as on 31-12-2025, with relaxations up to 29 years (OBC-NCL), 31 years (SC/ST), and higher for PwBD/Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A3. Approximately 394 Non-Executive vacancies (including Junior Engineering Assistant-IV in various disciplines, Junior Quality Control Analyst, Fire & Safety and backlog/PwBD posts) are notified across IOCL refineries; candidates should verify the exact refinery-wise totals from the detailed vacancy tables in the PDF.

Q4. What is the selection process for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT); final merit is prepared refinery-wise based solely on CBT marks among candidates who qualify SPPT and fulfil all eligibility conditions.

Q5. What is the application fee for IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025?
A5. General/OBC (NCL)/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 300/- as non-refundable application fee, while SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from fee payment.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the IOCL Non-Executive CBT?
A6. No, there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test; all 100 questions are objective type with 1 mark each.

Q7. Can I edit my IOCL Non-Executive application form after submission?
A7. No, once the final online application is submitted and registration is completed, no change or correction is permitted; candidates must verify details carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the salary of IOCL Non-Executive posts?
A8. Selected Non-Executive personnel are placed in the pay scale of Rs. 25,000–1,05,000/- with industrial DA and are eligible for HRA/housing, medical facilities, performance incentives, PF, gratuity, LTC, education allowance and other benefits as per IOCL rules.

Q9. Is any specific score like GATE required for this recruitment?
A9. No, the IOCL Non-Executive Recruitment 2025 notification does not prescribe GATE or any external score; selection is based on IOCL’s own CBT followed by SPPT and medical fitness.

Q10. Where will the IOCL Non-Executive examination be conducted?
A10. The CBT will be conducted at multiple test cities across India such as Visakhapatnam, Guwahati, Vadodara, Delhi/NCR, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata and others listed in Annexure II of the notification.
