Eligibility Criteria

Internal Audit Officer (on Deputation)

  • Qualifications: Officers belonging to Audit and Accounts Services or other similar organised Accounts Services in Central/State Govt., holding analogous post on a regular basis.
  • OR with three years' regular service in Level 11 or equivalent in the area of Audit and Accounts in any Govt. Department/Autonomous Bodies.
  • OR with five years' regular service in Level 10 or equivalent in the area of Audit and Accounts in any Govt. Department/Autonomous Bodies.

Chief Security Officer (on Deputation)

  • Qualifications: Deputation from amongst persons from Police Organization/Para Military Forces etc. with five years' service in Pay Level 7 or above.

Medical Officer (Female)

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • MBBS recognised by MCI.
    • Three years of working experience in a Hospital attached with a Medical College/Corporate Hospital.
    • For the post of female Medical Officer at least one year working experience of Obstetrics and Gynaecology ward in any Govt./Govt. recognised hospital.
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Medical Qualification recognized by the MCI.

Assistant Librarian

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Master's degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree with at least 55% of marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed).
    • A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of library.
    • Qualifying in the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with the UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 and their amendments.
  • Experience: Candidates registered for Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations and shall be exempted from NET/SLET/SET requirement subject to fulfillment of specified conditions including Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, open viva voce conducted, two research papers published with at least one in a refereed journal, and two papers presented in UGC/ICSSR/CSIR sponsored conferences.

Private Secretary

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University/Institute.
    • At least 03 years' experience as Personal Assistant or 5 years as Stenographer in a University/Research establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU and other autonomous bodies.
    • English/Hindi Stenography speed: 120 wpm in English or 100 wpm in Hindi.
    • English/Hindi Type speed: 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi.
    • Knowledge of computer applications.
  • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.

Assistant

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University/Institute.
    • Three Years of experience as UDC or equivalent in the Level 4 in Central/State Government/University/PSU and other Central/State Autonomous Bodies or equivalent pay package in the reputed private Companies/corporate banks with a minimum annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores or more.
    • Proficiency in Typing, Computer applications, noting and drafting.

Personal Assistant

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from any recognised Institute/University.
    • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi with minimum speed of 100 wpm.
    • Proficiency in typing in English or Hindi with minimum speed of 35/30 wpm respectively.
    • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
    • Two years' experience as Stenographer or equivalent in Central/State Govt. organisation/University Research Institution or Central/State autonomous Institution/reputed private institutions having a turnover 200 Crores.
  • Desirable: Proficiency in English and good communication skills.

Junior Engineer (Electrical)

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • Bachelor's Degree of Engineering/Technology in relevant field from a recognized Institute/University with one year relevant experience.
    • OR Diploma in Engineering in the relevant field and three years' experience in relevant field in CPWD/State PWD or Similar Organized Services/Statutory or Autonomous Organizations/Central/State Universities/Autonomous Institutions or reputed Private construction company with an annual turnover of at least Rs.200 Crores or more.

Pharmacist

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • 10+2 plus 2 years Diploma in Pharmacy.
    • Registration with State Pharmacy Council.

Upper Division Clerk

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Bachelor's Degree from any recognized Institute/University.
    • Two year experience as Lower Division Clerk/Equivalent posts in University/Research Establishment/Central State Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent pay package in the reputed private Companies/corporate banks with a minimum annual turnover of at least Rs.200 Crores or more.
    • Speed in English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Speed in Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm.
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

Horticulture Supervisor

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • B.Sc. (Agriculture) with elective in Horticulture with 02 years' experience in the relevant field.

Laboratory Assistant

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • Bachelor's degree in Science (Physics) with minimum two years of working and maintenance experience of sophisticated scientific Instruments in the Laboratory.
    • The experience should be in University/Research establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU and other autonomous bodies or Private organization of repute with annual turnover of at least Rs.200 Crores or more.

Lower Division Clerk

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • A Bachelor's Degree from any recognized Institute/University.
    • English Typing @ 35wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30wpm (35 wpm and 30 wpm correspond to 10500 KDPH/9000KDPH on an average of 5 key depressions for each word).
    • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

Cook

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • Class 10th from a recognized School Board.
    • Two years' experience in cooking/catering services in educational institutions/guest houses, reputed hotels, restaurants or similar organisations.
  • Desirable:
    • ITI Trade certificate in Bakery and Confectionery (one year duration).
    • Experience in preparation of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food items both of South Indian/North Indian cuisine and continental cuisine.

Laboratory Attendant

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • 10+2 with Science stream from any recognized Central/State Board.
    • OR 10th Pass from any recognized Central/State Board with Science as one of the subjects and skill certificate programme in Laboratory Technology.

Library Attendant

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • 10+2 or its equivalent examination from a recognized Board.
    • Certificate course in Library Science from a recognized Institution.
    • One year experience in a University/College/Educational Institution Library.
    • Basic knowledge of computer applications.

Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS)

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • 10th Pass from a recognized Board.
    • OR ITI Pass.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications – Level I (PRT, Classes I-V): Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed/appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) as per NCTE Regulations 2007; OR Senior Secondary with 45% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education as per NCTE Regulations 2002; OR Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and passed/appearing in 4-year B.El.Ed; OR Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and passed/appearing in 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education); OR Graduation and passed/appearing in 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education. Matric with Hindi/Sanskrit or Sr. Secondary/Graduation/Post Graduation with Hindi as one of the subjects is required.
  • Qualifications – Level II (TGT, Classes VI-VIII): Different subject-wise combinations of Bachelor’s Degree with at least 50% marks in relevant subjects and B.Ed./D.El.Ed./B.El.Ed or integrated BA.B.Ed/B.Sc.B.Ed, with Hindi or Sanskrit as one of the subjects in Matric or higher education, as detailed for TGT Social Studies, Science, Mathematics, English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Punjabi, Urdu, Physical Education, Home Science, Art, Music etc.
  • Qualifications – Level III (PGT, Classes IX-XII): Post Graduate Degree in concerned subject with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. (or specific combinations such as M.Sc. Computer Science/MCA/B.E./B.Tech for PGT Computer Science; M.P.Ed etc. for PGT Physical Education) along with Matric with Hindi/Sanskrit or higher qualifications with Hindi as one of the subjects and consistent good academic record as defined in the bulletin.
  • Desirable / Relaxations: 5% relaxation in minimum qualifying marks for SC/BC/Differently Abled candidates as clarified (e.g., 50% → 47.5%, 45% → 42.75%); Teacher education degrees must be NCTE-recognized; Special Education diplomas/degrees must be RCI-recognized.
  • Experience: No prior teaching experience is mandated for appearing in HTET; eligibility is based on educational qualifications and other conditions laid down.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum / Maximum age limits are not specifically prescribed in this Information for appearing in HTET-2025; conditions are primarily based on minimum educational qualifications.
  • Candidates must, however, meet all eligibility conditions of the respective Service Rules at the time of actual recruitment by appointing authorities, even after qualifying HTET.

Application Fee

Category For One Level only For Two Levels For Three Levels
SC and PH Candidates of Haryana Domicile Rs. 500/- Rs. 900/- Rs. 1200/-
All Candidates except SC and PH of Haryana Domicile Rs. 1000/- Rs. 1800/- Rs. 2400/-
All Candidates Non-Haryana Domicile (Including SC & PH) Rs. 1000/- Rs. 1800/- Rs. 2400/-
  • Fee once remitted shall not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Application fee is payable only through online payment gateway while submitting the application.

Important Dates

Online Application System Start 24.12.2025
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 04.01.2026
Correction in Particulars 04.01.2026 to 05.01.2026
Downloading of Admit Card From a date to be notified (Admit cards will not be sent by post)
Schedule / Date of Test Will be mentioned after due approval from the State Government (as per admit card – 150 minutes for each level)

Selection Process

  • HTET-2025 is conducted as a qualifying eligibility test with separate Levels: Level I (PRT), Level II (TGT), Level III (PGT), each having a single paper of 150 multiple-choice questions and duration of two-and-a-half hours.
  • All questions are objective type (MCQs), each carrying one mark, with no negative marking.
  • Qualifying marks: 60% (90 marks) for all categories except Scheduled Castes and Differently Abled/Physically Challenged of Haryana domicile; 55% (82 marks) for Scheduled Castes and Differently Abled/Physically Challenged of Haryana domicile; 60% (90 marks) for Scheduled Castes and Differently Abled/Physically Challenged of other States.
  • Validity of HTET certificate: Lifetime from the issuance date for all levels; unlimited attempts allowed; candidates who have already qualified HTET may re-appear to improve their score.

General Information/Instructions

  • HTET-2025 is conducted by Board of School Education Haryana, Bhiwani on behalf of Government of Haryana as per guidelines of NCTE and Department of School Education, Haryana.
  • HTET applies to schools of the State Government/local authority and other specified categories as per RTE Act, 2009 and relevant Service Rules; some unaided schools may opt for HTET or Central TET at elementary level.
  • Qualifying HTET only confers eligibility; it does not guarantee appointment. Final eligibility and recruitment are governed by respective Service Rules and appointing authorities.
  • There is no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of OMR answer sheets; unfairmeans/malpractices, impersonation or possession of prohibited items will invite cancellation, debarment and legal action as per Board’s Unfairmeans Regulations.
  • Differently abled/visually impaired candidates may be provided compensatory time and scribe/amanuensis facilities as per specified conditions and government instructions.
  • The validity of the result is also linked with biometric (IRIS) verification; candidates missing stipulated biometric verification windows may be required to pay an additional fee for late verification within one year.

How to Apply

  • Read the HTET-2025 Information Bulletin (“Guidelines/Instructions – Scheme of Examination”) carefully before filling the online form.
  • Apply online through HTET website www.bseh.org.in or https://htet.eapplynow.com from 24.12.2025 to 04.01.2026 using a single registration for one level or multiple levels.
  • Keep ready scanned images of latest coloured photograph, signature and thumb impression in JPG format (photo: 20 KB to 50 KB, signature: 10 KB to 50 KB, thumb impression: 10 KB to 50 KB; photo dimension 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm, white background, at least 60% visibility).
  • Enter personal details (Name, Father’s Name, Mother’s Name, Date of Birth) exactly as per Class 10th / Secondary certificate and submit mandatory Identification Proof & number.
  • Upload photograph, signature and thumb impression as per specifications, then remit application fee online through the payment gateway.
  • After successful submission and fee payment, download and keep printout of the Confirmation Page for record (no need to send to Board office).
  • Use the specified online correction window (04.01.2026 to 05.01.2026) to rectify particulars, photo/signature/thumb impression, level, caste category, physically challenged status and home state; no offline corrections via email/fax/post will be accepted.
  • In case confirmation page is not generated despite fee payment, contact Assistant Secretary (Special Exam Cell) of the Board office with proof of payment.

  • The short listing of candidates shall be done on the basis of particulars and reservation category filled in online application form for which the candidate has the supporting documents as on last date of submission of application. In absence of documentary evidence or mismatch in claimed category, candidature of candidate shall be considered under General category/Parent category, subject to his/her fulfilling eligibility in General category/Parent category.
  • The benefit of reservation will be given only to those SC/BCA/BCB/EWS/PwD and ESM candidates who are bonafide resident of Haryana State and submit the application against reserved category posts and have the documents in support thereof as on last date of submission of application.

EWS certificate issued for jobs in Central Govt. will not be considered irrespective of income mentioned in certificate.
  • Qualifications and other term and conditions of eligibility will be determined with regard to the last date fixed for receipt of online applications also termed as closing date.
  • If on verification at any stage, it is found that any candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility condition or it is found that the information furnished is false or incorrect, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will also be liable to be criminally prosecuted. This is irrespective of whether the candidate was benefitted in his/her application from that particular eligibility condition or not.
  • No Individual information at any stage shall be sent and hence all candidates should regularly visit the Hartron’s Website & Public Notices in different Newspapers.
  • Benefit of reservation to Ex-Serviceman & their family members will be as per Government Instructions bearing No. 12/15/2019-4GS-II dated 09.03.2022 and 13.04.2022 or as amended from time to time upto the date of advertisement.
  • An ex-serviceman who himself/herself or his/her family member has already secured employment in civil service on regular basis in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government with availing the benefit of reservation – i. he/she himself/herself shall not be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation in civil service for any subsequent appointment in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government. However, the benefit of age relaxation for securing another employment in a higher pay scale or post shall remain continue and ii. his/her family member shall also not be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation against the posts reserved for ex-servicemen.
  • An ex-serviceman who himself/herself has already secured employment in civil service on regular basis in any Department/Board/Corporation/University etc. under the State Government without availing the benefit of reservation in such case he/she himself/herself or one of his/her family members (son, daughter or spouse) will be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation: i. where an ex-serviceman who himself/herself is eligible to avail the benefit of reservation under these instructions but he/she does not want re-employment in civil service in such case one of his/her family members (son, daughter or spouse) will be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation.
  • If an ex-serviceman applies for various vacancies before joining any civil employment, he/she can avail the benefit of reservation as ex-serviceman for any one of the subsequent employments. However, to avail of this benefit, an ex-serviceman as soon as he/she joins any civil employment should give self-declaration/undertaking to the concerned employer about the date-wise details of applications for various vacancies for which he/she had applied for before joining the initial civil employment. Further, this benefit would be admissible only in respect of vacancies which are filled by direct recruitment and wherever reservation is applicable to the ex-servicemen.
  • The family members of martyr military personnel shall be entitled to exercise an option either – i. to avail the benefit of reservation up to two family members; or ii. to avail the benefit of compassionate appointment to one of the family members under the Ex-gratia Policy namely Compassionate Appointment to family member of Martyr Armed Forces Personnel Policy notified by Government from time to time.
  • The priority list for recruiting agency for preparation of final list of selection/appointment of ex-servicemen or their family members against the posts reserved for ex-servicemen shall be as under:- i. disabled ex-servicemen, the post(s) for which they are physically fit; ii. failing (i), family member of disabled ex-servicemen; iii. failing (ii), other ex-servicemen who are eligible to get the benefit of reservation under these instructions; iv. failing (iii), family member of other ex-servicemen who are eligible to get the benefit of reservation under these instructions.
  • Disabled ex-serviceman means a person who has been released from military service due to disability attributable or aggravated due to military service. An exserviceman shall not be treated disabled one who has been released from military service not on account of his/her disability but has been released in the normal course after the completion of his/her term or retired from military service voluntarily.
  • Both the reservations are horizontal, therefore, a disabled ex-serviceman who is selected against the post reserved for ex-serviceman will not be counted against the post reserved for PwD.
  • In all circumstances the benefit of reservation against the posts reserved for Exservicemen shall be admissible at the time of final selection list only and not at the time of preliminary test, main test or interview.
  • An ex-serviceman who have been discharged from military service by way of dismissal, misconduct or inefficiency neither he/she himself/herself nor his/her family members shall be entitled to avail the benefit of reservation in civil service.
  • As per Instruction No.12/15/2019-4GS-II dated 13 April 2022 of Haryana Government Human Resource Department (General Services-II Branch), if an Ex-servicemen applies for various vacancies before joining any civil employment, he/she can avail the benefit of reservation as ex-serviceman for any one of the subsequent employments. However, to avail of this benefit, an ex-serviceman as soon as he/she joins any civil employment should give self-declaration/undertaking to the concerned employer about the date-wise details of applications for various vacancies for which he/she had applied for before joining the initial civil employment. Further, this benefit would be admissible only in respect of vacancies which are filled by direct recruitment and wherever reservation is applicable to the ex-servicemen. In the above said instructions the benefit of reservation has been allowed either to the Ex-serviceman himself/herself or one of his family members (son/daughter/spouse) therefore the provision of selection of any one post out of the posts for which application(s) was/were submitted before joining service shall also be applicable to the family members where they are eligible to avail the benefit of reservation under the above said instructions. In other words, above shall also be applicable to the family members of Ex-servicemen also.
  • Family member of ESM candidates of Haryana claiming benefit must have valid eligibility certificate on last date of submission of online application and shall produce the valid Eligibility Certificate from the concerned Zila Sainik Board at the time of test. ESM candidates should also produce attested photo copy of Identity Card issued by concerned Zila Sainik Board & Discharge certificate/Book. Disabled ESM shall produce disability certificate and family member of Martyr produce relevant certificate/Battle Casualty certificate which proves the Martyr status.
  • Benefit of reservation to the children/grandchildren of Freedom Fighters will be as per Government Instruction No. 22/49/2021-1GS-III dated 27.10.21 and 26.04.2022. Children/Grand Children of Freedom Fighter shall be required to have the Certificate duly issued by the respective competent authority.
  • Hartron can direct the ESM candidates to provide suitable information along with the affidavit to avail the benefits.
  • If for any post, reserved category of post is not advertised then the candidate of reserved category can apply for general category post and he/she will be shortlisted in General category only on the basis of merit.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Candidates who successfully apply online will be called for an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination
  • Merit List Preparation: The merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination
  • Tie-Breaking Rules: In case of equal marks in the written examination:
    • First preference: Older candidate (based on date of birth)
    • Second preference: Higher percentage in required educational qualification
    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies
  • Important Note: Appearing in online application, written examination, merit list, or counseling does not guarantee selection. Final recommendation depends on complete eligibility verification and vacancy availability

General Information/Instructions

  • Punjab Domicile Mandatory: Only residents of Punjab State are eligible for reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate (not older than 5 years) must be submitted during counseling
  • Category Certificates: SC/BC/Ex-Servicemen/PWD/EWS certificates must be as per Punjab Government's prevailing instructions
  • Category Code Selection: Candidates must carefully select category and category code while filling the online form as it cannot be changed at any stage
  • Ex-Servicemen Priority: ESM (Self) candidates will be given first preference. Only if ESM (Self) is not available, ESM (Dependent) candidates will be considered
  • Women Reservation: Recruitment will be done as per Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020, Notification No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020
  • Document Upload: Candidates must scan and upload required certificates in PDF format in a single file during online application
  • No Personal Communication: All recruitment-related information will be published only on the Board's website. No individual communication will be sent to candidates
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for attending written examination or counseling
  • Board's Rights Reserved: The Board reserves the right to modify/cancel/increase/decrease the number of vacancies or category-wise distribution at any stage of recruitment
  • Final Decision: The decision of the Board or Committee constituted by the Board shall be final and binding on all candidates

  • Step 2 - Click on Online Applications: Click on "Online Applications" link on the website
  • Step 3 - Select Post: For Advertisement 16, first click on Junior Engineer post, then select one from Civil/Mechanical/Electrical as per your qualification
  • Step 4 - Registration: Fill personal and educational details carefully and complete registration. A Username will be generated after successful registration
  • Step 5 - Login and Fill Form: Login using the generated Username and complete the application form step-wise
  • Step 6 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), 12th certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, and category certificates (if applicable)
  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment
  • Step 8 - Fee Payment: After submitting the form (skipping one day), pay the application fee through:
    • State Bank of India branch via Challan (on any working day)
    • Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI (anytime before 31-12-2025)
  • Step 9 - Download Application Form: After successful fee payment (after 2 days), download and print the application form for future reference
  • Step 10 - No Correction After Submission: Once submitted, no changes can be made to the application form. Candidates must fill the form carefully
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to apply themselves and not take help from cyber cafes to avoid errors. Self-application is recommended

ITI Limited Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 215 Contract Posts

Advertisement

ITI Limited (ITI), under the administrative control of the Government of India, has released the Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Notification for various domains including Projects, IS&IT, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing, Finance and Official Language on a temporary/contract basis. This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization ITI Limited (A Govt. of India Undertaking)
Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language
Total Vacancies 215 Posts

Age Limit Upper age limit generally 35 years for YP Technician/Generalist; internal candidates relaxation up to 45 years
Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification from ITI Limited specifies the advertisement date and the last date for receipt of online applications. Candidates should strictly adhere to the application deadline and regularly visit the official website for any corrigendum or addendum regarding the schedule.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

ITI Limited has announced a total of 215 Young Professional vacancies across multiple domains including Projects, Project Management, IS & IT, Computer Lab/Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, Production/Manufacturing, HR, Marketing, Finance and Hindi Cell. The posts are further classified as Young Professional – Graduate, Young Professional – Technician, Young Professional – Operator, YP Generalist (HR/Marketing/Finance) and YP – Official Language, with domain-wise distribution as given below.

Young Professional Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for the Young Professional posts must ensure that they fulfil the required eligibility criteria in terms of educational qualification, relevant experience and age as prescribed by ITI Limited in the notification. Only Indian Nationals with qualifications from recognized universities/institutes (AICTE/UGC/other statutory authorities) are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various Young Professional categories and domains are summarised below.

For YP – Graduate (Projects):
BE/B.Tech in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil or MCA/M.Sc. (Electronics/CS/IT) from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Technician (Projects):
Diploma in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Projects):
ITI Trade Certificate in EC/CS/Mechanical/IT/EEE/Civil from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Graduate (Project Management):
MBA in Project Management/Operations Management or M.Sc. in Project Management from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Graduate (IS & IT):
Essential: BE/B.Tech in IT/CS/ECE/EEE or MCA/M.Sc. (IT/CS) from a recognised University/Institute; desirable skills include proficiency in PHP/Python/Java, HTML/CSS/JS, MySQL/PostgreSQL and Linux server environment.

For YP – Technician (IS & IT):
Essential: B.Sc (IT)/BCA/Diploma in CS from a recognised University/Institute; desirable knowledge of network fundamentals, VPN, firewall basics, Linux/Windows systems and end-user support.

For YP – Graduate (Comp. Lab):
BE/B.Tech in IT/CS from a recognised University/Institute.

For Comp. Lab/Production (Graduate/Technician roles):
- B.Sc in Chemistry or Diploma in Chemical Engineering with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience in conformal coating, OR Diploma in CS/Electronics with minimum 2 years’ experience in testing/measurement systems as specified.

For YP – Operator (Computer Lab/Production):
ITI Trade Certificate in Electronics/Electronic Mechanic with minimum 2 years’ experience and VSSC Soldering School certification; or ITI Fitter with minimum 2 years’ relevant experience.

For YP – Graduate (TSTL):
BE/B.Tech in ECE/CS/Telecommunications or MCA/M.Sc.(CS/IT)/M.Sc. Cybersecurity from a recognised University/Institute with minimum 2–5 years post-qualification experience (depending on slot) and industry-recognised certifications in IT/Telecom Security Testing desirable.

For YP – Technician (Production/Manufacturing):
Diploma in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Operator (Production/Manufacturing):
ITI Trade Certificate in CS/ECE/EEE/Civil/Mechanical/Fitter from a recognised Institute.

For YP – Generalist (HR):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Graduate (Marketing):
Any Degree with MBA in Marketing from a recognised University/Institute.

For YP – Generalist (Marketing):
BBA/BBM/BMS from a recognised University/Institute with knowledge of computer.

For YP – Generalist (Finance):
Any Degree from a recognised University with mandatory knowledge of computer and applications.

For YP – Official Language (Hindi Cell):
Any degree from recognised University with Hindi as subject and English as medium of examination, OR any degree with English as subject and Hindi as medium, OR any degree with Hindi and English as elective/optional subjects.

Age Limit 

Candidates applying for Young Professional posts must satisfy the prescribed upper age limits as on the date of advertisement, with relaxations for internal candidates as per ITI rules. Internal candidates with relevant experience are eligible for age relaxation up to a maximum of 45 years, while general upper age limit for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist is indicated as 35 years in Table-A.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Young Professional Application Fee 2026

ITI Limited’s Young Professional 2026 notification does not explicitly mention any application fee for the recruitment. Candidates should refer to the latest instructions on the official website to confirm whether any fee is applicable before submission.

ITI Young Professional Salary 2025-26

Candidates selected as Young Professionals in ITI Limited will receive consolidated monthly remuneration as per Table-A of the notification without additional allowances like DA, accommodation, medical reimbursement etc. In case of posting in tough locations, Young Professionals will be entitled to benefits under ITI’s Tough Location Policy in addition to the consolidated pay.

  • Contract initially for 1 year, extendable yearly up to 3 years subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Young Professionals are engaged on a purely temporary, non-official basis with independent consultant legal status vis-à-vis ITI Limited.

How to Apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 through the official website within the specified timeline. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted and incomplete applications are liable to be rejected.

  1. Visit the official website of ITI Limited: www.itiltd.in.
  2. Go to the “Careers” or “Career” section and open the relevant Young Professional 2026 notification (Ref. No. ITI/CRP/HR/2025/1534 dated 22-12-2025).
  3. Read the detailed notification carefully including eligibility, vacancies, service conditions and selection process.
  4. Click on the application link / application format available under the notification and start filling the online form.
  5. Enter personal details, educational qualifications, experience details, and select your preferred initial posting locations as per instructions.
  6. Provide a valid email ID and mobile number as all important communication will be sent through email only.
  7. Upload required documents/certificates in legible form as per the prescribed format and size.
  8. Verify all details carefully before final submission; only the latest application will be considered if multiple are submitted.
  9. Submit the online application on or before 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).
  10. Keep a copy/print of the submitted application and email acknowledgements for future reference.

Official Notification PDF: Available on www.cochinshipyard.in > Career > UCSL (Malpe) and www.udupicsl.com > Career Page
Apply Online (NATS): https://nats.education.gov.in
Official Website (UCSL): www.udupicsl.com

Important Instructions for Apprentice Recruitment 2025

  • Ensure that all eligibility conditions, including qualification, age, domicile and previous apprenticeship status, are satisfied before submitting the application.
  • Make sure marks and other details are entered correctly; any mismatch with uploaded mark sheets may lead to summary rejection.
  • No application fee is required, but applications must be submitted within the prescribed dates through the NATS portal only.
  • Call letters for certificate verification will not be sent by post; candidates must regularly check their registered email ID and the UCSL/CSL websites for updates.
  • Submission of application will be treated as unconditional acceptance of all terms and conditions mentioned in the vacancy notification.
  • Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973 in any organisation are not eligible to apply.
  • Upon completion of apprenticeship period, UCSL has no obligation to offer employment and apprentices cannot claim right to employment on this basis.
  • Any suppression of facts or furnishing of false information at any stage will lead to cancellation/rejection of candidature without further notice.
  • All legal proceedings related to this selection will fall under the jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals at Udupi only.
  • Any amendment, modification or addition to the advertisement will be published only on CSL/UCSL websites.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online through the NATS portal is 21.01.2026.

Q2. What is the age limit for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A2. Candidates must be above 18 years of age as on 22 December 2025, with upper age relaxation applicable as per Government of India apprenticeship rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A3. A total of 5 apprenticeship seats are available, including 3 Graduate Apprentices (Mechanical) and 2 Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Electrical).

Q4. What is the selection process for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through shortlisting and certificate verification in the order of merit and reservation, followed by medical fitness; no written test or interview has been mentioned.

Q5. What is the application fee for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A5. There is no application fee (Nil) for all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, PwBD and female candidates.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the UCSL Apprentice exam?
A6. No written examination is specified in the notification, so negative marking is not applicable.

Q7. Can I edit my application form after submission?
A7. The notification does not mention a separate correction window; candidates should fill the NATS application carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the stipend for UCSL Apprentices?
A8. Graduate Apprentices receive Rs. 15,000 per month plus meals allowance, while Technician (Diploma) Apprentices receive Rs. 13,200 per month plus meals allowance during training.

Q9. Is domicile of Karnataka mandatory for this recruitment?
A9. Yes, the notification clearly states that only candidates who are domicile of Karnataka are eligible for selection.

Q10. Where will the apprenticeship training be conducted?
A10. The apprenticeship training will be conducted at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe in Karnataka State.

Disclaimer: Candidates must refer to the original UCSL notification and the official websites of UCSL/CSL and NATS for any subsequent updates or changes before applying.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Chief General Manager (Digital Transformation): Full-time First Class Degree in Engineering (Preferably Computer Science, IT, Electronics & Communication) from a recognized University/Institution. PG Degree/Diploma in Management/MBA will have added advantage.
  • General Manager (Construction Equipment): Full-time First Class Degree in Engineering in Mechanical/Automobile from a recognized University/Institution. PG Degree/Diploma in Management/MBA will have added advantage.
  • Deputy General Manager (Engine Assembly): First Class Degree in Mechanical/Thermal/Automobile Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.

  • Assistant Manager (R&D Maritime): First Class Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Naval Architecture/Ocean Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
  • Officer/Assistant Manager (Security): Graduate in any Discipline from a recognized university/institution with specified training qualifications from Defence Forces or Police/Intelligence training institutions or NCC-C Certificate with 2 years security experience.
  • Assistant Manager/Manager (Raj Bhasha): First Class full-time Master's Degree in Hindi or its equivalent from any recognized university with English as a subject at the Degree Level. Preference will be given to those having Ph.D. in Hindi.
  • Assistant Manager (Paediatrician): Degree in MBBS along with DCH/MD/DNB (Paediatrics) from MCI recognized Institute/College.
  • Assistant Manager (General Physician): Degree in MBBS along with MD/DNB (General Medicine) from MCI recognized Institution/College.
  • Officer (Medical): MBBS graduate from MCI recognized Institution/College.
  • Consultant (Physician): MBBS graduate with MD/DNB (General Medicine) from MCI recognized Institution/College.
  • Consultant (Dermatologist): MBBS graduate with MD/DNB/Diploma (Dermatology) from MCI recognized Institution/College.

Essential Qualifications:

  • First class is reckoned at 60% (as an aggregate of marks of all Semesters/years)
  • Qualifying marks are relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD candidates
  • Candidates with CGPA/Credit have to mandatorily provide the conversion to percentage

Experience:

  • Chief General Manager: Minimum 21 years of professional experience, out of which last 10 years must be in organization of repute handling IT projects & infrastructure requirements
  • General Manager: Minimum 19 years of professional experience in manufacturing/marketing of construction equipment or heavy machinery industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
  • Deputy General Manager: Minimum 16 years of post qualification experience in Diesel Engine Assembly Area
  • Engineer (Tooling): Minimum 2 years of post qualification experience in Tool Engineering
  • Assistant Manager (Tooling): Minimum 4 years of post qualification experience in Tool Engineering
  • Assistant Manager (Maritime): Minimum 4 years of post qualification experience in Design of Ships/Submarines/Dredgers/Warships
  • Officer (Security): Minimum 2 years of post qualification experience
  • Assistant Manager (Security): Minimum 4 years of post qualification experience
  • Assistant Manager (Raj Bhasha): Minimum 4 years of post qualification professional experience in terminological work in Hindi and/or translation work
  • Manager (Raj Bhasha): Minimum 8 years of post qualification professional experience in terminological work in Hindi and/or translation work
  • Assistant Manager (Paediatrician/General Physician): Fresher or Experienced personnel
  • Officer (Medical): Minimum 2 years experience in General OPD or specialty OPDs
  • Consultant Positions: Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in relevant domain (except ENT Surgeon which can be fresher or with 3 years experience)

Desirable:

  • Digital Transformation: Knowledge in implementation of AI/ML, IIoT, IR4.0 & S/4 HANA. Familiarity with Govt e-procurement, GEM and other platforms
  • Engine Assembly: Knowledge and experience in Engine Component manufacturing, Engine testing, optimization, engineering materials & manufacturing processes
  • Maritime: Proficiency in Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) tool, specialized software like SIEMENS NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS, ALTAIR HYPERWORKS and other FEA tools, IMO conventions, SOLAS, MARPOL, classification society rules
  • Raj Bhasha: Experience in translation of technical or scientific literature

Salary/Stipend

  • Grade-II (Officer/Engineer): Rs. 40,000 – Rs. 1,40,000 per month
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager): Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000 per month
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager Medical): Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000 per month
  • Grade-IV (Manager): Rs. 60,000 – Rs. 1,80,000 per month
  • Grade-VII (Deputy General Manager): Rs. 90,000 – Rs. 2,40,000 per month
  • Grade-VIII (General Manager): Rs. 1,00,000 – Rs. 2,60,000 per month
  • Grade-IX (Chief General Manager): Rs. 1,20,000 – Rs. 2,80,000 per month
  • Besides Basic Pay, candidates will be eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of the applicable Basic Pay under the Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per the prevailing Company Rules
  • The pay fixation will be guided by the extant rules of BEML Limited, applicable at the time of issuance of Offer of appointment

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Grade-II (Officer/Engineer): Maximum 29 years
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager): Maximum 30 years
  • Grade-III (Assistant Manager Medical): Maximum 30 years
  • Grade-IV (Manager): Maximum 34 years
  • Grade-VII (Deputy General Manager): Maximum 45 years
  • Grade-VIII (General Manager): Maximum 48 years
  • Grade-IX (Chief General Manager): Maximum 51 years
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC-NCL candidates

  • The upper age limit can be relaxed (for candidates under all category) subject to equivalent years of excess post qualification experience prescribed. However, the maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years
  • For Security positions (107/108), relaxation in age limit for Ex-servicemen will be extended as per rules. The upper age limit for ESMs with all relaxations shall not exceed 45 years as on 31.12.2025

Application Fee

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: Rs. 500/- (Non-refundable)
  • SC/ST/PwD Candidates: No application fee
  • Payment to be made online by clicking "Pay Application Fee Online" at the end of the application form

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 26/11/2025
Online Application Start Date 26/11/2025
Last Date for Online Application 31/12/2025 (Till 6:00 PM)
Last Date for Submission through Proper Channel (Govt/PSU Employees) Within 10 days from closing date
Age/Qualification/Experience Criteria Date 31/12/2025

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for assessment/interview
  • Assessment will be conducted to evaluate technical competency and suitability for the position
  • Selected candidates will undergo pre-employment medical examination
  • Original document verification will be conducted
  • Appointment is subject to meeting the medical standard of the Company and receipt of satisfactory medical report from the Company Medical Officer
  • Management reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates and increase the qualifying percentage based on number of applications received
  • The list of shortlisted/selected candidates for final selection will be uploaded on Company's website

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply
  • Candidates shall apply for single position which is most suitable. In case of multiple applications, only the most relevant application will be considered
  • SC/ST candidates are required to submit SC/ST Caste Certificate in the format as applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India
  • OBC candidates are required to submit Other Backward Class Certificate (Non-Creamy Layer) in the format applicable for Government of India appointments. OBC certificate should not be older than six months as on the last date of application submission
  • PwD candidates are required to submit PwD Certificate in the format as applicable for appointment to posts under Government of India
  • Candidates seeking reservations under EWS are required to submit income & assets certificate in the applicable format
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government, Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Government and PSU should send the print out of online application through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" specific to the position applied for
  • Private sector candidates applying for Chief General Manager and General Manager must be employed in a regular capacity where the annual turnover of the Company has to be Rs. 1000 crore or more
  • Private sector candidates must be employed in a regular capacity and will be required to submit experience certificate on Company Letter Head at the time of interview
  • Experienced candidates are required to provide details (a pen picture) of each experience in the Application Form
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria and that the particulars furnished are correct. In case of any incorrect/false information, candidature shall stand automatically cancelled
  • Merely meeting the conditions of the advertisement will not automatically entitle candidates to be called for assessment
  • Management reserves the right to cancel the advertisement in full or in part and/or the selection process at its discretion
  • Management reserves the right to increase/decrease the vacancies based on Business requirements and availability of qualified candidates
  • Management reserves the right to convert the position into contract engagement, if necessitated
  • Intimation regarding Assessments, issuance of provisional offer/final offer etc., will be sent only through e-mail
  • The e-mail id and mobile number provided in online application should remain valid for at least one year
  • Any request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, etc., as declared in the online application will not be entertained
  • Any sort of canvassing or influencing of the officials related to recruitment/selection process would result in immediate disqualification of the candidates

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE only through the official website www.bemlindia.in
  • Access the online application form in the career page at www.bemlindia.in
  • The online registration site will be available till 18:00 Hrs on 31st December 2025
  • Candidates should have a valid e-mail and mobile number for Registration
  • Fill in all the required details carefully in the online application form
  • Note the Registration number generated for all future correspondences
  • While filling the online application, the experience section should be filled by providing latest experience first followed by previous experiences
  • In the space provided against the experience, write a pen picture of the experience relevant to the position applied
  • Upload the following documents (mandatory):
    • 10th Marks card
    • 12th Marks card
    • Qualifying Degree Marks cards (with CGPA conversion formula if applicable)
    • Post-Graduation Marks cards and Certificate (as applicable)
    • Identity card issued by Government of India (Aadhar, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card, etc.)
    • Detailed Resume
    • OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwD certificate (as applicable)
    • All Experience Certificates/Documents clearly indicating start & end dates of each employment
    • Latest pay-slip
    • Current reporting structure (for DGM/GM/CGM positions)
    • Company credentials proving average turnover (for GM & CGM positions)
    • Recent photograph
    • Signature (on clear white background in black ink)
  • Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online (if applicable) by clicking "Pay Application Fee Online"
  • Submit the completed application form online before the last date
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference
  • Incomplete applications without uploading required documents will be summarily rejected
  • For any queries, candidates may email: [email protected]

        • AI / ML / Data Science (DS)
        • Mechanical Engineering
    • Essential Qualification – PAT-II (any one):
      • B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in above areas with 2 years’ experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities/services.

    • Desirable:
      • Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with ML libraries (e.g. PyTorch).
      • Hands-on experience with sensor-based data sources (LiDAR, camera, stereo etc.) on autonomous vehicles/ADAS.
      • Familiarity with Reinforcement Learning and Computer Vision techniques; knowledge of simulators like CARLA.
      • Experience in setting up and analysing experiments for ML/RL; familiarity with version control (Git).
      • At least one peer-reviewed publication in AI/ML/CV/NLP; CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship) / GATE qualified; MS (by Research)/BS & MS (Dual Degree) desirable.
    • Job Description:
      • Running experiments in RL simulators and real vehicles, benchmarking, dataset generation.
      • Field work for data collection on autonomous vehicle platforms.
      • Writing reports, presentations, documentation, research articles and any other project-assigned work.

    • Rs. 28,000/- + HRA for others.
  • Project Associate-I (PAT-I):
    • Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE or equivalent qualified candidates.
    • Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

NMPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

One post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay of Rs. 100000-260000 in New Mangalore Port Authority will be vacant with effect from June 1, 2026. The post is to be filled by absorption through a composite method from officers of Major Ports.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Essential):
    • Degree or equivalent in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institution.
    • Fifteen years experience in executive cadre in Planning/Construction/Design/Maintenance preferably of Port and Marine Structures in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking.
  • For absorption through composite method: Officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs. 80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department in a Major Port Trust shall be eligible. The feeder post is Deputy Chief Engineer in the pay scale of Rs.80000-220000/-.

Salary/Stipend

  • Initial Scale of Pay: Rs. 100000-260000.
  • Note: The pay scale will be upgraded to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000/- after completion of three years regular service in the post, subject to fulfilling relevant conditions.

Age Limit (as on 01 June 2026)

  • There is 45 upper age limit specified for candidates applying via the absorption through composite method.
  • The crucial date for eligibility criteria will be the date of arising of the vacancy, i.e., June 1, 2026.

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit, for which the benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports/APARs will not be below "Very Good" for the last five years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025).
  • Selection is made by the Services Selection Committee.
  • Port officials who withdraw their candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Ports for a period of two years.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only applications submitted through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) shall be accepted.
  • No application other than those submitted through OAP shall be accepted.
  • The administrative Ports are required to forward the hard copy applications with required documents (certified APARs, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance, NOC, etc.) to NMPA by January 30, 2026.
  • Incomplete applications or those received after the due date will not be considered.

How To Apply

  • Register and apply online through the 'online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at `https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in` between December 16, 2025, and January 15, 2026.
  • Take a print-out of the online application form uploaded in OAP.
  • The print-out should be signed and sent through the proper channel (via the administrative Port Authority Secretary/Chairperson) along with certified copies of educational qualifications, experience, PPOs, and attested APARs for the last 5 years.
  • The envelope containing the hard copy must be superscribed "Application for the post of Chief Engineer (Civil) in New Mangalore Port Authority".
  • The hard copy must reach The Secretary, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore - 575 010 before January 30, 2026.

Non-Executive Selection Process 2025

The IOCL Non-Executive selection is based on shortlisting candidates through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT). The CBT assesses the candidate’s technical knowledge in the relevant discipline along with numerical ability and general awareness, and only those who secure minimum qualifying marks are called for SPPT. Final selection is based on refinery-wise merit list drawn from CBT scores among candidates who qualify SPPT and meet all eligibility and document verification requirements.

The Non-Executive selection process is carried out in two main stages, as explained below:

1. Computer Based Test (CBT):
The CBT consists of 100 objective multiple-choice questions of 1 mark each, to be completed in 120 minutes, with sections on Subject Knowledge (75 marks), Numerical Ability (15 marks) and General Awareness (10 marks), conducted in English and Hindi without negative marking. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in CBT (35% for SC/ST/PwBD against reserved posts) to qualify for shortlisting for SPPT, and in case CBT is held in multiple sessions, scores are equated to account for difficulty level differences.

2. Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test (SPPT):
Shortlisted candidates in a ratio of 1:2 (post and category-wise) based on CBT and document scrutiny are called for SPPT, which is qualifying in nature and assesses the required skills, proficiency and physical standards, especially for technical and Fire & Safety posts. Only candidates who qualify SPPT as per IOCL standards and are medically fit will be considered in the final refinery-wise merit list prepared solely on CBT marks, with tie-breaking done on date of birth (senior in age preferred).

Final Merit: Final merit is based only on Computer Based Test scores (subject to qualifying SPPT), prepared refinery-wise, discipline-wise and category-wise, and candidates availing relaxations are considered against reserved vacancies as per Government norms.

Advertisement

Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Recruitment 2026 for 04 posts of Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator, Research Assistant and More. Candidates with BDS, B.Pharma, B.Sc, MBBS, BAMS, BHMS, M.Sc, MSW Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in on 09-01-2026. For detailed information please visit SMCofficial website, suratmunicipal.gov.in.

SMIMER Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator, Research Assistant and More Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research (SMIMER)
Post Name Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator, Research Assistant, Field Investigators
No of Posts 4
Salary Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 50,000/-
Qualification B.Sc. with working knowledge of computer, MBBS / BDS / BAMS / BHMS / M.Sc. in any of the Life Science subjects, B.Sc. Nursing / BPH / B.Pharm / MSW / B.Sc. Medical Science
Age Limit Not more than 30 to 40 years
Walk in Date 09-01-2026
Official Website suratmunicipal.gov.in

SMIMER Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator, Research Assistant and More Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name No of Posts
Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator 01
Research Assistant 01
Field Investigators 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator: B.Sc. with working knowledge of computer
  • Essential Qualifications: Science Graduation from a recognized university
  • Experience: Experience of handling computers and "CCC" certificate
  • Desirable: Data entry and data evaluation experience, Data handling experience, Preference will be given to those having experience in ICMR /DHR/CSIR /DBT projects/any other equivalent project in medical colleges/institutes
  • Research Assistant: MBBS / BDS / BAMS / BHMS / M.Sc. in any of the Life Science subjects
  • Experience: minimum of 2 years experience of working in the research field
  • Desirable: ICMR/DHR-funded research projects related to healthcare costing
  • Field Investigator: B.Sc. Nursing / BPH / B.Pharm / MSW / B.Sc. Medical Science

Salary/Stipend

  • Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator: Rs. 20,000/-
  • Research Assistant: Rs. 50,000 /- (Consolidated)
  • Field Investigator: Rs. 35,000 /- (Consolidated)

Age Limit

  • Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator: Not more than 30 years
  • Research Assistant: Up to 40 years
  • Field Investigator: Up to 40 years

Important Dates

Details Date
Notification Date 24/12/2025
Walk-in-Interview Date and Time 09/01/2026 at 9:00 am

Selection Process

  • Screening test will be conducted to shortlist eligible candidates for appearing in the interview
  • In case the number of Eligible candidates appear in the walking interview are more than 5 time the number of vacancy for each post, written MCQ test related to the subject matter will be conducted. Based on the score obtained, a merit list will be prepared. Interview of only top scorers (5 Times the no. of vacancy) will be conducted
  • Original documents will be verified before interview
  • Selection committee is the final authority in selecting the candidates and altering the number of vacancies

General Information/Instructions

  • The terms and conditions of staff to be employed in MRU SMIMER will be as per guidelines implementation of MRU scheme in Government medical colleges as stipulated by Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Govt. of India
  • The candidates are instructed to register their names before 9.30 am on the day of interview
  • Qualification & Pay: As per notification and guidelines of MRU scheme Department of Health Research, MoHFW, Govt. of India
  • The appointments shall on contract basis on monthly consolidated remuneration
  • The period of appointment is for 11 month for Laboratory Assistant cum Data Entry Operator and for 6 month, extendable to another 6 Months based on performance for Research Assistant and Field Investigator
  • Candidates working in Government sector/ Government Autonomous Medical colleges must produce “No Objection Certificate” from Head of the institution/Competent Authority in which the candidate is presently working
  • No TA DA will be paid to the Candidates for attending walk-in interview
  • The work may required travelling outside city and overnight stay for Research Assistant and Field Investigator
  • Above post is temporary in nature and will be filled up purely on contractual basis with initial appointments for Eleven (11) months as per rules and regulations of the MRU. The employment on this post will be temporary, for a fixed term and shall automatically cease on expiry of term without any notice unless renewed or reemployment letter issued
  • If the performance of the candidate is not satisfactory during any part of the tenure, the services of the candidate may be terminated with a notice period of 1 month. In case the candidate wishes to leave the contract, they may choose to do so with a notice period of 1 month
  • The appointment is purely on temporary basis and can be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice. The Controlling Authority, however, reserves the right to terminate the services of the appointee forthwith or before the expiry of notice period by making payment to the appointee of the consolidated salary for a period of notice or the un-expired portion thereof. The appointee cannot, however, surrender stipend/consolidated salary in lieu of the period of notice or un-expired portion thereof and may be required to serve the full period of notice
  • Applicable Govt. taxes are liable to be deducted from contractual candidate's monthly consolidated pay
  • Candidate has to perform all duties and work given by his/her higher authorities without fail with full sincerity and dedication
  • The appointee will have to work for a minimum period of one month. If he/she resigns before the stipulated period, he/she will have to refund the entire amount of salary/stipend received forthwith before being relieved. After one month's period, the appointee has to submit one month's prior notice for resignation/termination
  • The appointee will not be treated as an employee of the SMIMER, Surat or DHR/ICMR, New Delhi. The appointee will not have any claim on a regular post in this Institute or in any Dept. of Govt. of India. The appointee shall give an undertaking to this effect before joining the post
  • The appointee will be under the Administrative control of SMIMER, Surat and will be subject to all the rules and regulations of the Institute during tenure of the appointment. If there is any periodic amendment in guidelines from DHR regarding any component of scheme it will be applicable as per the guidelines issued by the Department of Health Research (DHR) of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
  • The appointee is not entitled for Medical aid, Bonus or any other such facilities extended to the regular staff of the Institute
  • He/ She shall be entitled for eleven (11) casual leaves and 1 sectional off for a period of eleven months. He / She shall be entitled for all public holidays which other staff of SMIMER are entitled for; other than that no leave shall be granted to him/her. He / She shall have to obtain written permission in advance from the Dean, SMIMER before proceeding for such leave
  • In regard to any disputes regarding service terms and conditions Dean, SMIMER, Surat decision will be final authority. All dispute matters will be under Surat city jurisdictions

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may appear for walk-in-interview with their application along with requisite documents to D-Block, Surat Municipal Institute of Medical Education & Research (SMIMER), Opp. Bombay Market, Umarwada, Surat-395010, Gujarat
  • The Application forms and details regarding appointment are available on following websites: http://smimer.suratmunicipal.gov.in. & www.suratmunicipal.gov.in

IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts
Junior Research Fellow 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • M.Sc. or BS-MS in Chemistry from a reputed institute in India.
  • Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onwards.
  • Minimum 55% or equivalent in class 10th and 12th.
  • GATE or CSIR-UGC NET qualification.
  • Good knowledge of Inorganic and organometallic chemistry (desirable).
  • Some experience in synthetic chemistry (desirable).
  • Good communication skills (desirable).

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration: Rs. 37,000/- per month.
  • HRA is admissible if campus accommodation is not availed.
  • The appointment is initially for one year, with the possibility of extension or conversion to a PhD position based on performance.

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of candidates based on applications and submitted documents.
  • Selection based on an online interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email regarding the date and time of the interview.

How To Apply

  • Prepare a detailed CV indicating academic track record and awards received.
  • Attach a scanned copy of the M.Sc./BS-MS certificate.
  • Attach a recommendation letter.
  • Combine the application and all required documents into a single PDF file.
  • Send the PDF file by email to Prof. Priyabrata Ghana at [email protected].
  • Ensure that the application reaches on or before 31st December 2025 or before the position is filled.

Important Dates

Event Date
Application starting Immediate (advertisement for an immediate opening)
Last date for application submission 31st December 2025 or until the position is filled

Instructions

  • The position is in the Main Group Organometallic Chemistry Lab at IIT Gandhinagar headed by Prof. Priyabrata Ghana.
  • The appointment is for one year in the project funded by Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF).
  • The position may be converted to a PhD position or extended up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • The candidate will work on designing and synthesizing low-valent transition metal complexes for catalytic conversion of small molecules (e.g., N2, NH3, H2, CO, CO2, ethylene) into value-added chemicals.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the online interview.

NFSU Various Non-Academic Positions 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for NFSU Recruitment 2025 is 28 posts, distributed across Non-Academic and Library Cadre positions as follows:

Post Name Total Posts

Library Assistant 3

Academic Pay. PwBD reservation is horizontal and adjusted against respective categories.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility varies by position, encompassing educational qualifications, age limits, and experience requirements.

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Deputy Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 9 years experience as Assistant Professor (Level 10+) or 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 3 years experience in relevant university fields (Procurement/HR/Academics/Accounts/Examinations).
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering (55%) (Master's preferred), plus 2 years relevant experience.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical): Bachelor’s in Civil/Electrical Engineering (55%). Master’s degree is desirable.
  • Statistical Assistant: Bachelor Degree with Statistics as a special subject.
  • Assistant Librarian: Master’s Degree in Library Science (55%), consistently good academic record, and must have cleared UGC NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D. as per regulations.
  • Library Assistant: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent, typing speed 30 wpm in English, and computer knowledge.

2. Age Limit

Age is determined as of the closing date of application:

  • Deputy Registrar: Not more than 50 years.
  • Assistant Registrar / Deputy Engineer (Civil) / Assistant Librarian: Not more than 40 years.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) / Statistical Assistant: 21 to 35 years.
  • Library Assistant: Not more than 32 years.

Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules. The upper age limit is not applicable to existing government/university employees.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be citizens of India.

Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable:

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: ₹500/- + GST & transaction charges.
  • SC/ST Category, PwBD, and Women candidates: Exempted from paying the application fee.

Salary/Stipend

Posts fall under the 7th Pay Matrix system. Based on general Government of India norms for these levels, the approximate starting basic pay ranges are:

  • Deputy Registrar (Level 12): Basic Pay approx. ₹78,800 per month.
  • Assistant Registrar / Assistant Librarian (Level 10 / Academic Level 10): Basic Pay approx. ₹56,100 per month.
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil) (Level 9): Basic Pay approx. ₹53,100 per month.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) (Level 8): Basic Pay approx. ₹47,600 per month.
  • Statistical Assistant (Level 5): Basic Pay approx. ₹29,200 per month.
  • Library Assistant (Level 4): Basic Pay approx. ₹25,500 per month.

Selected candidates will receive basic pay within the respective pay matrix level, plus other admissible allowances as per government norms.
