  • Competitive Written Examination consists of one paper. The Final merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by the candidates in this paper.

General Information/Instructions

  • These posts carry usual allowances i.e. Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) etc., as admissible to the Central Government employees and as made applicable to CSIR employees at the place of posting. Council employees are also entitled to accommodation according to the CSIR Residence Allotment Rules, subject to availability. If council or government accommodation is utilized, HRA will not be provided.
  • In addition to the emoluments, benefits such as reimbursement of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession and Children’s Education Allowances etc. are also available as per CSIR/Govt. of India (GoI) Rules as applicable to the Council servants.
  • All New Entrants will be governed by the “National Pension System” based on defined Contributions for new entrants, as adopted by CSIR for its employees.

The duly constituted Screening Committee will adopt its own criteria for short-listing the candidates. The candidate should, therefore, mention in the application all qualifications and experience in relevant areas over and above the minimum prescribed qualification, supported with documents.

Candidates will be allowed to take the written examination / trade test only in the medium they have opted for. If any candidate does not indicate the medium, the option will be deemed to be for English medium. The Choice of medium given by the candidates in the Online Application Form shall be applicable for written examination / trade test and treated as final, and no change in the medium will be entertained.
  • The screening of candidates will be conducted on the basis of the documents and information provided in the online application only.   2. Register by providing your name, contact details, and email ID to receive a Provisional Registration Number and Password. Use the Save and Next facility if you need to complete the form later.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational, and other details accurately in the application form. Verify all information before proceeding to upload documents.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration following the guidelines provided. Ensure all uploads meet the size and format requirements.
  5. Proceed to the payment section if applicable, and make the fee payment using Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or other modes. Wait for confirmation and generate the e-Receipt.
  6. Review the entire application in the Preview tab and make any necessary changes. Click on Final Submit only after ensuring all details are correct.
  7. Download and print the application form and e-Receipt for your records. Keep your registration details safe for future reference.
  8. Monitor your email and the MOIL website for updates on admit cards, test dates, and further instructions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

Essential Qualifications

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

Credit Officer Selection Process 2025-26

The Credit Officer selection is based on shortlisting candidates through an online examination and/or direct shortlisting followed by a personal interview. The screening focuses on assessing the candidate's reasoning, quantitative aptitude and professional knowledge in their selected discipline in addition to English language. Only those who qualify in the screening stage and rank sufficiently high in merit are invited for the interview.

The selection process is carried out in main stages as explained below.

1. Scrutiny and Shortlisting of Applications: Applications are shortlisted on the basis of documents uploaded in support of eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, category, etc.) at the time of registration. Only candidates whose documents clearly establish eligibility are taken forward for the online test and/or interview.

2. Online Examination:

  • Mode: Online objective test.
  • Structure: English Language (25 questions, 25 marks), Reasoning (25 questions, 25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 25 marks), Professional Knowledge relevant to the post (75 questions, 75 marks); total 150 questions for 150 marks, composite time of 120 minutes.
  • Language: All tests except English are bilingual (English & Hindi); English Language test is only qualifying and its marks are not added in merit.
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum 35% in each test for General/EWS; SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get 5% relaxation.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4th of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for every wrong answer; no penalty for unanswered questions.

3. Interview: Candidates who secure the minimum qualifying marks in the online tests and rank high in order of merit (category-wise) are called for a personal interview, generally in the ratio of about 1:3 to the number of vacancies. The interview carries 100 marks with minimum qualifying marks of 50% for General/EWS and 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates.

Final Merit: If both online exam and interview are conducted, final merit is prepared by combining scores of online examination (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude and Professional Knowledge) and interview in a 70:30 ratio, subject to candidates qualifying in both stages. If the online exam is not conducted, selection will be based solely on interview marks in descending order of merit up to the number of vacancies.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A1. The last date to submit the online application is 12-01-2026 up to 23:59 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A2. The general upper age limit indicated is 35 years for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist, while internal candidates with relevant experience get relaxation up to a maximum of 45 years; detailed category-wise relaxation follows ITI/Government rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A3. A total of 215 Young Professional vacancies have been announced across various domains and posts.

Q4. What is the selection process for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A4. Selection for Young Professional – Graduates is through a two-stage process: shortlisting using a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Young Professional – Technicians & Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test.

Q5. What is the application fee for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A5. The notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment; candidates should check the official website for any further updates.

Q6. What is the salary of ITI Young Professional?
A6. Young Professional – Graduate receive Rs. 60,000 per month, Young Professional – Technician/Generalist/Official Language receive Rs. 35,000 per month, and Young Professional – Operator receive Rs. 30,000 per month as consolidated pay.

Q7. Is this a permanent job in ITI Limited?
A7. No, Young Professionals are engaged on a purely temporary/contract basis initially for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years based on performance, with no obligation on ITI to offer regular employment.

Q8. What are the main posting locations for ITI Young Professional 2026?
A8. Posting locations include ITI units at Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini, Palakkad, Rae Bareli and multiple project/marketing locations such as Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ahmedabad and North Eastern states, subject to company requirements.

Q9. What is the job nature and working hours for Young Professionals?
A9. Young Professionals are engaged full time to provide professional services in specific spheres and will follow the same working hours as ITI employees; no extra remuneration is paid for work beyond office hours or on holidays.

Q10. Where can I contact ITI Limited in case of technical issues with the application?
A10. For any queries or technical issues related to the online application, candidates can email at [email protected] as mentioned in the notification.

  • For Trauma & Emergency (#), eligibility includes MD in Emergency Medicine or MD in General Medicine or MS in General Surgery or MD in Anaesthesiology or MD in Respiratory Medicine or MS in Orthopaedics or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Resident is in Group ‘A’ with pay Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable).

Age Limit (as on 07-01-2026)

  • Upper age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years as on the closing date 07/01/2026.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates; no age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies.
  • For Persons with Disability (PwD) candidates, age relaxation is up to 5 years for General, 8 years for OBC and 10 years for SC/ST categories.
  • 4% of the total posts are horizontally reserved for PwD candidates with benchmark disability as per Reservation Rules and RPwD Act/DoPT instructions.

Application Fee

  • For General/EWS/OBC Category: Rs. 500/-.
  • For SC/ST Category: Rs. 250/-.
  • Application fee for PwD category is exempted.
  • Candidates must pay the fee through NEFT into AIIMS EXAM FEE account (Bank of Baroda, AIIMS Nagpur Campus Branch, Account No. 40680200000276, IFSC: BARB0VJNAAP, MICR code 440012015).
  • The transaction reference number and date of transaction should be mentioned in the application form.
  • The application fee is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Notification Date 08/12/2025
Opening Date for Application 08/12/2025
Closing Date for Application (Google Form submission) 07/01/2026 up to 5 PM
Age reckoning date 07/01/2026 (age will be counted as on closing date of receipt of application)
Interview Date To be notified on AIIMS Nagpur website; may be spilled over to next day, so candidates should be prepared accordingly.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made on the basis of interview conducted at AIIMS Nagpur.
  • The date of interview will be notified on the AIIMS Nagpur website, and the decision of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur in this regard shall be final and binding.
  • The interview may be spilled over to the next day; therefore candidates should be prepared to be available for the next day if necessary.
  • In case a large number of applications are received, shortlisting of candidates for interview will be done based on qualification, additional qualification, experience etc., or through a written test.
  • Offer of appointment will be provisional and subject to verification of educational and personal credentials by the competent authority.

General Information/Instructions

  • Age will be counted as on the closing date of receipt of application i.e. 07/01/2026, and age limit refers to completed age in years on that date.
  • Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation; the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur reserves the right to vary vacancies including reserved vacancies as per Government of India rules and requirements.
  • Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi Government/Autonomous Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Self-attested photocopies of degrees, certificates, mark sheets, age proof, caste certificates etc. must be annexed and originals produced with photocopies for verification at the time of interview.
  • Valid NCL-OBC certificate issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026 in the prescribed format and valid for Central Government employment is mandatory for OBC candidates; OBC certificate must clearly mention non-creamy layer status and match Central OBC List.
  • EWS candidates must submit Income and Assets certificate in prescribed format issued by competent authority, with crucial date being the closing date for receipt of application.
  • 4% horizontal reservation is applicable for PwD candidates with benchmark disability as per rules; disability certificate must be issued by a duly constituted Medical Board and countersigned by Medical Superintendent, with board comprising consultants from Orthopaedics, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation and Surgery.
  • Total Senior Residency period is 3 years; any Senior Residency already completed in any Government medical institution (regular/ad-hoc/contract) will be reduced from the 3-year tenure offered, and applicants should not have completed 3 years Senior Residency under Residency Scheme earlier.
  • Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification; mere possession of prescribed qualifications does not entitle any candidate for selection.
  • The appointee will not be entitled to benefits like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance, Seniority, Promotion etc. available to regular Government servants, and must conform to conduct and discipline rules of the Institute, without engaging in private practice.
  • Incomplete applications in any respect will be summarily rejected, and the competent authority reserves the right to amend, cancel or change the advertisement wholly or partly without assigning reasons.
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Courts at Nagpur only.
  • Name of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the Institute website; no separate individual intimation will be sent, and candidates must regularly check https://aiimsnagpur.edu.in/pages/vacancies for updates.
  • In case of any inadvertent mistake in the selection process detected at any stage even after issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to the candidate.
  • The applicant is responsible for authenticity of information, documents and photograph; submission of false information or suppression of facts will lead to rejection/cancellation of selection/recruitment.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who wish to appear for the interview must make payment of the applicable application fee online through NEFT to the specified AIIMS EXAM FEE bank account.
  • The transaction reference number and date of transaction must be mentioned in the application form.
  • Candidates must fill the prescribed application form (Annexure I) and send a copy of the payment receipt along with application and all relevant copies of certificates via Google Form link https://forms.gle/Di3JuZ9vzKQF7Nuh9 on or before 07-01-2026 by 5 PM.
  • The filled-in application form (Annexure I) along with all original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates must be brought on the scheduled date of interview.
  • Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post should submit a separate application for each post.
  • Only those candidates who have been declared successful in their qualifying degree exam and will be completing their tenure for the same on or before the closing date of application will be eligible; if result is declared after the closing date, candidature will stand cancelled and no claim will be considered on interview basis.

Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Scientific Officers Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official BARC website. The last date to submit the application form is 21-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the BARC Scientific Officers Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is inviting applications for the Scientific Officer positions through the OCES/DGFS 2026 recruitment. This prestigious program offers engineering graduates and science postgraduates the chance to join the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) through two distinct training schemes: the one-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates (OCES-2026) and the two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates (DGFS-2026). Successful candidates will undergo intensive training, with a stipend of ₹74,000 per month during the training period. Upon appointment, they will be placed in Group-A posts with an attractive pay scale under the 7th CPC, totaling approximately ₹1,35,000 per month, along with various allowances.

This recruitment offers a unique opportunity to contribute to India's nuclear and atomic energy programs in various DAE units, such as BARC, IGCAR, and NPCIL. Candidates must meet specific educational qualifications, including a minimum of 60% marks in engineering or science degrees, and fulfill the age criteria (18 to 31 years). The selection process includes an online examination, GATE score-based shortlisting, and a final interview. Interested candidates can apply online from 22 December 2025 to 21 January 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring scientists to be part of a prestigious and impactful sector.

BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Training Scheme / Discipline Vacancy / Intake Detail
Scientific Officer (through Training School) OCES-2026: One-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates Number of posts not specified; selection through OCES-2026 programme for eligible disciplines.
Scientific Officer (through DGFS) DGFS-2026: Two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates Number of fellows not specified; DGFS fellowship awarded as per needs of DAE programmes to best performing candidates in OCES selection interview.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifying degrees and academic requirements for OCES/DGFS-2026 include B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engineering)/5-year Integrated M.Tech. in eligible engineering disciplines such as Civil, Chemical, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Metallurgical Engineering with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks, as detailed in the notification.
  • Eligible science disciplines include M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Geology and Geophysics with specified subject combinations at B.Sc. level and minimum 60% aggregate marks in qualifying degrees, as per the detailed discipline-wise criteria.
  • For screening based on GATE Score, candidates must have valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in the relevant GATE subjects/papers corresponding to their discipline as mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Only regular educational degrees obtained through full-time/on-campus mode are considered; degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education/learning, by research or part-time modes are not eligible.
  • Applicants must satisfy discipline-specific inclusion and exclusion of degree titles as listed, including ineligible specializations for each engineering and science discipline.
  • Candidates graduating in the academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results may apply, subject to completion of all academic requirements for the qualifying degree before 31 July 2026 and submission of final marksheet by 31 December 2026 (for OCES) or as per DGFS institute requirement.
  • Applicants must be citizens of India and, for those working in Central/State Government units/PSUs/Aided Institutes, a No Objection Certificate from their organization must be produced at the time of selection interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • During training, OCES Trainee Scientific Officers and DGFS fellows are paid a stipend of ₹ 74,000/- per month.
  • OCES Trainee Scientific Officers receive a one-time book allowance of ₹ 30,000/- during the training period.
  • DGFS fellows are reimbursed tuition fee for the M.Tech. programme and receive a one-time contingency grant of ₹ 60,000/- per annum for two years, along with funding up to ₹ 4,00,000 under the BRNS fast track project scheme for project-related equipment/consumables.
  • On appointment, Scientific Officers are placed in Group-A post of Government of India in Level 10 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix with basic pay of ₹ 56,100/-; total monthly emoluments including dearness allowance, house rent allowance and transport allowance are approximately ₹ 1,35,000/- for those posted in Mumbai.
  • Additional allowances include leave travel concession by air (as per conditions), children’s education allowance, annual professional update allowance and Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) as per government norms, along with a comprehensive Contributory Health Service Scheme for employees and dependent family members.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Minimum Age Limit: 18 years (Age as on August 1, 2026).
  • Maximum Age Limit for General Category: 26 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 29 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for SC/ST: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Dependents of those who died in the riots of 1984: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Persons domiciled in Kashmir Division of Jammu and Kashmir State from 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1989: 31 years.
  • Persons with physical disability with extent of disability 40% or more will be considered for age relaxation and may be permitted a scribe as per rules.

Application Fee

  • A non-refundable Application Fee of ₹ 500/- is chargeable from male applicants belonging to General and OBC categories.
  • Women candidates, transgender candidates, candidates belonging to SC/ST category, Dependents of Defence Personnel Killed in Action (DODPKIA) and physically challenged candidates are exempted from payment of Application Fee.
  • Candidates who have availed fee exemption are required to bring valid relevant proof for verification at the exam centre.

Event Date / Period

Selection Interviews 12th May – 12th June 2026

Commencement of OCES-2026 programme 31st July 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection to OCES/DGFS-2026 is a two-step process consisting of screening of candidates followed by a Selection Interview.
  • Screening for Selection Interview is conducted through two alternative channels: an online screening examination and GATE-score-based shortlisting.
  • The online screening examination is conducted in eight engineering OCES disciplines (codes 21-28) and five science OCES disciplines (codes 41-43, 45 and 46) at more than fifty cities across India.
  • Candidates meeting eligibility criteria with valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in prescribed papers may be screened in for Selection Interview on the basis of GATE scores.
  • Cut-off GATE scores for Screening Interview are decided after conclusion of the online exam, and candidates are advised to maximize their chances by availing both screening avenues.
  • Selection Interviews for shortlisted candidates in all disciplines except Geology and Geophysics are conducted at BARC Training School, Mumbai; interviews in Geology and Geophysics disciplines are held in Hyderabad.
  • Outstation applicants travelling for Selection Interview are eligible for reimbursement of to-and-fro AC-III tier normal train fare by shortest route or actual fare, whichever is less, upon submission of original tickets.
  • Final selection is solely on the basis of performance in Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness as determined by DAE doctors.

General Information/Instructions

  • OCES-2026 is a one-year Orientation Course conducted at BARC Training Schools at BARC, Mumbai and AMD, Hyderabad for engineering graduates and science postgraduates, leading to appointment as Scientific Officers in DAE units or Atomic Energy Regulatory Board upon successful completion.
  • DGFS-2026 is a two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for engineering graduates who secure M.Tech. admission in designated DGFS institutes and specializations, and who perform well in OCES Selection Interviews.
  • On successful completion of OCES/DGFS training, Trainee Scientific Officers are posted as Scientific Officers in various DAE units such as BARC, IGCAR, RRCAT, VECC, HWB, NFC, BRIT, NPCIL, BHAVINI, AMD, UCIL, DCSEM and AERB, based on programme needs and trainee performance.
  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement and personal indemnity bond to serve DAE for at least three years after completion of training; the bond covers stipend, book allowance, tuition fee and contingency grants as applicable.
  • DAE strives to maintain gender balance and encourages women candidates to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programmes.
  • Only online applications are accepted, and applicants are advised to regularly visit the online application portal for important updates and information.
  • Records of applicants for BARC Training Schools OCES/DGFS-2026 programme will not be preserved beyond four months from the date of publication of the final selection result.
  • In all matters concerning OCES/DGFS-2026 recruitment, decisions of the competent authority in BARC, Mumbai are final and binding; disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai, India.

How to Apply

  • Only online applications will be accepted for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme.
  • Candidates are required to visit the website https://www.barcocesexam.in during the period specified in the Important Dates table and submit the online application by following the instructions provided there.
  • Applicants should carefully read the Information Brochure and FAQs available on the online application portal before filling the online application form.
  • Candidates must enter accurate details regarding qualifying degree, discipline, GATE score (if applicable) and other required information as per the advertisement.
  • Candidates graduating in academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results must ensure that all academic requirements for award of qualifying degree are completed before 31 July 2026 and provide necessary certificates at the time of joining.

3. Disability Criteria (Divyang Reservation Matrix)

  • The notification includes a Divyang post suitability table mentioning physical requirements such as sitting, standing, walking, bending, finger manipulation, reading/writing, seeing, hearing and communication, and Divyang categories like Deaf/Hard of Hearing, One Arm/One Leg/Both Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness and Multiple Disabilities.
  • It clarifies that Divyang candidates who can perform the duties of Laboratory Assistant (test sample handling, record-keeping, coordinating laboratory work and assisting laboratory technologists) as per the specified physical criteria may apply. However, this is an isolated post and reservation benefit does not apply; Divyang candidates will be considered as general if otherwise eligible.

Selection Process

  • The selection will be based on a Vyavsay Chachani (Trade Test), which is only a qualifying test.
  • Applications received through proper channel will be scrutinized, and eligible candidates will be called for Trade Test as per departmental schedule.
  • Candidates who qualify the Trade Test will be placed before a Selection Committee, which will consider:
    – Confidential Reports (Gopaniya Ahwal) of last 5 years,
    – Service record, inquiry reports and other documents,
    – Seniority in service (Sevajyeshtha) determined from date of entry into service and cadre as per circular MPM/03/2781 dated 07.04.2010 and related instructions.
  • Final selection will be made strictly on service seniority amongst Trade Test qualified candidates, and appointment orders will be issued as per committee’s recommendations.
  • If two or more candidates have the same date of entry and equal seniority, tie-breaking will be done by:
    – Giving preference to the candidate senior in age (higher date of birth priority),
    – If date of birth is also same, preference will be decided on the alphabetical order of the initial letter of the surname.

Application Fee

  • No application fee has been mentioned in the notification for the post of Prayogshala Sahayak.

How To Apply

  • Only eligible in-service BMC employees working as Laboratory Attendant in specified hospitals/colleges/departments may apply in the prescribed departmental format attached with the notification.
  • Applications must be filled legibly in Marathi with the candidate’s own handwriting and signed clearly.
  • Candidates must route their applications through their concerned department/ward head and Service Record Officer (Seva-abhilekh) as per rules.
  • Service details must be verified and certified; the application should bear the inward/outward number of the department and be forwarded to:
    Pramukh Vaidhakiya Adhikari, Seth A.J.B. Mahanagarpalika Kan Nak Ghsa Rugnalay, Prashaskiye Karyalaya, 7, Mahatma (Phule) Marg, Fort, Mumbai – 400001.
  • Applications must reach the office from 22.12.2025 to 09.01.2026 during working hours only.
  • Applications received before or after this period, applications sent by Speed Post, ordinary post, tapal or courier directly, incomplete applications, applications not as per prescribed format, or without the employee’s signature will not be accepted.
  • Candidates must attach the following attested documents with their application:
    – Service verification in prescribed Form-B (two copies),
    – Inquiry certificates based on service record and SAP system,
    – Confidential reports of last 5 years,
    – Caste certificate & Caste Validity Certificate where applicable,
    – Non-Creamy Layer certificate/validity as applicable,
    – Pay slips/pay fixation order & Municipal ID card,
    – Initial appointment order in BMC service,
    – Marriage registration and Gazette notification for name change (if applicable),
    – SSC or equivalent marksheet and certificate for those appointed after 2009 to prove Marathi language qualification,
    – Computer qualification certificates (DOEACC/MS-CIT/GECT/other approved).
  • Original certificates must be produced at the time of document verification; absence of originals will render the candidate ineligible for Trade Test and selection.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 17/12/2025
Start date for receipt of applications 22/12/2025 (during office hours)
Last date for receipt of applications 09/01/2026 (during office hours)
Document Verification Date & Time 19/01/2026, 11:00 am to 4:00 pm at Seth A.J.B. Municipal ENT Hospital
Trade Test Date & Time To be notified separately; candidates must attend at their own cost

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Prayogshala Sahayak is in revised pay scale M-13, Rs. 21,700 – 69,000/- as sanctioned by BMC orders.
  • Other allowances and benefits will be admissible as per Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation service rules and applicable government norms for Group ‘C’ posts.

Instructions

  • This recruitment is strictly departmental and limited to in-service BMC staff working as Laboratory Attendant in specified health establishments.
  • Backward category employees who have already availed reservation earlier or are shown as “adhik sankhya” (excess) or whose category change is under process must submit valid Caste and Caste Validity Certificates along with Non-Creamy Layer certificates as applicable; otherwise, their applications will not be considered.
  • All eligible candidates (including backward category) will be considered in general merit list for this isolated post; reservation is not applicable, but category must be correctly mentioned for record purposes.
  • Candidates appointed in Group ‘D’ and later promoted to Group ‘C’ posts must pass compulsory computer examination within 2 years from appointment; otherwise, they may be reverted to original post as per circular MPM/2/3221 dated 14.11.2014.
  • Candidates under departmental inquiry, preliminary inquiry, or suspension will not be considered for appointment until such proceedings are cleared.
  • Selected candidates for Prayogshala Sahayak must submit an application within 2 years from selection date for reversion to original post in case they do not wish to continue; otherwise, their rights to original post will lapse.
  • Applications received under this recruitment process will be considered only for this selection; future vacancies will require fresh recruitment/notification.
  • Waiting list (Pratiksha Yadi), if prepared, will remain valid for 2 years; after that, it will lapse automatically.
  • The administration reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

Eligibility Criteria for HAL Operator & Staff Nurse 2025

Candidates will be shortlisted for a Written Test based on the marks secured in the Qualifying Examination (cut-off decided by HAL). The Written Test will be of 2.5 hours duration with Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts:

  • Part-II: 40 questions on English & Reasoning.

There is no negative marking, and candidates need at least 50% marks to qualify for document verification. Final selection is subject to document verification, pre-employment medical examination, and character verification.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before applying, candidates must scan and prepare their photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration (in prescribed text and format), and ensure these meet specified size and file‑type requirements; a latest CV/Resume in PDF (up to 500 KB) must also be uploaded.

The Uranium Corporation of India Limited (UCIL) has released Advertisement No. UCIL-07/2025 for the recruitment of 27 regular posts including Mining Mate-C, Winding Engine Driver-B, and Boiler-cum-Compressor Attendant-A in various disciplines. Online applications began on December 1, 2025, and eligible Indian nationals can apply through the UCIL recruitment portal until December 31, 2025. This recruitment targets metalliferous mining operations and offers opportunities in the nuclear power sector with competitive pay and benefits under Department of Atomic Energy.

Eligibility Criteria for UCIL 2025

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the following qualifications as on December 31, 2025:

  • Mining Mate-C: Valid ‘Restricted’/‘Unrestricted’ Certificate of Competency for working in Metalliferous Mines issued by DGMS + Minimum 3 years working experience in metalliferous mines.
  • Winding Engine Driver-B: Matriculation with 1st Class Winding Engine Driver Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS + More than 3 years experience as Winding Engine Driver in Metal Mines, including at least 1 year on 75 HP winder or more.
  • Boiler-cum-Compressor Attendant-A: Matriculation with 1st Class Boiler Attendant Certificate granted by any State/UT Govt. Board + 1 year experience in-charge of single/multiple boilers with 300 sq.mtr. capacity or more.

Age Limit (As of 31/12/2025)

Maximum age limits: Mining Mate-C - 40 years; Winding Engine Driver-B - 35 years; Boiler-cum-Compressor Attendant-A - 30 years.

PwBD (OBC) 13 Years

Salary & Benefits for UCIL 2025

Pay Scales (IDA): Mining Mate-C - ₹29,910 - 3% - ₹45,480; Winding Engine Driver-B - ₹28,790 - 3% - ₹44,850; Boiler-cum-Compressor Attendant-A - ₹28,390 - 3% - ₹44,230. Selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance, Perks & Allowances, subsidized accommodation, medical facilities, etc., as per company policies. Internal candidates are exempt from application fees.

Exam Pattern & Syllabus for UCIL 2025

Selection Process

Final selection may be made through Written Test/Trade Test/Psychometric Test/Group Exercise/Personal Interview or any other suitable mode of assessment. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for further stages. Verification of original certificates will be at the next stage.

How to Apply for UCIL Recruitment 2025

  1. Visit the UCIL website www.ucil.gov.in and go to the "Recruitment" portal.
  2. Click on "Online Application" for Advt. No. UCIL-07/2025 and register with valid email ID and mobile number.
  3. Fill in personal, educational, experience, and category details carefully; ensure eligibility criteria are met.
  4. Upload scanned copies of recent passport-size photo, signature, relevant certificates (DGMS, Matriculation, Experience, Caste/PwBD/EWS), and other documents as required.
  5. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) via net banking/debit/credit cards (Rs.500/- for UR/OBC/EWS; exempt for SC/ST/PwBD/Female/Internal).
  6. Preview the form, submit the application, and take a printout of the acknowledgment for future reference.

Important Dates

Selection Process

  • The selection shall be made in terms of Rule 43(ii) of the J&K Public Service Commission (Business & Procedure) Rules, 2021, updated vide Notification No. 05-PSC(DR-P) of 2023 dated 09.02.2023.
  • The syllabus for the post of Assistant Manager is appended to the notification as “Annexure A” (detailed subject-wise units in Printing Technology, Design, Binding & Packaging, Reproduction, Press Technology, Book Design, Costing & Estimating, Computer Application, Management and Public Administration, etc.).
  • Candidates are advised to acquaint themselves with the above rules and syllabus.
  • Examination will be held at Srinagar and Jammu centres; candidates shall indicate their preferred centre in the application form, but allotment of centre is at the sole discretion of the Commission.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the JKPSC website (http://www.jkpsc.nic.in); no other means/mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are advised to update their One Time Registration (OTR) before filling the application form and to go through all instructions and eligibility conditions prescribed for the post.
  • Applicants must upload all mandatory prescribed documents along with the online application form; no further opportunity to upload any document shall be provided after the cut-off date.
  • An applicant seeking consideration under any reserved category must ensure that he/she possesses requisite category certificate valid on the cut-off date and upload the same while submitting online application, failing which action under rules including rejection of application/candidature may be taken.
  • Applicants will not be required to submit a hard copy of the online application form or any other documents to the Commission at the time of filling online application; however, they will be required to produce downloaded copy of the online application form along with original certificates at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates are advised to submit online applications much before the closing date and not wait till the last date to avoid the possibility of disconnection/inability to pay fee or failure to login due to heavy load on the website.
  • Admit cards, examination timetable and centre details will be uploaded on the Commission’s website about two weeks before the date of examination; candidates must bring printout of Admit Card/Roll Number Slip, recent photographs and valid photo ID proof to the examination hall.
  • Detailed instructions are provided regarding documents to be uploaded (Date of Birth certificate, Domicile certificate, Degree/Diploma and marks cards, In-service certificate, and any document for weightage as per rules such as NCC/NSS).
  • JKPSC will initially accept candidature provisionally and detailed scrutiny of applications will be undertaken later; if any claim is not substantiated by proof at the time of verification, candidature will be cancelled and the Commission’s decision shall be final.
  • Action against candidates found guilty of misconduct (including impersonation, fabricated documents, false statements, unfair means in examination, misbehaviour, etc.) includes disqualification, debarment from examinations/selection, and disciplinary action if already in Government service.

How to Apply

  • Visit the JKPSC website (http://www.jkpsc.nic.in) and click on “One Time Registration” (OTR) or “Login” if profile is already created.
  • Fill all requisite fields in OTR: personal information, contact information, educational qualification, service details etc., and upload date-stamped recent passport-size colour photograph and signature (size between 10 kB to 20 kB in .jpeg/.jpg format).
  • After updating OTR, check eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement, click on “Show Examination” for the relevant notification month, select the post and click on “APPLY”.
  • Read the instructions window carefully, then proceed; system will display particulars from OTR, candidate must fill remaining required fields, accept the declaration and click “SUBMIT”.
  • After successful submission of basic details, pay the requisite fee through online mode under “Submitted Applications” menu and upload requisite documents (Date of Birth, Degree/Diploma, Category certificate, Domicile etc.).
  • Ensure that fee payment status is reflected as submitted on the application form; in case of non-reflection or “under processing” status, candidates must immediately contact JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/Resham Ghar Colony Jammu.
  • Candidates can print the submitted application only after payment of fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • Submission of multiple applications by generating multiple User IDs or prefixing titles with mismatched fee details may lead to rejection; only the application with higher Registration ID will be entertained and fee against one RID will not be adjusted against another.

Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/ documents or providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidate at any stage of recruitment selection will result in automatic rejection of his/ her candidature. The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard.
  • Date & Place of Bio-metric, Document Verification and Written Examination for each trade will be intimated via admit card which will be sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate alongwith the application and through Electronic means. Candidates will have to make their own arrangement for loading / boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhaar card, PAN Card, Driving License) for confirmation while reporting for the bio-metric, document verification, written test, skill test and physical test (where applicable), which should have same name as given in the application form.
  • Capturing of Bio-metric details will be done on first day of documents verification and Bio-metric verification will be carried out on subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for the written test/ Skill Test/ Physical Test (where applicable) and on reporting to unit by selected candidates.
  • The recruitment process including any part of examination can be cancelled/ postponed/ suspended/ terminated without any prior notice/ assigning any reasons at any stage. Provisionally selected candidates have to produce original and photocopy of the following documents/ certificates duly self attested on the date and time intimated by the recruiting establishment:- a. Matriculation certificate/ Municipality Birth certificate in support for date of birth. b. Aadhaar Card. c. Mark Sheet of the educational qualification mentioned against the post applied for. d. Any certificate for the desirable qualification. e. SC/ ST/ OBC (Non creamy layer for OBC)/ EWS or any other reservation certificate, if applicable. f. Physically handicapped certificate showing 40% and above disability issued by competent authority if applicable. g. Discharge certificate in case of Ex-serviceman h. NOC in original from their present employer/ competent authority in case of Government servant including serving Armed Force's Personnel if applicable j. In case of Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husband, a certified copy of judgement degree of the appropriate court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case may be. k. Address proof (Passport/ Ration Card/ Voter Card/ Driving License)
  • Candidates on selection are liable to be transferred anywhere across India including field services liability and not necessarily at the choice of location given at time of application.
  • Any representation for redressal of grievances with regard to the recruitment will be subject to the jurisdiction of the District Court of respective stations where candidate has submitted the application.

  • A candidate who claims to belong to any of the category-Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/ Other Backward Class/Economically Weaker Sections should submit in support of his/ her claim an attested/ certified copy of a certificate(s) issued from the competent authority as per list mentioned at para 29 below as applicable vide the provisions of Government of India, Department of Personnel & Training guidelines issued and amended from time to time.
  • The authorities competent to Issue caste certificates are indicated below:- District Magistrate/ Additional Magistrate/ Collector/Deputy Commissioner/ Additional Deputy Commissioner/Deputy Collector/ First Class Stipendiary Magistrate/ Sub Divisional Magistrate/ Taluka Magistrate/ Executive Magistrate Extra Assistant Commissioner (not below the rank of First Class Stipendiary Magistrate). Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/ Presidency Magistrate. Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar, and Sub-Divisional Officer of the area where the candidate and/ or his family resides.

Candidate to ensure that valid E-mail ID Aadhar linked Mobile Number mentioned in the application form.
  • Last date for receipt of application is 21 days (including Sundays and holidays) from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News and 28 days (including Sundays and holidays) for those in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of Jammu & Kashmir State, Lahaul and Spiti Districts and Pangi Sub- Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh; Andaman and Nicobar islands and Lakshadweep. First date of this advertisement in the "Employment News" will be taken into account for calculating 21/28 days. If closing date falls on holidays, then next working will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

This recruitment offers fixed monthly remuneration with opportunities to contribute to the healthcare needs of ex-servicemen and their dependants in Leh. The posts include medical, dental, nursing, technical and support staff roles, ensuring a broad scope for candidates with varied qualifications and experience. Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

Selection Process

  • The selection process will comprise of Computer Based Test (CBT) Tier-I and Tier-II followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.
  • Tier-I (CBT): Provisional selection on the basis of marks obtained in Tier-I exam.
  • Tier-II (CBT): Trade/Skill Test (for Technician-A) or Descriptive Test (for STA-B) – qualifying in nature.
  • Final selection will be based on combined merit of Tier-I and Tier-II marks (where applicable) and subject to medical fitness.
  • Date of Tier-I Exam (CBT) will be announced on DRDO website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through the official website https://www.drdo.gov.in.
  • Before filling the online application, candidates are advised to read the complete advertisement carefully.
  • One candidate can apply for only one post code. Multiple applications for different post codes will lead to cancellation.
  • Candidates must fill all required details, upload photograph, signature and relevant documents/certificates in prescribed format.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the application for future reference.
  • No hard copy/postal application will be accepted.

  • Candidates whose result of final qualifying examination is awaited as on crucial date are NOT eligible.
  • Only Indian Nationals need apply.
  • Selected candidates will have All India service liability and are liable to serve anywhere in India including field/remote areas.
  • Candidates must serve minimum five years at the first place of posting. No request for transfer will be entertained during this period.
  • Provisionally shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification and Medical Examination.
  • Candidates must be in good mental and physical health. Night blindness or colour blindness will lead to disqualification.
  • Any dispute will be subject to courts/tribunals having jurisdiction over Delhi only.
  • DRDO reserves the right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

  • The hiring shall be purely on fixed term basis initially for a period of 1-2 Years, and further extendable if required, until completion of the assignment and subject to satisfactory performance, for a maximum period of 3 years from the initial date of joining

  • Candidates shall be required to work anywhere in India and abroad depending on the requirement
  • The selected candidates shall be allowed to join only if found medically fit
  • No claim for regular appointment in EIL by virtue of having worked on fixed term basis will be entertained
  • Place of posting shall be at different construction Sites spread across the country including Bina, Dahej, Vadinar, Vishakhapatnam, Raipur, etc.
  • The place of posting can be anywhere in India and abroad depending upon the organizational requirement
  • Reservation for PwDs (Persons with Disability) shall be as per Government of India directives. Persons with 40% or more disability only are eligible to apply under PwD category
  • A candidate can apply for one position only in the subject advertisement. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, the latest one shall be considered as final, and the older applications shall be rejected without any notice

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.engineersindia.com and go to the career link
  • Step 2: Read carefully all the instructions given on the website
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all the relevant correct details. While filling the percentage of marks, round off percentage to lower whole number (e.g., for 60.9, write 60). Round off CGPA to the lower decimal (e.g., for 6.95, write 6.9)
  • Step 4: Keep the properly scanned copies (readable form) of the following documents ready for uploading: Latest Passport size colour photograph in .jpg/.jpeg format of not more than 75 KB size, and Signature in .jpg/.jpeg format of not more than 25 KB size
  • Step 5: Submit the online application between 00:00 hrs on 22.12.2025 till 23:59 hrs on 31.12.2025
  • Step 6: Take printout of the registered application form (6 copies), affix colour photograph and bring while reporting for walk-in interview

  • Step 8: Report for walk-in interview at Engineers India Limited, Sector-16 (On NH-48), Gurugram, Haryana-122001 on the scheduled date for your position code at 08:00 AM
  • Step 9: Carry all original documents along with self-attested photocopy sets for verification

  • Certificates of educational qualifications – Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/Post Graduation Mark Sheets and Passing Certificates of all Semesters/Years

  • Experience Certificates for all experiences declared in application in original (should clearly indicate date of joining, date of separation and nature of works handled)
  • On demand, produce further documents like offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI Card, Bank Statement to substantiate employment
  • SC/ST Certificate (in original) in prescribed format, if applicable

The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), MP, under the guidance of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) and Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority, has invited applications for the engagement of Legal Aid Defense Counsels on contract basis as per the Legal Aid Defense Counsel Scheme (L.A.D.C.S.). This initiative aims to provide quality legal assistance to accused persons in criminal cases from pre-arrest stage to appeal and all intermediate stages. A total of 10 posts are available: 01 Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel, 03 Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsels, and 06 Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsels, exclusively for the District Legal Services Authority, MP.

The positions are full-time contractual roles where selected advocates will handle cases assigned by DLSA MP and are prohibited from undertaking any private practice during the contract period. Honorarium ranges from Rs. 35,000/- for Assistant to Rs. 80,000/- for Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel, based on minimum bar practice experience (0-3 years for Assistant, 7 years for Deputy Chief, and 10 years for Chief in specified courts). Applications in the prescribed format must be submitted in person or by registered post to the DLSA MP office by 02.01.2026 (5:00 PM). The scheme follows NALSA's modified guidelines and MP State Legal Services Authority SOPs, with details available on official court websites.

  • a) Specializing in different types of electrical systems (DCEXX, Gem, DC2000 etc) of Dragline / Excavators.

  • c) Experience of rewinding and repair of electrical motors, generators, transformers etc.
  • d) Repairing of Electronics Cards and components, like IC, Microprocessors etc and other Electronics components and assemblies.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Consolidated monthly compensation/ Honorarium For Retd. E-8 Gr. Executive ₹1,20,000/- per month
  • Conveyance charges: Company shall provide conveyance for Full-time Advisors as per availability. However, where conveyance is not provided, they shall be eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charge.
  • Accommodation Facility: Suitable company's accommodation shall be provided on availability. However, if company's accommodation is not available, HRA will be provided as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X,Y and Z class of cities based on circular of DoE vide OM dated 07.07.2017
  • Re-imbursement for Mobile Telephones: Re-imbursement for the use of mobile telephones based on the actual bills or ₹1000/- per month whichever is less.
  • Medical: All executives of CIL covered under the Post Retiral Medical Benefits Scheme will continue to be governed by the said scheme. Those appointed, who were not under the roll of CIL, will be given the same coverage of benefit, if they are not covered under any post retiral medical scheme.
  • Leave: The Advisor shall be entitled for paid leave of 15 days in every six months spell in addition to the paid holidays in the establishment. The paid leave shall be regulated as per the provisions of EL (Earned Leave) applicable to the executive cadre employees under the CIL Executive Leave Rules. However, the paid leave admissible as above is not encashable. The accumulated leave shall stand lapsed on the expiry of each period of engagement of Advisor.
  • TA/DA and other boarding/ lodging charges: On official tour :- As per entitlement on their retirement restricted to air travel by Economy class only. On Joining: On engagement to the post of Advisor, if the Advisor is required to travel from out-station for joining duty, then he/she will be eligible for the cost of One ticket (for self) as per the entitlement mentioned above. On expiry of contract, also he/she will be eligible for one ticket (for self). Accommodation in Hotel: The Advisor will be entitled to Hotel Accommodation as per his entitlement at the time of his Retirement/Superannuation limited to Single Room, limited to the maximum of entitlement of E9 grade Executives.
