  • The selected Advisor (Excavation) would be stationed at NCL HQ, Singrauli MP and will report to Director (Tech/Operation), NCL.
  • The engagement of Advisor (Excavation) shall be subject to Medical Fitness to be certified by Company's Medical Officer.
  • Notice period for termination of contract - one month's notice or consolidated compensation amount from either side.
  • Extension of Fixed Tenure - Tenure of engagement can be extended on the approval of the Chairman-cum-Managing Director, NCL as the case may be.
  • Signing of the documents - The Advisor shall give his proposals, suggestions, comments, advises, remarks, etc in writing under their signature and shall take accountability for the same. However, he will not supervise or control the day to day work of officials / employees of the company nor will he certify or pass bills pertaining to the department.
  • Secrecy-The Advisor will maintain all information/ documents/ materials gathered during the course of the engagement in strict confidence. They will not copy or make notes of such information/ documents except in conjunction with the work for the Company. They will not divulge to anyone outside the Company or use any of the information/ documents/ materials gathered during the course of engagement for their own or anyone else's benefit, either during or after the terms of engagement with the Company. The aforesaid obligation shall also apply to proprietary/ confidential information/ documents of third parties received by them or the company in the normal course of the engagement with the Company. The Advisor shall, while demitting the office, handover all information/ documents/ materials (in soft/ hard format) under their possession, during the engagement period, to the concerned HOD.
  • Tax - In case payment of GST is required, then the same shall be reimbursed on production of proof of such payment.
  • Reporting Relationships – During course of the engagement, the Advisor will employ himself/herself efficiently, diligently and to the best of his/her ability shall devote his/her whole time and attention to the interest of the Company and generally carry out work as assigned to him/her and shall comply with all lawful orders and directions given by the CMDs/ Directors/ HoDs. He/She shall honestly, diligently and faithfully serve the Company and use utmost endeavor to promote the interest of the Company.
  • Expiry of Terms of Engagement – Unless the ad-hoc period of engagement is extended further or terminated earlier by giving one-month notice or payment in lieu thereof, the engagement will come to an automatic end on the expiry of the period of engagement stipulated in the offer letter and no notice will be necessary.
  • Joining on appointment – The Advisor is required to join within 15 days of the offer of engagement or in exceptional circumstances, as approved by the concerned Functional Director. In the event of failure to join within the stipulated period, the offer of engagement shall stand withdrawn automatically.
  • Prohibition on other Full time engagement - Advisor shall not accept any full time appointment or post, whether advisory or administrative, in any other firm or company during the period of their engagement with CIL and its subsidiaries
  • Vigilance/ Departmental Clearances – The rules of promotion on the matter of Vigilance/ Departmental shall hold good on the matter of appointments/engagements of retired officials of Coal India Limited. Further, compliance to circular No. 07/05/21 dated 03.06.2021 of Central Vigilance Commission to be made regarding procedure for obtaining Vigilance clearance before engaging retired officials other than that of Coal India Limited.
  • Other Terms and Conditions will be as per CIL's policy in vogue.
  • Applications received after 12.01.2026 by 3.00 PM to the office/email of General Manager (HR)/HOD(EE), NCL, Post - Singrauli, Distt-Singrauli (MP) PIN-486889 will not be considered and company will not be responsible for any postal delay/lost in transit in submission on application within specified time.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Technical Assistant): Diploma in relevant engineering/technology (3 years full time) with 60% marks and 2 years experience OR B.Sc. with 1 year professional qualification/experience in relevant area (IPR/HR/Finance/IT etc.).
  • Qualifications (Technician): SSC / 10th Standard with Science subjects (minimum 55% marks) AND ITI certificate in relevant trade OR 2-3 years of relevant experience/apprentice training.
  • Essential qualifications: All qualifications must be from recognized Universities/Institutions. Period of experience is counted after acquiring minimum prescribed qualification.
  • Desirable: Higher qualifications can be mentioned in the application form.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years for Technical Assistant roles, and minimum of ITI certification or 2-3 years experience for Technician roles.

Salary/Stipend

Total Emoluments means approximate total emoluments on minimum of Pay Level inclusive of Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) etc. in Class 'Y' City.

  • Technical Assistant (Level-06): Rs. 35,400-1,12,400 (Total Emoluments approx. Rs. 66,500/- per month).
  • Technician (1) (Level-02): Rs. 19,900-63,200 (Total Emoluments approx. Rs. 37,000/- per month).
  • Other benefits available as per CSIR/Govt. of India rules: Reimbursement of Medical Expenses, Leave Travel Concession, Children’s Education Allowances, New Pension Scheme (NPS) 2004, Personal Computer Advance, House Building Advance.

Age Limit (as on 04-01-2026)

The crucial date for determining age limits is the last date for submission of online applications (04.01.2026).

  • Minimum Age: The age of the applicant should not be below 18 years.
  • Maximum Age: 28 years for UR/EWS candidates.
  • Age Relaxation: Up to 05 years for SC/ST, up to 03 years for OBC (NCL) candidates for reserved posts.
  • PwBD Relaxation: 10 years relaxation (cumulative with caste relaxation up to 15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC).
  • Government/Autonomous Bodies employees: Up to 5 years relaxation if in the same line/allied cadre.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- through the online portal.
  • No fee is payable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Ex-Servicemen candidates, subject to uploading relevant documents.
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.
  • Fees paid are non-refundable.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Number RECT - 04/2025 (Dated 10.12.2025 implied)
Date of commencement of online applications 10.12.2025
Start Date for registration/fee submission for Online application 10.12.2025
Last date & time for submission of online applications 04.01.2026 (23.59Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Candidates recommended by the Screening Committee will be invited for a Trade Test.
  • Those who qualify in the Trade Test will be invited for a competitive Written Examination.
  • The written exam is OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination (English and Hindi, except for English language questions).
  • The exam consists of Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 questions, 1 hour, no negative marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 25 questions each, 30 minutes, negative marking), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 questions for TA / 50 questions for Tech(1), 90/60 minutes respectively, negative marking).
  • The final merit list will be prepared only on the basis of marks obtained in Paper-II & Paper-III, provided minimum thresholds are met in Paper-I and Trade Test is qualified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must be citizens of India.
  • Candidates working in Govt/PSUs must upload a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) with their online application.
  • Applications without required documents or incomplete applications will be rejected.
  • The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary.
  • All communication and updates (e.g., test dates, results, admit cards) will be posted on the CSIR-AMPRI official website only (https://ampri.res.in). No individual call letters will be mailed.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

How To Apply

  • Eligible candidates are required to apply ONLINE via the websites https://recttg3.ampri.res.in (for Technical Assistant) or https://recttg2.ampri.res.in (for Technician(1)) or via the link on the main CSIR-AMPRI website.
  • The application process involves three steps: Registration (online), Fee Submission (online, if applicable), and Online application submission.
  • Candidates must upload recent passport size photograph, signature, and all relevant certificates in the specified format and size (max 1MB each).
  • After final submission, no changes will be permitted to the application form.
  • Candidates should retain a printout of the completed application form and payment details for their records, but should NOT send a hard copy initially.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (TBE-XSM-01 Mechanical/Electrical): Diploma in Engineering (full time & regular) in the relevant trade from a recognized Board of Technical Education/Institute, OR Diploma awarded by Indian Air Force/Indian Army/Indian Navy after prescribed training.
  • Experience (TBE-XSM-01 Mechanical/Electrical): Minimum 2 years of working experience in Aircraft Maintenance.

  • Experience (TBE-XSM-02 Aerodrome): Minimum 03 years’ experience in aerodrome/flight operations by working at a flying base/station.
  • Candidates must have acquired qualifications through regular mode only.

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay on Induction: Rs. 23,000/- for D6 Channel; Rs. 21,000/- for B4 Channel.

  • Other benefits: Monthly/Annual Incentive, Quarterly Performance Pay, Night Shift Allowance (if applicable), Uniform, Shoe Allowance, HRA (if company quarter not provided).

  • The Written Test will be 2 ½ hours long, comprising Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts (General Awareness, English & Reasoning, Concerned Discipline).
  • There is no negative marking; each question carries 1 mark.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in the written test to qualify.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification in order of merit.
  • Provisional Offers of Engagement will be issued after successful Document Verification and candidates will undergo a Pre-employment Medical examination.

  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply.
  • Age and Experience are calculated as on 10-12-2025.
  • Engagement is on a tenure basis for a maximum of four years and does not guarantee regular/permanent employment.
  • Selected candidates will undergo Induction Training for a period of 8 weeks.
  • Selected candidates will be deployed in shifts as per company requirements and are liable to be transferred to any HAL location based on organizational requirements.
  • Candidates possessing higher qualifications than prescribed should not apply, their candidature will be rejected.
  • No relaxation in Health Standards will be allowed during the pre-employment medical examination.

How To Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates need to apply ONLINE through the HAL website (www.hal-india.co.in).
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Applications received through ONLINE mode will be screened as per the norms laid down in the notification.
  • Candidates are requested to visit the HAL website regularly for all updates regarding the selection process, test dates, and venue.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications for Chief LADC: Practice in Criminal law for at least 10 years; Excellent oral and written communication skills; Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others with capability to lead.
  • Qualifications for Deputy Chief LADC: Practice in Criminal law for at least 7 years; Excellent oral and written communication skills; IT Knowledge with proficiency in work.

  • Desirable: LL.M. Degree, Ph.D. in Law, Knowledge of Information Technology and Legal Software Tools are additional qualifications that can be submitted.
  • Experience: Varies by post as listed above. Candidates must have handled minimum numbers of cases (e.g., Chief LADC must have handled at least 30 criminal trials in Sessions Courts).

Salary/Stipend

  • For a Category C district (which includes Mandla), the determined honorarium (retainership fee) per month is:
  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹65,000/-
  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹45,000/- each
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹25,000/- each

Event Date
Advertisement Date 18/12/2025
Last Date for Application Submission 20/01/2026 (by 5:00 PM)

  • Applications will be scrutinized according to the rules. Incomplete or false information applications will be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

For Veterinary Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A.H.) from a University established by law in India or equivalent qualification as defined in Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984
  • Must be duly registered with the Uttar Pradesh Veterinary Council

For Vetting Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor of Arts degree (with English or Hindi Literature) or Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Commerce with minimum 50% marks AND three years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks; OR Five years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, obtained 'B' certificate of NCC, or Post-graduate degree in Law

For Swasthya Shiksha Adhikari:

  • Essential Qualification: Master's Degree from a recognised University in Sociology or any subject of Social Science (includes Sociology, Anthropology, Psychology, Social Psychology, Political Science, Geography, History, and Economics)
  • Desirable: Experience of Extension Work, Training under Family Welfare, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Inspector of Drugs:

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from recognized University
  • 18 months experience in manufacture OR testing of substances specified in Schedule 'C' to Drug and Cosmetics Rules 1945 in approved laboratory OR 3 years experience in inspection of firms manufacturing substances in Schedule 'C' as Drug Inspector
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Dental Surgeon:

  • Essential Qualification: B.D.S. (Bachelor of Dental Surgery) degree from recognised university or equivalent qualification recognised by Indian Dental Council
  • Rotary Internship completed before last date of application
  • Registration with U.P. Dental Council
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Ayurved):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Ayurvedic from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Vaidya with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Ayurvedic or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurvedic from recognized institution

For Medical Officer Community Health (Ayurvedic and Unani):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from University established by law in India or equivalent qualification
  • Registration as Vaidya or Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience in State Ayurvedic, Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from recognised institution, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Unani):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Unani Tib from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Unani Tib from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Unani Tib from recognized institution

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Homoeopathic):

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years (preference to degree holders)
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Homoeopathic Medical Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

Selection Process

  • Screening Examination: Commission will hold Screening Examination (Objective Type) for selection of suitable candidates for admission to interview
  • Question Paper: Objective type multiple choice questions with four alternatives for each question
  • Negative Marking: For each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty
  • If question is left blank, no penalty will be imposed
  • If more than one answer is given, it will be treated as wrong answer with same penalty
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: SC/ST candidates must secure minimum 35% marks, other category candidates must secure minimum 40% marks in screening examination
  • Candidates securing less than minimum efficiency standard will be disqualified
  • Final Merit: Determined by adding 75% marks in screening test and 25% marks in interview
  • Only candidates qualifying in Screening Examination will be entitled for Interview as per Commission's standard
  • Interview: Original certificates required for verification at the time of interview
  • Candidates serving under Central/State Government must produce "No Objection Certificate" at interview

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Online application only through O.T.R. (One Time Registration) based system. Applications through any other medium will not be accepted
  • O.T.R. Mandatory: Candidates must obtain O.T.R. Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submission of online application
  • Knowledge of Hindi: Essential for all posts
  • Domicile: Only domiciled persons of U.P. are entitled for reservation benefits
  • EWS Certificate: Valid for application year only; must be for previous year from application year with gross annual income from all sources
  • Caste Certificate: Must be issued by District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/City Magistrate/SDM/Tehsildar in prescribed format
  • Document Verification: Hard copy of online application with self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates to be submitted when asked
  • No Change After Submission: Any request for change in qualification and category after receipt of application will not be entertained
  • Wrong Information: Candidates furnishing wrong information will be debarred from this selection and all future examinations up to maximum 5 years
  • Vacancy Numbers: May increase/decrease depending upon circumstances/requirements
  • Commission's Decision Final: Decision of Commission regarding eligibility/candidature/selection shall be final
  • Anti-Malpractice: Provisions of Uttar Pradesh Examination (Prevention of unfair Means) Act-2024 dated 06 August 2024 will be applicable
  • Candidates must visit Commission website continuously for updates
  • All future information/instructions will be sent to registered mobile number and email ID linked in O.T.R. by SMS or email

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - O.T.R. Registration: Obtain One Time Registration (O.T.R.) Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before applying
  • Step 2 - Visit Official Website: Go to https://uppsc.up.nic.in and click on "All Notifications/Advertisements"
  • Step 3 - Read Instructions: Go through User Instructions and View Advertisement thoroughly
  • Step 4 - Click Apply: Click on "Apply" button and authenticate with O.T.R. using O.T.P. received on registered mobile/email or O.T.R. password
  • Step 5 - Fill Application Part-1: Personal details will be auto-filled from O.T.R. Fill essential qualification required for the post
  • Step 6 - Fill Application Part-2: Click 'Submit Details' under 'Application Part-2'. Permanent and correspondence address will be auto-displayed. Choose Yes/No for preferential qualifications
  • Step 7 - Fee Payment: Click 'Proceed for fee payment' and pay through NET BANKING/CARD PAYMENTS/OTHER PAYMENT MODES via SBI MOPS
  • Step 8 - Take Print: After successful payment, take print of Payment Transaction Slip and submitted application form
  • Step 9 - Modification: If needed, modification in qualification can be done only once till last date for correction through 'Candidate Dashboard Login'
  • Important: Complete all stages of online application (O.T.R., Fee payment, Final submission) before last date
  • Preserve Records: Keep soft/hard copy of all information regarding all stages for future reference

  • Desirable / Preferred Skills: Familiarity with GIS, ABD, RFMS and Network Management Systems (NMS).
  • Desirable / Preferred Skills: Working knowledge of OTDR, Power Meters, Fusion Splicers and Visual Fault Locators (VFL).

Selection Process

  • Engagement shall be based on Walk-in Interview, assessment of experience, domain knowledge and overall suitability for the assignment.
  • RVNL reserves the right to assess candidates as per organizational and project requirements.
  • No request for postponement of interview shall be entertained.
  • Engagement shall be purely on contract basis for an initial period of one (01) year, extendable up to three (03) years based on project requirement and satisfactory performance.
  • The engagement shall automatically cease on expiry of the contract period unless extended by RVNL.
  • One-month advance notice shall be required from either side for termination of contract.
  • Selected candidates shall be required to execute a Service Bond equivalent to two months' consolidated remuneration to serve RVNL for a minimum period of one year. If the candidate fails to complete the bond period, they will be liable to pay the entire bond amount as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates working in Government / PSU / Autonomous bodies shall produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview or submit an undertaking to produce proper relieving order at the time of joining in case of selection.

  • Candidates belonging to the OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category must submit a caste certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the format prescribed for appointments under the Government of India. OBC certificates issued for State Government services shall not be accepted and the certificate must be issued during the current financial year clearly indicating that the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer.
  • In the case of EWS candidates, an Income and Asset Certificate for 2024-25 issued by the Competent Authority during the current financial year only shall be accepted as valid proof for availing reservation under the EWS category.
  • In the case of PwBD candidates, a PwBD Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed Government of India format (where applicable) must be produced.
  • In case the Caste/Category certificate is issued in a language other than Hindi or English, the candidate shall be required to produce a certified translation of the same in Hindi or English at the time of Interview/Document Verification/Joining, as applicable.
  • RVNL reserves the right to modify, restrict, increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the engagement process at any stage.
  • No correspondence shall be entertained from candidates found ineligible or not selected.
  • The candidate will give an undertaking at the time of interview to the effect that he/she will be de-barred for participation in all types of future assignments in RVNL, if they refuse to join after issue of offer of appointment.

  • Candidates must be medically fit and selected candidates shall have to undergo medical examination as per RVNL policy at their own cost before joining.

  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfil the prescribed eligibility criteria before attending the Walk-in Interview and their candidature shall be subject to verification of original documents and eligibility conditions.
  • Furnishing false/tampered documents or any misconduct will invite legal action, disqualification, debarment and/or termination as per rules.

  • Candidates have to appear for the Walk-in Interview at Rail Vikas Nigam Limited, Conference Hall, 7th Floor, Tower A, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, Safdarjung Enclave, New Delhi-110029.
  • Reporting time for Walk-in Interview is 10:00 Hrs.

  • Qualifications from University/Institute recognized by UGC/AICTE/State Technical Board/appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities

  • Only Matriculation/10th certificate is the authentic document for verification of date of birth
  • All educational certificates other than Central Board/State Board shall be accompanied with Government notifications declaring equivalence
  • Computer Literacy is desirable for all candidates

Experience Requirements

  • General Manager (E-8): 26 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Deputy General Manager (E-7): 23 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Chief Manager (E-6): 20 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Senior Manager (E-5): 16 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Manager (E-4): 12 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Deputy Manager (E-3): 8 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Assistant Manager (E-2): 4 years of post-qualification work experience
  • Work experience should be after acquiring relevant educational qualification and should be in-line executive experience
  • Management Trainee/Graduate Engineer Trainee experience counted only if regularized in same Company
  • Apprenticeship training under Apprentices Act, 1961 will not be counted as post-qualification executive work experience
  • Experience on contract basis through empaneled agencies/contractors (except in RFCL and its Promoter Organizations - NFL, EIL & FCIL) will not be considered
  • Preference will be given to candidates having in-line executive experience in Chemical and Fertilizer Industry

Desirable

  • Candidates with specific domain experience in respective departments as mentioned in detailed advertisement
  • Hands-on experience in continuous operating plants preferably in process industry
  • Conversance with latest practices, DCS control system, maintenance practices, troubleshooting
  • Computer literacy
  • For IT posts: Hands on experience of SAP shall be given preference

Salary/Stipend

  • E-2 (Assistant Manager): Rs. 50,000 - 1,60,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 17.40 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-3 (Deputy Manager): Rs. 60,000 - 1,80,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 20.88 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-4 (Manager): Rs. 70,000 - 2,00,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 24.36 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-5 (Senior Manager): Rs. 80,000 - 2,20,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 27.84 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-6 (Chief Manager): Rs. 90,000 - 2,40,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 31.32 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-7 (Deputy General Manager): Rs. 1,00,000 - 2,60,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 34.80 Lakhs per annum)
  • E-8 (General Manager): Rs. 1,20,000 - 2,80,000/- per month (CTC: Rs. 41.76 Lakhs per annum)
  • Additional Benefits: Industrial Dearness Allowance, Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance (not payable while posted at Unit where Company accommodation is available)
  • Other Perquisites: Leaves, Earned Leave Encashment, Medical Facilities, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Group Personal Accident Insurance & other welfare schemes as per Company rules
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP): Extended as and when applicable as per Company rules
  • Contributory Superannuation Benefit Fund Scheme: Extended as and when applicable as per Company rules

Age Limit (as on 15.01.2026)

  • General Manager (E-8): Maximum 55 years
  • Deputy General Manager (E-7): Maximum 50 years
  • Chief Manager (E-6): Maximum 50 years
  • Senior Manager (E-5): Maximum 45 years
  • Manager (E-4): Maximum 45 years
  • Deputy Manager (E-3): Maximum 40 years
  • Assistant Manager (E-2): Maximum 40 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (NCL): 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for UR-PwBD: 10 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-SC/ST: 15 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD-OBC(NCL): 13 years
  • Age Relaxation for ExSM/Dependent of those killed or disabled in action: As per Government of India guidelines
  • Age Relaxation for candidates domiciled in J&K (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989): 5 years
  • Maximum age after all relaxations: Should not exceed 56 years as on cutoff date

Application Fee

Pay Scale Level Category Application Fee

E-2 to E-4 UR/OBC/EWS Rs. 700/- (Plus additional bank processing charges, if any)
All Levels SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Departmental Exempted

  • No other mode of payment will be accepted

Last Date for Receiving Hard Copy (Far-Flung Areas) 29/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Scrutiny of Applications: Based on information in Application Form and submitted documents, candidates meeting eligibility criteria will be provisionally shortlisted
  • Stage 2 - Computer-Based Test (if required): In case of large number of applications, computer-based test in Delhi-NCR region and/or any other city(ies) of India may be conducted for shortlisting candidates. No TA/Boarding & Lodging facilities will be provided
  • Stage 3 - Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% average marks in interview
  • Merit List Preparation: In case of tie in total marks after personal interview, percentage of marks in qualifying examination will be considered. If percentage is also equal, date of birth will be considered (candidate born earlier will be senior)
  • Document Verification: Candidates will be called for personal interview provisionally. Those not meeting eligibility criteria or not in possession of complete requisite documents will not be allowed to attend interview
  • Travelling Allowance: - E-5 to E-8 posts: Single return air fare (economy class)/rail fare for AC I/Executive class chair car/road mileage at prescribed rates - E-1 to E-4 posts: To and fro single AC II return rail fare from nearest railway station to place of interview by shortest route
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates will be medically examined and certified fit by Medical Officer of Company or Medical Officer not below rank of Civil Surgeon/Chief Medical Officer/Medical Superintendent of State/Government Hospitals
  • Character & Antecedents Verification: Appointment will be provisional and subject to verification of Character & Antecedents and Caste/PwBD Certificate from concerned District Authorities/Competent Authorities

General Information/Instructions

  • OBC candidates falling in creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits and shall be treated as Unreserved candidates
  • Details once submitted in online application form will be final. No change in correspondence address/email/mobile/category shall be entertained
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies shall produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at time of interview
  • Selected candidates shall initially be posted at Ramagundam Plant, Telangana or Corporate Office, Noida but may be posted anywhere in India at discretion of Management
  • Selected candidates would be required to work in general and/or rotating shifts (including night shift) depending upon job requirement
  • Candidates should possess valid email ID which should remain active for at least one and half year from cutoff date

  • In case of any ambiguity/dispute, English version on website shall prevail

  • Important Notes: - Only one application per candidate per post is allowed - Incomplete applications or applications not supported by self-attested copies of relevant documents will be summarily rejected - Applications received at any other address of RFCL or after due date will be rejected - Keep copy of Application Form and Fee receipt for future reference - For issues related to form fill up & payment, contact: [email protected]

The merit list will be prepared for the purpose on the basis of percentage of marks in matriculation (with minimum 50% of aggregate marks) + ITI marks in the trade in which apprenticeship is to be done. The panel will be on the basis of simple average of marks in the matriculation and ITI.
  • In case of two candidates having the same marks, the candidates with older age shall be preferred. In case the dates of birth are also same, then the candidate who passed matriculation exam earlier shall be considered first.
  • A final merit list will be prepared trade wise and community wise, equal to the number of slots in the descending order of percentage of marks obtained by the candidate.
  • Candidates finally enlisted would be subject to verification of original testimonials and being found fit in appropriate medical examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The decision of the Railway administration in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the application and mode of selection shall be final.
  • Imparting Training in Railway will not confer any right to the candidates for their absorption in Railway after successful completion of training.
  • No correspondences for engagement will be entertained.
  • CANVASSING IN ANY FORM WILL DISQUALIFY THE CANDIDATURE AND NO CORRESPONDENCE WILL BE ENTERTAINED IN THE MATTER.
  • If the marks of 10th Passed is given in CGPA the percentage of the same to be filled up in format (ONLINE Application) also.
  • Enrolment with Employment Exchange is must except for wards of employees of RCF/Kapurthala.
  • Engagement of Act Apprentices will be from the sources of candidates who have registered their names in the nearest Employment Exchanges.
  • Before applying, the candidates should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and other criteria, at any stage of engagement and if erroneously engaged, such candidates shall be summarily dismissed without notice.
  • Candidature of the candidate shall be cancelled if he/she fails to produce the required original testimonials for verification or any other discrepancy noticed.
  • If it is noticed by the Railway administration that the applicant has furnished wrong/fake Certificates/ false certificates, the Railway administration reserves the right to discharge the candidate/selected candidate at any stage without notice even after his selection to undergo training.
  • The Railway administration do not undertake any responsibility for sending reply to the candidates not selected or not called for. No correspondence in respect of the application submitted shall be entertained or replied by this office to any individual or organization.
  • The Railway administration will not be responsible for any printing error.
  • A merit list will be prepared by the Committee who will then place the result before the Head of Workshop/Unit/Division for approval. The result should be declared within 15 days of the closure of receipt of application.
  • The candidates who are called for document verification are advised to bring their medical fitness certificate duly issued by Government authorized doctor (Gaz.) not below the rank of Asst. Surgeon of Central/State Hospital.
  • No daily allowance/conveyance allowance or traveling allowance will be paid to the candidate who will be called for document verification.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE by visiting www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in Detailed instruction for filling up ONLINE applications will be available on the website.
  • Candidates are required to log on the RCF website www.rcf.indianrailways.gov.in provided for filling ONLINE applications and fill up the personal details/BIO-DATA etc. carefully.
  • Candidates should ensure their name, father name, date of birth exactly match as recorded in Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and also debarment.
  • Candidates are advised to indicate their active mobile number and valid e-mail ID in the ONLINE application and keep them active during the entire engagement process as all important messages will be sent by email/SMS which will be treated as deemed to have been read by the candidates.
  • Candidates trying to submit more than one application with different particulars like Name/Father's name/community/Photo(face)/educational and/ or technical qualifications etc. or with different Email ID/Mobile Number are advised that all such applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to keep printout of their application. If found eligible, he/she will be called for Document Verification and the print out of Online application is required to be produced at the time of Document Verification.
  • Candidates are required to upload their passport size coloured photograph (size 3.5cm x 3.5 cm, not older than three months from the date of application in JPG/JPEG format, 100 PDI, Size of the image/file should be between 20 kb-70 kb) with clear front view of the candidates without cap and sunglasses.
  • Candidates are also required to upload their signature (size 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, size of the file should be between 20 kb – 30 kb).
  • The ONLINE application, complete in all respects, can be submitted through ONLINE process to RCF up to 07.01.2026 till 24.00 hours. No physical copy of the application is required to be sent to RCF.

The Scheme and the method of Screening Test (Computer Based Test or Offline Test) shall be notified in due course on the website of AIIMS, Bathinda
  • Interview: Candidates called for interview will have to produce all relevant original documents in proof of details furnished in their application form
  • Final Selection: Selection will be made on the basis of interview/ written examination

  • The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals / Institutions and countersigned by Medical Superintendent /CMO / Head of Hospital / Institution
  • Only such persons would be eligible for reservation under PwBD quota who suffer from not less than 40% of physical disability
  • Person who wants to avail the benefit of reservation would have to submit a Disability Certificate as issued by a Competent Authority in prescribed format

For OBC Candidates:

  • Candidates applying under OBC category must produce the valid caste certificate in the format provided by the DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification issued by DoP&T OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt(Res-I) dated 31.03.2016
  • The certificate must mention the non-creamy layer status of the applicant
  • The OBC applicants who belong to the 'Non-Creamy Layer' and whose caste appears in the Central List of the OBCs shall be eligible
  • The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate shall be issued for the financial year 2025-2026 (which is the year of advertisement), issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

For EWS Candidates:

  • A EWS certificate issued in prescribed format for employment in Central Government on the basis on income of financial year 2024-2025, issued from 1st April 2025 to 07th January 2026

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Tenure: The appointment is initially for one year and extendable up to maximum 03 (Three) years upon the recommendation of Head of the Department / discretion of the competent authority
  • Joining Period: Candidates have to join within one month from the date of issue of appointment letter. No extension will be allowed in any circumstances
  • Termination: The appointment can be terminated at any time by the Institute by giving one month notice or salary in lieu thereof
  • Full-time Position: This appointment is of full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited
  • Work Requirements: He/she will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute
  • Leave: The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed by the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time
  • No Benefits: The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc., or any other benefits available to Government Servants appointed on regular basis
  • NOC/Relieving Letter: If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 03 (Three) months of joining, then neither he/ she will be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor he/ she will receive any Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate
  • Experience Counting: The period of experience, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification
  • Government Employees: The candidates who are in service in any Government Institutions are required to submit "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of Interview
  • Discipline: He/ she should conform to the rules of discipline and conduct as applicable to the Institute employees
  • No Travelling Allowance: No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidates for interview and joining on selection
  • Court Conviction: The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will lead to a disqualification
  • Jurisdiction: All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bathinda

Important Notes

  • The candidates who applied earlier vide Advertisement No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/SR/2076 dated 18 October 2025 shall be considered, and they are not required to apply again
  • The above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation. The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda reserves the right to vary the vacancies including reserved vacancies as per the Govt. of India rules/circulars and requirements
  • Inadequately filled/ incomplete application form will be summarily rejected and no enquiry or representation will be entertained in this regard
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy
  • Candidates who fail to produce valid category certificate OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PWBD etc. during document verification or as and when required, the candidature will be cancelled
  • The decision of the competent authority regarding selection of candidates will be final and no representation will be entertained in this regard

The selection process for these temporary project roles involves an interview and/or written exam at the Department of Pathology in AIIMS Bathinda. Successful applicants can expect a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 73,700/- per month, depending on the specific role and qualifications. Candidates should bring their completed application form, bio-data, and original documents for verification on the interview day.

Desirable: Well versed in local languages (Punjabi & Hindi) and English.

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.

Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet.   • Completion of compulsory rotating internship, followed by at least 3 years of experience in a recognized hospital

  • MD/DNB (Internal Medicine), MD/DNB (O&G) or MD/DNB (Paediatrics)

  • Experience in Counseling students of highly competitive residential Institute of higher learning

  • First class degree is desirable
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated experience and knowledge in a reputed Organization, preferably in an educational institution

  • Experience in Analysis, design and development of ERP/IMS/Software system for academic operations
  • Knowledge of algorithms and data structures, MySQL database, PostgreSQL, RDBMS, Object-oriented Programming, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, Perl
  • Awareness of threats relating to web application security

    • Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • Computer Knowledge: 25 questions, 25 marks
  • Language: All tests except English Language will be available bilingually (English and Hindi)
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by Bank. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates entitled to 5% relaxation
  • Stage 2 - Test of Local Language: Conducted after qualifying the online written examination. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the local language of the state
  • Exemption from Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language
  • Final Merit List: Drawn state wise and category wise based on marks obtained in online examination in descending order
  • Tie Breaker: If marks are equal, merit order will be on the basis of Date of Birth (senior by age placed higher)
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Medical Fitness: Candidate must be declared medically fit as per Bank requirements

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for engagement in only one state and choose only one zone under that state
  • The number of training seats mentioned is provisional and may vary according to actual requirements of the Bank
  • Bank has right to post apprentices in any Branch/Offices within the state as per operational requirements
  • This is neither an employment nor a contract employment in the Bank. Engaged apprentices will only be "Trainees" and not treated as employees/workers
  • Period of engagement shall be restricted to One Year Apprenticeship Training Programme
  • Apprenticeship period shall not give the apprentice any lien/right on permanent employment with the Bank
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in by navigating to "Student Register/Login" section
  • Step 2: After registration, login to the NATS portal using user ID and password at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
  • Step 3: Apply for Apprenticeship against the advertisement published by "Bank of India" by going to the section "Apply against advertised vacancies"
  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours
  • Application Period: 25.12.2025 to 10.01.2026
  • Mode of Application: Online only through NATS Portal
  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government

Essential Conditions:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE
  • For Graduate and Technician disciplines, only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2022 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • For Trade Apprentices (ITI/Data Entry Operator) only those applicants who have acquired the prescribed qualification between 01.04.2021 and 31.12.2025 shall be considered eligible
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech., MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent qualification or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute
  • Candidates possessing Diploma in Engineering in relevant trade/discipline under a recognized lateral entry scheme shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks

Previous Apprenticeship Training Conditions:

  • A Candidate may undergo maximum two apprenticeship training, and the second training shall not be in the same trade
  • There shall be minimum one year gap between two apprenticeship training, provided that the previous training is completed
  • No gap shall be required in the case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer
  • Where an apprentice has terminated a previous apprenticeship contract due to health or financial hardship or relocation, transportation or career changes or language barrier, the waiting period of three month shall apply before the apprentice shall enter into another contract of apprenticeship with the same employer or any other employer and there shall be no waiting period for women

Salary/Stipend

  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019/2025 as amended from time to time
  • The exact stipend amount will be communicated at the time of engagement
  • Stipend will be paid on monthly basis during the apprenticeship training period

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 24 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years (maximum age up to 29 years)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years (maximum age up to 27 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years (maximum age up to 34 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years (maximum age up to 39 years)
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC-NCL): 13 years (maximum age up to 37 years)
  • Date of Reckoning: 31.12.2025

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification
  • The application process is completely online and free of cost

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 10/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/12/2025 (10:00 AM onwards)
Last Date for Registration in NAPS/NATS Portal 09/01/2026 (5:00 PM)
Last Date for Microsoft Form Submission 09/01/2026
Date of Reckoning (Age & Qualification) 31/12/2025
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months

Selection Process

  • Candidates must register successfully on NAPS/NATS portal and apply against the notification to be considered for selection process
  • No Written Test/Interview: There will be no written test or interview for the selection
  • Merit-Based Selection: Merit list of all the candidates who have applied against a respective post in the portal and meeting the notified eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the essential prescribed qualification for the post
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement
  • Candidates are advised to ensure that they are medically fit as per IndianOil's pre-engagement medical format
  • Shortlisted candidates whose documents including Pre-Engagement Medical Fitness Certificate are found in order shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training
  • Opportunities not filled through the initial shortlisting process shall be considered for filling by eligible and qualifying candidates from the panel cum merit list from the same opportunity

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates are advised to register as a Technician/Trade/Graduate Apprentice online in the NAPS/NATS portals under the respective State as per their Trades
  • Trade Apprentice (ITI/Data Entry Operator) must register at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
  • Technician Apprentice (Diploma) must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Graduate Apprentice must register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Candidates need to LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using their User ID/Email ID and APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings with the Establishment ID: NATS - EWBKOC000077, NAPS - E05201900011
  • Candidates MUST ensure their profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc.) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in application
  • Candidates have to apply for ANY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE ONLY. Candidates applying for more than one discipline Code will not be considered
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to his/her being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications

Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Chartered Accountant (CA) conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
  • OR candidates who have passed in intermediate examination of Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates who have undergone training under similar scheme for one year or more in any other PSUs will not be eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.

Salary/Stipend

  • The term of engagement as Industrial Trainee (CA/CMA) is purely for a period of 15 months only from the date of joining training.
  • The stipend payable to the trainees is Rs. 22,000/- per month.
  • There should be no misconception or claims by the beneficiary for employment in CIL or its subsidiaries on completion of training.

Age Limit (as on Crucial Date)

  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for UR/EWS category is 28 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for OBC (NCL) category is 31 years.
  • The upper age limit as on the crucial date for SC/ST category is 33 years.
  • The upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years for PwDs, 13 years for PwDs belonging to OBC-NCL and 15 years for PwDs belonging to SC/ST categories.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit to SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates is not applicable for consideration against unreserved posts.
  • Crucial date for claim of SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD status or any other benefit viz. reservation, upper age limit etc. where not specified otherwise, will be the 1st date of the month in which advertisement has been published.

Application Fee

  • No information regarding application fee is mentioned in the advertisement.

 

Selection Process

  • Selection of candidates will be based on percentage of marks scored by them in intermediate examination (total of both groups) of CA/CMA, as the case may be, and as per the reservation policy of Government and preference to the Land Owners and wards of employees.
  • Students would be required to give choice of 9 companies (in the order of preference) among CIL or its subsidiary companies i.e. CIL (HQ), ECL, BCCL, CCL, CMPDIL, NCL, MCL, SECL & WCL.
  • Selection will be based on the merit ranking based on marks obtained in Intermediate Exam and posting will be done based on the preference of posting given and seniority position in the Merit List.
  • In case of tie in marks of candidates, their relative seniority shall be determined by the date of birth, the older candidate being the senior.
  • If there is a tie in date of birth, the candidate who has got more marks in class X shall be preferred.
  • A waiting list panel of 125 additional trainees will also be drawn and reservation guidelines of the Government of India will be followed while drawing up the waiting list.
  • In case there is shortfall in joining in the original panel, then this shortfall (for the respective category) will be filled from the Waiting List Panel.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should have registered their names in Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India.
  • Candidates are informed that applying for engagement as Industrial Trainee shall not give them the right to be engaged as trainee in the company and company reserves the right to reject any candidate without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of training does not entitle the trainees any right for temporary or permanent job in CIL or its subsidiaries.
  • Preference will be given to the Land Owners and also to the wards of employees as defined in the scheme.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates can contact the Helpline No. 033 7110 4262 between 10.00 Hours to 17.00 Hours on all working days.
  • The selected candidates will be allowed for training subject to being found medically fit based on Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Registered Medical Practitioner.
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage if any information provided is found to be false or not in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Selected candidates will be engaged for a period of 15 months training and would be required to give an undertaking to the effect that they would complete the entire period of training unless otherwise removed by the company.
  • They shall maintain absolute integrity and maintain the secrecy of the documents they may come across during course of training.
  • They shall not share any information without prior approval of Management.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Kolkata and the Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Kolkata shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Selected candidates must agree to the other working terms and conditions like that of leave, misconduct, termination provisions etc. as per the approved scheme.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates meeting the above requirements may apply ONLINE and upload scanned copy of certificates in CIL Online application portal in career page of CIL website (coalindia.in).
  • All the fields in the form need to be filled up.
  • Candidates must provide nine choices of posting of CIL/subsidiaries in preferential order.
  • Upload recent passport size color photograph.
  • Upload scanned image of candidate’s signature in dark blue or black ink.
  • Upload proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Matriculation/HSC Mark Sheet).
  • Upload copy of AADHAR Card.
  • Upload Intermediate Examination Certificate of CA/CMA & Mark Sheets of intermediate examination of CA/CMA in chronological order.
  • Upload Community Certificate in case of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates.
  • Upload Disability Certificate in case of PwD candidates.
  • Upload proof of Land Ownership certificate signed by concerned Project Officer/Agent/Area GM of the Project, where applicable.
  • Upload proof as Ward of Employee and documents confirming the employment status of their parent(s) in CIL or its Subsidiary, where applicable.
  • Students are advised to fill up the marks obtained in the term through which they passed the Intermediate Examination; if there is any exemption paper(s), the actual marks obtained in such exempted paper(s) shall be considered.
  • In support of educational qualification(s) and experience(s) all documents are to be arranged in chronological order in a single PDF file and to be uploaded.
  • Candidates are requested to ensure that only legible self-attested documents are uploaded.
  • Scrutiny of applications for short listing of candidates will be based on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of registration/submission of application through online mode.
  • Before registering/applying online, the candidates should ensure that they have a valid email ID, which should remain valid till the selection of trainee process is completed.
  • After submitting the application through online mode, a Registration-Cum-Application Form will be generated, which candidates are required to take print out of and submit along with copies of other uploaded documents at the time of certificate verification.
  • No manual/paper applications will be entertained directly.

General/OBC/EWS Candidates Rs.500/- (Application Fee)

  • Candidates can opt to pay through internet banking account/UPI/debit card.
  • Application fee/Processing Fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • Payment to be made through State Bank Collect (SBI Collect) portal.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 30/12/2025
Opening of Online Submission of Application 02/01/2026 (10 AM)
Last Date of Deposit of Application/Processing Fees through SBI Collect 22/01/2026 (4 PM)
Last Date of Submission of Online Application 22/01/2026 (5 PM)
Upper Age Limit (as on) 22/01/2026

Selection Process

  • NALCO shall utilize Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering-2025 (GATE-2025) marks for recruitment of Graduate Engineer Trainees (GETs).
  • Candidates must have qualified GATE 2025 examination in relevant discipline. Only GATE-2025 mark is valid for this recruitment process.
  • Based on GATE-2025 marks and organizational requirement, candidates will be short listed for personal interview.
  • The eligible candidates will be called for the interview based on the qualifying marks secured in GATE 2025 discipline wise, category wise in the ratio of 1:10.
  • The final selection of candidates shall be based on marks secured in GATE-2025 and their performance in Personal Interview.
  • The weightages assigned to GATE marks and Personal Interview are 90% and 10% respectively.
  • Candidates shall be eligible to apply provided they have appeared in GATE-2025 in relevant GATE papers: Mechanical Engineering (ME), Electrical Engineering (EE), Chemical Engineering (CH).

General Information/Instructions

  • All Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Reservations/relaxations for SC/ST/Ex Servicemen/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD (degree of disability 40% or above) candidates as per Government guidelines are applicable.
  • Only such PwBD category candidates would be eligible to get the applicable benefit of reservation/concessions in whose case specified disability is not less than 40%.
  • The OBC candidates who belong to "Creamy Layer" are not entitled for concession admissible to OBC category and such candidates have to indicate their category as UR.
  • The OBC(NCL) candidates are required to submit requisite certificate in prescribed format from a Competent Authority issued in the financial year 2025-26.
  • The EWS candidates are required to submit requisite Income and Assets Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in prescribed format, which should be valid for FY 2025-26.
  • The selected candidates at the time of joining will be required to sign a contract of apprenticeship and execute a service agreement bond of Rs.3,00,000/- or Rs.4,00,000/- (for training imparted abroad) on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.1500/- to serve the Company for a minimum period of 4 years after successful completion of one year training.
  • The candidates seeking employment in NALCO need to be medically fit as per NALCO's norms and standards for medical fitness.
  • As per the training policy of the Company, selected candidates shall undergo one-year on-the-job training. During the training period and/or after absorption, candidates may be posted at any of the unit/office of NALCO in India or abroad.
  • Candidates working in PSU/Govt. organizations are required to produce NOC at the time of interview or submit 'Relieving order' at the time of joining, if selected.
  • The e-mail id entered in the online application form must remain valid for minimum one year. All future communication with candidates will take place through e-mail only.
  • No manual/paper application will be entertained.
  • NALCO reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards. The management reserves the right to fill or not to fill or partly fill any of the above positions without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Canvassing by a candidate in any form shall disqualify their candidature.
  • Candidates are advised to visit the career section of NALCO website www.nalcoindia.com regularly for latest updates.
  • Any dispute with regard to recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Cuttack only.
  • A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only. Candidates applying for more than one post/discipline will not be considered at all.

How to Apply

  • Go to Career Page of NALCO at www.nalcoindia.com.
  • Read the Advertisement carefully to be sure about the eligibility.
  • Click "Apply Now" and register yourself with correct credentials.
  • Fill up the online application form with required details and proceed step by step.
  • At Step 4 of online application, click on Pay Application fee through SBI Collect which will redirect you to State Bank Collect page of SBI.
  • Select "Odisha" under the State of the Corporate/Institution and "PSU- Public Sector Undertaking" under type of Corporate/Institution.
  • Select "NATIONAL ALUMINIUM COMPANY LTD" under PSU- Public Sector Undertaking.
  • Select Payment Category and choose "GET Rectt- GATE 2025 (For UR/OBC/EWS)" or "GET Rectt- GATE 2025 (For SC/ST/ PwBD /DEPTT.)" as applicable.
  • Fill the GATE Registration Number, Name, Discipline, Category, Date of Birth, Registered Email Id and Mobile No. as required on the Payment portal and submit.
  • Payment may be made using any one of the options available: Net Banking/Debit Card/UPI.
  • On successful payment, one e-receipt will be generated in PDF format with SB Collect Reference Number. Note down the Reference Number for Step-4 of online application process.
  • Upload the scanned copy of recent passport size colour photograph, signature which are identical to that submitted along with GATE-2025 application, GATE-2025 admit card, GATE-2025 score card and SBI collect copy.
  • Candidates will be provided opportunity to edit their application form before final submission. Check the application form once again and click on Final Submission.
  • After submission of online application, take a print out of the said application for future reference.
  • Ensure that GATE-2025 registration number and name are filled up correctly as appearing in GATE-2025 admit card.
  • On successful submission, a unique application number will be generated and sent to the registered email Id as well as mobile number.

Zilla Swasthya Samiti Ganjam Recruitment 2025 for 14 posts of Medical Officer. Candidates with MBBS Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in on 06-01-2026. For detailed information please visit Zilla Swasthya Samiti Ganjam official website, ganjam.odisha.gov.in.

Zilla Swasthya Samiti, Ganjam has announced the Recruitment 2026 drive for multiple Medical Officer positions under the National Health Mission (NHM), Ganjam district. The recruitment aims to fill roles including Medical Officer (SNCU), Senior Medical Officer (NTEP), and Medical Officer (UAAM), with total vacancies reaching 14 posts. Eligible candidates with MBBS or MD/Diploma qualifications can attend the walk-in interview on the last date, January 6, 2026.

The positions offer a consolidated monthly salary ranging from ₹66,309 to ₹68,892, plus performance incentives. The maximum age limit for candidates is 70 years as of November 30, 2025. The selection process is based purely on a walk-in interview process to be held at the Office Chamber of the CDM&PHO, Ganjam. Candidates must bring all original and self-attested documents for verification at the time of the interview.

Post Name Medical Officer (SNCU, NTEP, UAAM)
No of Posts 14 (Total across all posts)
Salary ₹66,309/- to ₹68,892/- p.m. + PI
Qualification MBBS from MCI/NMC recognized institution + OCMR registration
Age Limit Min: 21 years; Max: Below 70 years (as on 30.11.2025)
Start Date for Apply  18/12/2025
Last Date for Apply  06/01/2026 (Walk-in Date)
Official Website https://ganjam.odisha.gov.in

Vacancy Details

A total of 14 vacancies are available for Medical Officer positions under NHM Ganjam, including 2 for SNCU, 1 for NTEP, and 11 for UAAM across various locations.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates need an MBBS from an MCI/NMC recognized institution and valid OCMR registration for all posts. Specific experience or additional qualifications are required depending on the post: 2 years post-qualification experience or MD/Diploma for SNCU, and specific experience/MD/Diploma/MPH for NTEP.

Salary/Stipend

The monthly salary varies by post, ranging from ₹66,309/- to ₹68,892/-, plus Performance Incentive (PI).

Age Limit (as on 30-11-2025)

The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum is below 70 years. Candidates over 65 must provide a physical fitness certificate during the interview.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 18/12/2025
Walk-in Interview Date 06/01/2026
Interview/Registration Time 11:30 A.M.
Age & Eligibility Cut-off Date 30/11/2025

Selection Process

Selection is based on a walk-in interview (Viva-Voice Test). A panel of candidates scoring 50% or more will be valid for one year to fill future vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Positions are temporary and co-terminus with the NHM scheme.
  • In-service candidates need a 'No Objection Certificate' (NOC).
  • Late arrivals or incomplete applications will result in disqualification/rejection.
  • Updates will be posted on the district website: https://ganjam.odisha.gov.in.

How To Apply

Attend the walk-in interview on 06.01.2026 at 11:30 A.M. at the Office Chamber of CDM&PHO, Ganjam. Download the application form from the official website and bring it along with required documents: two passport photos, original and self-attested copies of certificates (age, qualification, experience), ID proof, and NOC for in-service candidates.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.
