Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Assistant W6 34
Total Vacancies 132

Note: Out of 34 Assistant posts, 2 posts are reserved for PwBD category. CSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies as per requirement.

Eligibility Criteria for CSL Workmen 2025

1. Educational Qualification

For Senior Ship Draftsman (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation):

  • Three year Diploma in relevant Engineering discipline from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum two years post qualification experience as Ship Draftsman or Draftsman in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Ship Design Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Experience in 3D modeling software like Tribon, CADMATIC or CAD software

For Junior Technical Assistant (Mechanical):

  • Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of mechanical systems in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Experience in HVAC, Fire Fighting System, Cranes, Air Compressors, Pumps, Piping systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Electrical):

  • Three year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of electrical systems
  • Desirable: Experience in PLC/SCADA/DCS Systems, HT/LT switchgear panels, power management systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Electronics):

  • Three year Diploma in Electronics Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in installation and commissioning of control systems and electronic systems
  • Desirable: Experience in electronics systems manufacturing, microprocessor based embedded systems, wireless communication systems

For Junior Technical Assistant (Civil):

  • Three year Diploma in Civil Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in civil construction, maintenance of infrastructure projects, and must be computer savvy

For Junior Technical Assistant (Instrumentation):

  • Three year Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering from State Board of Technical Education with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Instrumentation works in Shipyard or Engineering Company and must be computer savvy

For Laboratory Assistant (Mechanical):

  • Essential: Three year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Metallurgical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Desirable: Radiographer Certificate Level-1 from BARC or PCN/ISNT/ASNT Level II qualification in four NDT methods
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Testing Laboratory or Quality Control activities

For Laboratory Assistant (Chemical):

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc) in Chemistry from recognized University with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in Metal/Water/Oil/Fuel/Paint testing Lab preferably NABL Accredited
  • Desirable: Experience in handling instruments like Optical Emission Spectrometer, Mass Spectrometer, Gas Chromatograph

For Storekeeper:

  • Graduate with Post Graduate Diploma in Materials Management OR Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical or Electrical)
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in storekeeping in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Exposure in materials management and ERP packages

For Assistant:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Arts (other than Fine Arts/Performing Arts) or Science or Commerce or Computer Applications or Business Administration with minimum 60% marks
  • Minimum four years post qualification experience in office work, ERP system, data entry, record maintenance in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Commercial Organization, Government or Semi-Government Company
  • Desirable: Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Tally, SAP

Important Note: Applicants with higher qualifications like B.Tech, M.Sc etc. without prescribed diploma qualification shall not be considered.

Age Limit for CSL Workmen 2025

The age limit for CSL Workmen Category Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 12/01/2026 (Candidates should be born on or after 13/01/1991)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years for reserved posts
  • Age Relaxation for SC: 5 years for reserved posts
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Storekeeper & Assistant posts): As per Government of India guidelines (Maximum age after all relaxations: 45 years for UR, 48 years for OBC, 50 years for SC)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-servicemen: As per Government of India guidelines (Maximum 45 years after relaxation)

Salary/Stipend for CSL Workmen Category 2025

The selected candidates will receive the following monthly emoluments as on date:

Pay Scale Basic Pay DA (51.80%) HRA (20%) Conveyance Allowance Total
W6 Rs.22,500 Rs.11,655 Rs.4,500 Rs.2,400 Rs.41,055
W7 Rs.23,500 Rs.12,173 Rs.4,700 Rs.2,400 Rs.42,773

Pay Scale Range:

  • W6 Pay Scale: Rs.22,500 - Rs.73,750
  • W7 Pay Scale: Rs.23,500 - Rs.77,000

Other Benefits:

  • New Pension Scheme
  • Contributory Provident Fund
  • Gratuity
  • Accident Insurance Coverage
  • Medical Assistance Scheme
  • Post-Retirement Medical Assistance Scheme
  • Earned Leave Encashment
  • Working Dress Maintenance Allowance

Selection Process for CSL Workmen 2025

For Senior Ship Draftsman Posts:

  • Phase I: Objective Type Online Test - 70 marks (75 minutes duration)
  • Phase II: Practical Test in CAD - 30 marks
  • Total Marks: 100 marks
  • Minimum Pass Marks: 50% for UR/EWS, 45% for OBC, 40% for SC (in each phase separately)

For Junior Technical Assistant, Laboratory Assistant, Storekeeper & Assistant Posts:

  • Part 1: Objective Type Online Test - 70 marks (75 minutes duration)
  • Part 2: Descriptive Type Online Test - 30 marks (60 minutes duration)
  • Total Marks: 100 marks
  • Minimum Pass Marks: 50% for UR/EWS, 45% for OBC, 40% for SC/PwBD (in each test separately)

Test Pattern for Senior Ship Draftsman:

  • General Knowledge: 5 marks
  • General English: 5 marks
  • Reasoning: 5 marks
  • Quantitative Aptitude: 5 marks
  • Discipline Related: 50 marks

Test Pattern for Other Posts:

  • Objective Test: General Knowledge (5), Reasoning (5), Quantitative Aptitude (5), General English (5), Discipline Related (50)
  • Descriptive Test: Discipline Related (30 marks)

Important Notes:

  • No negative marking in the examination
  • Online tests will be conducted at various centers in Kerala
  • CSL reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on eligibility requirements
  • Rank list validity: 18 months from the date of last candidate reporting

How To Apply for CSL Workmen Category Recruitment 2025

Eligible candidates can apply online for CSL Workmen Category 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.cochinshipyard.in
  2. Navigate to Career page → CSL, Kochi section
  3. Click on the link for Workmen Category Recruitment 2025
  4. Read the official notification carefully
  5. Click on "Apply Online" link
  6. Complete Registration Phase by providing basic details
  7. Fill in the application form with correct details
  8. Upload required documents (Photo, Signature, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates)
  9. Pay the application fee of Rs.700 online (Exempted for SC/ST/PwBD for Storekeeper & Assistant posts)
  10. Submit the application and note down the unique registration number
  11. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference

Important Instructions:

  • Applicants should apply only for one post as online exams will be conducted simultaneously
  • Do not submit more than one application for the same post
  • Application once submitted shall be final, no changes allowed
  • Ensure all entries are correctly filled before final submission
  • Retain the unique registration number for all future correspondence
  • Do not send application printout or certificates by post
  • Apply well in advance to avoid last minute rush
  • Technical support may not be available after 4:00 PM on last date

Payment Mode:

  • Online payment through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, Wallets, UPI
  • Application fee: Rs.700 (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra)
  • SC/ST candidates exempted from application fee
  • PwBD candidates exempted from application fee for Storekeeper and Assistant posts

  • Staff Nurse - Palliative Care: Rs. 20,500/- per month
  • Audiologist cum Speech Therapist (MIU) / Audiologist (NPPCD): Rs. 30,000/- per month
  • Female Counsellor-GBVMC(Bhoomika): Rs. 20,500/- per month

  • Female Counsellor-GBVMC(Bhoomika): Below 40 years

  • Mode of Payment: Demand Draft (DD) in favor of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", Payable at Thiruvananthapuram
  • Note: Original DD must be submitted along with the printed application form

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 22/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 22/12/2025
Last Date for Online Application Submission 03/01/2026 (Saturday by 5:00 PM)
Last Date for Submission of Documents by Post/Person 06/01/2026 (Tuesday by 5:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date 01/12/2025

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates will only be based on prescribed qualification, experience and performance in test/interview
  • Selection will be as per the Circular No: NHM/4827/ADMN1/2019/SPMSU dated 28.10.2019
  • The vacancies are for immediate requirement and the society may prioritize the interview for different category of posts, on the basis of requirements
  • Candidates may be required to produce the originals at the time of interview/certificate verification process
  • All selected candidates will be governed by Rules and Regulations of NHM in force from time to time

General Information/Instructions

  • The applications are to be submitted through nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in websites. Only such applications will be considered
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
  • Selected candidates will have to enter into a contract with the District Health and Family Welfare Society (Arogyakeralam) Thiruvananthapuram District
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on contract basis initially for a period of three months only
  • The District Health & Family Welfare Society (Arogyakeralam) may at its discretion, based on the performance and integrity of the successful candidate, may extend the period of contract
  • Candidate should be willing to work in any institution in Thiruvananthapuram District as decided by the Society
  • Claims in respect of qualifications/experience etc. should be supported by copies of relevant documents
  • No TA/DA will be paid for the interview
  • All communications from the Society will be intimated to the candidates through e-mail
  • Candidates are advised to check the website "nhmtvm.com" or arogyakeralam.gov.in regularly for updates/notices and announcements
  • The posts are temporary in nature during the period of the operation of the Mission and no claim for permanency of job or labour claims to the NHM, DHS or the Government
  • Canvasing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification
  • The copy of the appointment letters, Salary certificate, Pay slips etc. will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificate
  • The Post Applied should be mentioned on the envelope as "Application for the post of ..........................."
  • The DPM, Thiruvananthapuram will have the authority to reject the applications at any time during the course of the selection process without assigning any reason thereon, if details or information furnished by the candidate are found to be incomplete, insufficient and misguided

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in
  • Fill the online application form (Google form) with all required details
  • Submit the online application on or before 03/01/2026 Saturday by 5:00 PM
  • Take a printout of the duly filled application form
  • Obtain a Demand Draft of Rs. 350/- in favor of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", Payable at Thiruvananthapuram
  • Attach the following documents:
    • Printout of duly filled application form (Google form)
    • Original DD of Rs. 350/-
    • Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents supporting qualifications and experience
  • Mention the post applied for on the envelope as "Application for the post of ..........................."
  • Submit or send the documents by person or post to: The District Programme Manager, Arogyakeralam (NHM), DPM Office, W&C Hospital Compound, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram-14
  • Ensure the documents reach the office on or before 06/01/2026 Tuesday by 5:00 PM
  • Keep checking the official website regularly for updates, notices and announcements

General Information/Instructions

  • The applicants must be citizens of India
  • The advertised posts are as per Central Government pay scales in accordance with the 7th CPC and carry the usual allowances such as DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, etc
  • The advertised posts are covered under the New Pension Scheme (NPS) of the National Pension System with benefits such as Medical Reimbursement, LTC, etc., as per Government of India norms
  • Age relaxation shall be applicable as per the Government of India rules
  • For Institute employees, there shall be no upper age limit. However, they must have at least one year of remaining service from the closing date of application submission until the date of superannuation
  • The qualifications, experience claimed, and age limit prescribed will be considered as on the closing date of online submission of the application
  • Apprenticeship, training, and similar engagements will not be counted as experience
  • The prescribed qualifications and experience are minimum requirements. Mere possession of the same shall not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for further stages of selection. If the number of applications received is large, the Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the selection process based on higher qualifications/experience in Government sectors and/ or other criteria. Applicants are advised to furnish and upload complete details of all qualifications and experience. Self-attested copies of the supporting documents along with copy of online application must be sent by post within the due date
  • Experience certificates must be issued on the organization’s letterhead and clearly mention the post held, nature of duties, period of employment, and pay scale/level. The certificate must bear the date, signature, name, and seal of the issuing authority
  • Claims of equivalent pay will be computed based on the initial pay in Cell 1 of the relevant 7th CPC pay level or the minimum pay of the corresponding Central Government pay scale applicable during the claimed period. Candidates must submit an equivalency certificate issued by their present employer. Candidates serving under IDA pay pattern must ensure that the certificate explicitly states the corresponding Central Government pay level
  • Candidates must disclose details of any penalties/punishments imposed on them or any disciplinary/inquiry proceedings initiated against them
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) must upload the relevant Disability Certificate issued as per the PwD Act, 1995 and the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
  • Applications must be submitted online along with documents supporting educational qualifications and experience, as per instructions provided in the portal. Incomplete applications or those unsupported by relevant documents will be summarily rejected. Online applications will be considered only if the hard copies reach the Institute on or before the last date
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs must apply through proper channel and upload the No Objection Certificate (NOC) and Vigilance Clearance Certificate (VCC) issued by their current employer. They may, however, send advance copies of the application with all enclosures. The NOC and VCC must be produced at the time of Written Test and/or Interview; failing which, the candidature will be rejected
  • As an Institute of National Importance, IISER TVM promotes inclusive and equitable opportunities for all Indian citizens. Candidates from across the country are encouraged to apply. Female candidates are particularly encouraged as the Institute promotes gender diversity
  • Application fee: Rs.1000 for Group A posts (Sl. No. 01 to 07) Rs. 500 for Group B & C posts (Sl. No. 07 to 10) Fee must be paid online. Fee once paid will not be refunded.SC/ST, PwD, Women, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment of fee; proof must be uploaded
  • Applications that are incomplete, not accompanied by required documents/photograph/application fee, or submitted after the deadline will be summarily rejected
  • If any information furnished by a candidate is found to be false/incorrect at any stage, the candidature/appointment will be cancelled/ terminated
  • The Institute reserves the absolute right to cancel/withdraw/not fill any or all advertised posts at any stage of the recruitment process without assigning any reason. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard
  • The decision of the competent authority shall be final and binding in all matters of recruitment, including eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications or experience, shortlisting criteria, and selection methodology
  • Canvassing or bringing any influence in any form shall lead to disqualification
  • The list of shortlisted candidates for Written Test/Interview will be published on the Institute website. Successful candidates will also be notified by email. No other communication will be issued. Hence, candidates must provide a functional email ID and mobile number and regularly check the Institute website for updates
  • Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents in support of claims regarding reservation, educational qualification, date of birth, experience, etc., prior to the selection process. Candidates not producing the required original documents will not be permitted to participate
  • In the case of a tie in the marks obtained in the written examination, the candidate senior in age shall be placed higher in merit, as per Government of India norms
  • No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the selection process

  • Interested candidates may apply online under ‘Openings’ at the Institute website

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register and create a User ID and Password for online application on the Institute website. Online applications can be submitted until 17:00 hrs on 05.01.2026
  • Step 2: Fill the online application form completely and submit it online. The form consists of six stages. You may save and edit before final submission. No changes are permitted after final submission
  • Step 3: After submission, the payment gateway will open for payment of fee (Rs.1000 for Group A; Rs.500 for Group B & C posts). Fee is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Women/Ex-Servicemen candidates. Follow payment instructions carefully. Applications without fee payment will not be accepted

Email confirmation will also be received. In case of deduction but unsuccessful transaction, recheck status after 30 minutes. For payment issues, write to [email protected]
  • Step 4: Send the hard copy of the completed application along with self-attested copies of certificates for educational qualifications, date of birth, experience, and category claims through Registered/Speed Post in a sealed cover super scribed: "Application for the post of ________________________, Post Code ____________" on or before 17:00 hrs on 12.01.2026 to the following address: Hard copy of applications for each post to be sent separately, if a candidate applies for more than one post. BEML Limited has announced a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST and OBC candidates, aiming to fill 50 backlog vacancies across various positions in Group A, Group B, and Group C categories. The recruitment includes roles such as Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer, Asst. Engineer, Diploma Trainee, and Office Assistant Trainee.

Candidates applying for these positions must meet specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications such as a First Class full-time Engineering Degree, MBA, CA/ICWA, or a Diploma for certain posts. The salary scales range from ₹90,000 to ₹2,40,000 for higher positions like Dy. General Manager and Asst. General Manager, while Diploma Trainees will receive a stipend ranging from ₹17,000 to ₹25,500 depending on the contract year. Advertisement
Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.

  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.

  • Upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates of all categories subject to equivalent years of excess PQE, within the maximum limit of 57 years.

Application Fee

  • Eligible and interested OBC candidates applying for the above positions (not applicable for SC/ST/PwDs) must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee payment link is provided at the end of the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 03/12/2025 (Advt. No. KP/S/28/2025).
Crucial Date for Age, Qualification & Experience 07/01/2026.
Last Date for Online Registration 07/01/2026 up to 18:00 Hrs (online registration site available till this date and time).

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment based on eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD etc.).
  • Based on assessment, shortlisted candidates must undergo pre-employment medical examination and original document verification; appointment is subject to meeting medical standards and satisfactory medical report.

  • For post codes L036, L037, L038 and L039, selection will be based on written exam at Bangalore (to & fro fares reimbursed based on eligibility) assessing domain ability (not for L039), reasoning ability, general awareness and English ability.
  • Merely meeting conditions of advertisement does not entitle a candidate to be called for assessment; Screening Committee may adopt its own criteria for shortlisting.
  • Only candidates meeting all eligibility norms need apply; receiving call for assessment/interview does not guarantee selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC for Group ‘A’ (9th Attempt), Group ‘B’ & Group ‘C’ (7th Attempt) backlog vacancies.
  • BEML Limited is a multi-technology company under Ministry of Defence with core sectors Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining & Construction; the drive is aligned with expansion initiatives like Vande Bharat sleeper trains, Metro coaches, high mobility vehicles, special application engines, AI-based mining equipment etc.
  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, qualification & experience are counted as on 07/01/2026; First Class is 60% aggregate (relaxable for SC/ST & PwD).
  • Candidates must upload all required documents (10th, 12th, degree/diploma, mark sheets with conversion formula, PG certificates, ID proof, caste/PwD certificates, experience letters, latest pay slip, detailed resume, current reporting structure) as per checklist; incomplete applications without documents are rejected.

  • No request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, test centre location etc. as declared in online application will be entertained.
  • Any canvassing or influencing related to recruitment/selection will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be hosted only on BEML website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only (mandatory) after going through guidelines and ensuring correctness of data entered.
  • Online application form can be accessed in the career page at www.bemlindia.in; online registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 07th January 2026.
  • Candidates must have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration and further correspondence; change of e-mail or mobile will not be entertained during the recruitment process.
  • A Registration number will be generated and should be noted for all future correspondence.
  • While filling online application, experience section should first list latest experience, followed by previous experiences; a brief pen picture of experience relevant to the position must be written.
  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.
  • Candidates with queries may e-mail [email protected].

  • Age Relaxation for Widows: Up to 5 years will be granted to widows subject to the condition that upper age limit shall not exceed 50 years

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: No application fee is charged for this recruitment
  • Payment Mode: Not Applicable

  • Note: This is a special recruitment for Scheduled Castes candidates with no application fee requirement

Selection Process

    • General Knowledge/Current Affairs - 30 marks
    • Questions to test proficiency in English language - 20 marks
  • Number of Questions: 100 questions, each carrying 1 mark
  • Negative Marking: For every incorrect answer, 1/4 mark will be deducted
  • Interview: Total marks for Interview shall be 10
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidate must secure minimum 35% marks in the Interview to be considered for inclusion in the ranked list
  • Examination Centre: Written Test (if conducted) will be held at Ernakulam

General Information/Instructions

  • This is a No Candidate Available (NCA) recruitment notification exclusively for Scheduled Castes community candidates in Kerala
  • Applications from candidates belonging to other communities will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates must complete One Time Registration before applying for the post
  • All communications will be sent through email and SMS only
  • Candidates should possess a valid email ID which should be kept active
  • Documents in original to prove age, qualification, community etc. should be produced as and when called for
  • The Caste/Community Certificate which is valid on the date of closure of application or on the date of certificate verification shall be produced to claim reservation benefits
  • Differently abled candidates claiming age relaxation shall produce Job oriented physical and functionality certification as per G.O.(P) No. 5/2023/SJD dated 01.10.2023
  • Government employees must obtain No Objection Certificate/Service Certificate from their Head of Office
  • Candidates should ensure they fulfill eligibility norms before applying
  • Furnishing incorrect/false information or suppression of material facts will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature
  • High Court reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage
  • Decisions of High Court regarding eligibility and selection would be final and binding

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Scrutiny of online applications and uploaded documents
  • Stage 2: Written Test (if conducted) - Objective type examination covering Diploma in Electronics syllabus, General Knowledge and English proficiency
  • Stage 3: Interview for shortlisted candidates - Assessment of technical knowledge, communication skills, and suitability for the post
  • Stage 4: Document Verification - Verification of all original certificates including educational qualifications, caste certificate, experience certificate
  • Stage 5: Medical Examination (if required) - Fitness certificate from competent medical authority
  • Final Selection: Preparation of ranked list based on performance in written test (if conducted) and interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official Recruitment Portal of High Court of Kerala at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in
  • Step 2: Complete "One Time Registration" using "One Time Registration Login" link
  • Step 3: Keep ready scanned images of:
    • Passport size photograph (face and shoulder clearly visible, white/light colored background)
    • Signature
    • Plus Two or equivalent certificate
    • Diploma in Electronics certificate
    • Experience certificate (in prescribed format)
    • Scheduled Castes certificate
    • Any other relevant documents
  • Step 4: After logging into profile, select "My Profile" option and enter required details
  • Step 5: Select "Upload Documents" option and upload all qualification documents
  • Step 6: Ensure documents are properly scanned and legible
  • Step 7: Preview uploaded documents before submitting (once submitted, documents cannot be re-uploaded or deleted)
  • Step 8: Once documents are uploaded, select "Apply Now" option from dashboard
  • Step 9: Fill in the online application form with accurate details:
    • Personal information
    • Educational qualifications
    • Experience details
    • Community information (SC certificate details)
    • Language proficiency details
    • Contact details
  • Step 10: Check preview of application before final submission
  • Step 11: Submit the application (no changes can be made after submission)
  • Step 12: Take printout/save soft copy of submitted application for future reference
  • Step 13: Do not send printout to High Court (keep for personal records only)
  • Important: Candidates will be called for Written Test (if conducted) only after scrutiny of uploaded documents
  • Note: Read notification and "How to apply" instructions carefully before applying

ESIC Kerala Recruitment 2025

Advertisement

Employees State Insurance Corporation Model and Super Specialty Hospital (ESIC Kerala) Recruitment 2025 for 22 posts of Specialist, Senior Resident and Other. Candidates with DNB, PG Diploma, MS/MD, M.Ch, DM Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in interview on 07-01-2026. For detailed information please visit ESIC Kerala official website, esic.gov.in.

Important Dates 

Event Date

Date of Walk-in Interview 07/01/2026, Wednesday
Registration Time 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM
Reporting Time 09:00 AM
Venue Conference Hall, ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam

ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 Overview

Company Name Employees' State Insurance Corporation Model and Super Specialty Hospital Asramam (ESIC Hospital Asramam)
Post Name Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time), Specialist (Full Time/Part Time), Senior Resident
No of Posts 22 Posts
Salary Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 2,40,000/- per month
Qualification MBBS with MCh/DM/DNB (Super Specialist), PG Degree/Diploma (Specialist/Senior Resident)
Age Limit Up to 69 years (Super Specialist/Specialist), Up to 45 years (Senior Resident)
Walk-in Interview Date 07/01/2026
Official Website www.esic.gov.in

ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 is 22 posts. The post-wise and category-wise vacancy distribution is as follows:

1. Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time) - 1 Post

Department No. of Vacancy Category
Endocrinology 1 SC-1
Total 1 Post

2. Specialist (Full Time/Part Time) - 6 Posts

Department No. of Vacancy Category
General Medicine 1 OBC-1
ICU 2 SC-1, OBC-1
Anaesthesiology 1 SC-1
Casualty (A&E) 2 OBC-2
Total 6 Posts

3. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11) - 15 Posts

Department No. of Vacancy Category
Cardiology 1 EWS-1
Nephrology 1 OBC-1
Anaesthesiology 3 SC-1, UR-1, OBC-1
General Surgery 1 SC-1
ICU 2 UR-1, SC-1
General Medicine 3 UR-1, OBC-1, ST-1
Obstetrics & Gynaecology 1 SC-1
Paediatrics 3 OBC-1, SC-1, ST-1
Total 15 Posts

Grand Total: 22 Posts

Note: In case of non-availability of candidates in the category advertised, the post may be filled for 44 days with UR candidate. Vacancies indicated may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview.

Eligibility Criteria for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Entry Level)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Entry Level: No specific experience mentioned

2. Super Specialist (Senior Consultant)

Essential Qualifications:

  • A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956)
  • MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned Super specialty
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Candidates with at least five years post super specialty qualification experience will be considered for engagement as Consultant (Senior Level)

3. Specialist (Junior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned speciality after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Three years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Five years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

4. Specialist (Senior)

Essential Qualifications:

  • Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma after MBBS with TCMC registration
  • For Casualty/ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine and registered with Medical Council
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • Five years experience in respective specialty for degree holders, OR
  • Seven years experience in respective specialty for Diploma holders

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

Essential Qualifications:

  • For Superspeciality departments: DM/DrNB in concerned superspeciality is preferred over MD/DNB in General Medicine
  • For Specialty departments: Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned specialty after MBBS with TCMC registration is required
  • For ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Critical care medicine and registered with Medical Council is required
  • All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council

Experience:

  • No specific experience mentioned for Senior Resident

Salary/Stipend for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

1. Super Specialist (Full Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 2,00,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Senior Level: Rs. 2,40,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency calls and visit as and when required
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

2. Super Specialist (Part Time)

  • Entry Level: Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,200/- for additional every hour, beyond 16 hours subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Consultant (Sr. Level): Rs. 1,50,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 20,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 1,500/- for every additional hour work beyond 16 hours (4 days × 4 hours) a week subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration revisable as per ESIC Headquarters instruction from time to time

3. Specialist (Full Time)

  • Junior Specialist (Level 11): Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Senior Specialist (Level 12): Rs. 1,60,752/- per month (Approximate amount as per HQ instruction dated 08.12.2022)
  • Working Hours: 09:00 AM to 04:00 PM on weekdays and 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Should attend emergency call as and when it is required
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

4. Specialist (Part Time)

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month
  • Additional Rs. 15,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing)
  • Rs. 800/- for additional every hour beyond 16 hours, subject to the justification of competent authority
  • Working Hours: 4 hours session per day × four days in a week (16 hours)
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • Remuneration Revisable as per ESIC HQ instruction from time to time

5. Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Total Emoluments (Level 11 as per VIIth CPC): Approximately Rs. 1,38,108/- per month (For PG Degree holders)
  • An amount of Rs. 1,350/- will be deducted for SRs who possess only Diploma
  • Contract Duration: One year contract or till regular incumbent joins whichever is earlier
  • To work as per ESIC norms for Senior Residency
  • Remuneration will be paid as per orders issued by ESIC Headquarters from time to time

Age Limit (as on 07/01/2026)

Super Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Specialist (Full Time/Part Time)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed
  • No minimum age specified

Senior Resident (Pay Level 11)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview (07/01/2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation for SC, ST & OBC as per rules
  • No minimum age specified

Application Fee for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

Category Application Fee
General & OBC Candidates Rs. 250/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty only)
SC/ST Candidates Rs. 50/- (Rupees Fifty only)
PWD/Female Applicants Exempted (No Fee)

Mode of Payment:

  • Application fee to be paid by way of Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • The Demand Draft should be submitted at the time of interview along with application form

Selection Process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

The selection process for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025 will be based on the following criteria:

  • Walk-in Interview: The selection will be based on qualification, experience & interview
  • The interview will be conducted at ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on 07/01/2026
  • Candidates will be assessed based on their educational qualifications, post-qualification experience, and performance in the personal interview
  • All original documents will be verified at the time of interview
  • Only shortlisted candidates based on qualification and experience will be called for final selection
  • The decision of the interview committee will be final and binding

General Information and Instructions for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

  • The applicants should bring along application in the prescribed proforma, all original documents including caste certificate (if applicable), one set of Xerox copies of all original documents, two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application) and the requisite application fee in the form of demand draft at the time of interview
  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will not be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Those who belong to OBC/SC/ST category should produce valid caste certificate issued by the Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer
  • OBC certificate should be in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions which should certify that the candidates do not belong to Creamy layer
  • EWS certificate must be valid and issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer in the prescribed form as per Government of India instructions
  • Candidates applying in PWD Category must possess disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions
  • Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institutions are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident
  • Private practice of any kind will not be allowed except for Part time Superspecialists/Part time Specialists
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for Interview
  • Vacancies indicated may change as per actual requirement on the date of interview
  • Canvassing in any form shall be a disqualification
  • The Selected Specialist/Super Specialist must have a professional indemnity policy which should cover the period of contractual engagement. The policy is meant to cover professional liability falling on them as a result of error and omissions committed by them while rendering professional services
  • The minimum sum assured per annum should be:
    • Rs. 30 lakh for Anesthesiologists, Cardiac Surgeons, Neuro Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons etc.
    • Rs. 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, Gynecologists, Obstetricians etc.
    • Rs. 10 lakhs for Physicians, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc.
  • A copy of the Insurance & Premium and receipt must be submitted within 7 days from the date of engagement
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to terminate the service of appointee at any time even before the tenure without assigning any reason by giving one month notice or immediately in case of any disciplinary action
  • Similarly, the engaged person will have to give one month prior notice before resigning or will have to pay an amount equivalent to one month's remuneration in lieu of the notice period
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the offer/advertisement without assigning any reason thereof
  • In case of selection, the candidate has to enter into an agreement with Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model & Super specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 200/-
  • The selected candidate has to submit a security deposit of Rs 15,000/- as DD in favour of ESIC Account No 2 payable at Kollam at the time of joining, which is refundable after successful completion of contract & production of no-due certificate
  • In case of applicants who are working in Central government/State government institutions, NOC should be obtained from the authority concerned and to be submitted in due course
  • Part time Engagement of one contractual employee in two ESIC hospital at the same time shall not be permissible
  • PWD candidate will be selected against suitable/notified posts as per government rules
  • The hospital is in the process of getting accreditation for conducting in house DNB training courses in various specialities

How to Apply for ESIC Hospital Asramam Recruitment 2025

This is a Walk-in Interview process. Candidates need to follow these steps:

  • Step 1: Download the official notification from ESIC website: https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments
  • Step 2: Download the application form (Annexure 1) from the notification PDF
  • Step 3: Fill the application form completely in CAPITAL LETTERS ONLY with all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Date of Birth, Category, Age)
    • Educational Qualification details with Year of passing, University, and Percentage of Marks
    • Experience details with Name of Hospital, Post Held, Period (From-To), Total Period
    • MCI Registration Number and Name of Medical Council
    • Present and Permanent Address
    • Contact Number & Email ID
    • Place where presently working
    • Particulars of DD (Number and Date)
  • Step 4: Affix one recent passport-size photograph on the application form
  • Step 5: Prepare Demand Draft for application fee:
    • Rs. 250/- for General/OBC candidates
    • Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates
    • PWD/Female candidates are exempted
    • DD should be drawn in favour of "Employees' State Insurance Fund – Account No 1" payable at Kollam
  • Step 6: Prepare all required documents in original and one set of self-attested Xerox copies:
    • MBBS Degree certificate
    • MCI/Central Council Registration Certificate (For basic and additional Qualifications)
    • Matriculation certificate in support of Date of Birth
    • PG Degree/Diploma Certificate (Qualification prescribed for the post)
    • Experience Certificate
    • Caste Certificate and Non creamy layer certificate, if applicable
    • PWD Certificate, if applicable
    • LPC/No Due Certificate from previous employer, if applicable
    • Any other relevant document
    • 2 Passport Size Photos
  • Step 7: Report to the interview venue on 07/01/2026 at 09:00 AM
  • Step 8: Registration will be done from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM at Conference Hall, ESIC Model and Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam
  • Step 9: Submit the filled application form along with all original documents, one set of Xerox copies, two passport-size photographs, and Demand Draft at the registration counter
  • Step 10: Attend the interview as per the schedule

Important Notes:

  • Application forms, printing, or photocopying facilities will NOT be provided at the interview venue under any circumstances
  • Candidates must bring their own filled application form and all documents
  • Late arrivals after registration time may not be entertained
  • Check the official website regularly for any corrigenda or updates

IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM Kozhikode)

Start Date for Apply  12 December 2025
Last Date for Apply  12 January 2026 (Online); 21 January 2026 (Hard Copy)
Official Website www.IIM Kozhikode.ac.in

IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

S.No. Post Name (Post Code) Total Post Count
1. Chief Manager (Infrastructure) (CMI) 01
2. Manager (MGR) 01
3. Assistant Administrative Officer (AAO) 03
4. Junior Engineer (Electrical) (JEE) 02

6. Assistant (ASST) 05
7. Accountant (ACC) 01

9. Junior Accountant (JACC) 01
Grand Total   17

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications (Chief Manager): M.E. / M.Tech in Civil Engineering with experience in CAD / CAM & Automated Project Management Systems. 15 years experience in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Manager): Graduation in any discipline. 12 years relevant administrative experience in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Asst Administrative Officer/Assistant/Junior Assistant): Graduation in any discipline with relevant administrative/clerical experience in specified pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Junior Engineer): 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engg (8 yrs experience) OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engg (3 yrs experience) in relevant pay levels.
  • Qualifications (Library & Info Asst): Bachelor's Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science or equivalent. 6 years relevant experience.
  • Qualifications (Accountant/Junior Accountant): b.com/Inter-CA/Inter-ICWA with 6/5 years relevant post qualification experience in specified pay levels.
  • Relevant experience means experience in administrative/office clerical matters, preferably in Central/State Govt. Service or academic institutions.
  • Experience should not include Apprenticeship and Training of any form.

Salary/Stipend

  • Chief Manager (Level-13): Rs. 123100-215900 (Gross Pay: Rs. 2.25 Lakh/month appx.).
  • Manager (Level-10): Rs. 56100-177500 (Gross Pay: Rs. 1.00 Lakh/month appx.).
  • Asst Administrative Officer (Level-07): Rs. 44900-142400 (Gross Pay: Rs. 77,000 /month appx.).
  • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant (Level-06): Rs. 35400-112400 (Gross Pay: Rs. 62,000 /month appx.).
  • Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant (Level-04): Rs. 25500-81100 (Gross Pay: Rs. 45,000 /month appx.).

Age Limit (as on 12 January 2026)

  • Chief Manager: Maximum 50 years.
  • Manager: Maximum 45 years.
  • Asst Administrative Officer: Maximum 40 years (OBC(NCL): 43 years).
  • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Accountant/Junior Accountant: Maximum 35 years.
  • Assistant: Maximum 35 years (OBC(NCL): 38 years, SC: 40 years).
  • Junior Assistant: Maximum 35 years (ST: 40 years).
  • Age calculation is as on the last date of online application submission (12 January 2026).
  • Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen/PwD is as per Govt. of India Rules. No upper age limit for departmental candidates holding regular position in IIM Kozhikode.

Application Fee

  • Application fee of Rs. 118/- inclusive of GST is to be paid through an online payment system.
  • There is no application fee for SC/ST/Differently Abled/Women and Departmental Candidates of IIM Kozhikode.
  • Fee once remitted will not be refunded.
  • A separate fee is to be paid for each post if applying for multiple positions.

Selection Process

  • Method of selection:
    • Chief Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Manager: Interview only (at IIM Kozhikode Campus).
    • Assistant Administrative Officer: Written Test only.
    • Junior Engineer/Library Asst/Assistant/Accountant/Junior Assistant/Junior Accountant: Written test only.
  • Shortlisted candidates alone will be called for the selection process.
  • Certificate verification will be part of the selection process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to fix the criteria for selection beyond minimum qualifications.

General Information/Instructions

  • Posts are on a regular basis. Place of posting can be IIM Kozhikode main campus or Kochi campus.
  • Selected candidates will join at the entry pay of the concerned Pay Level; no pay protection benefits.
  • Candidates must not apply for outside employment for the initial three years after joining.
  • Incomplete/unsigned applications and applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

MGU IIRBS Assistant Professor (Physics) 2025 Vacancy Details

The notification invites applications for 1 post of Assistant Professor on Contract in Physics at IIRBS, Mahatma Gandhi University for the academic year 2025–2026. The post is categorized as OC (Open Competition) and is purely on contract basis till the end of the current academic year.

Note: Reservation rotation is mentioned generally; this particular post is marked OC.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

  • Qualifications must be as per UGC norms for Assistant Professor in Physics (IIRBS).
  • Candidates are required to provide:
    – Degree and mark lists (UG & PG in relevant subject),
    – NET/UGC qualification proof (if applicable),
    – Ph.D. details where applicable,
    – Proof that journals are UGC-approved/peer-reviewed and impact factor details for published articles,
    – CGPA to percentage conversion proof if needed.
  • Degrees obtained from Universities/Institutions outside Kerala must be accompanied by equivalency/eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University.

2. Age Limit

  • As per UGC Regulations for appointment of Assistant Professors.
  • Maximum age limit: 70 years as on 01/01/2025, including retired teachers from Colleges/Universities.

3. Other Conditions

  • Reservation rotation is specified against vacancies; candidates applying under community/PH/EWS quota must attach valid certificates.
  • Natives of states other than Kerala are not eligible for posts notified exclusively under community reservation quota (not applicable to this OC post, but stated in general conditions).

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made based on scrutiny of:
    – Educational qualifications and UGC eligibility,
    – Teaching and research experience,
    – Publications and impact factor,
    – Other academic achievements as detailed in the proforma.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be considered as per Mahatma Gandhi University norms; detailed interview process is not described, but selected candidates must execute an agreement with the University.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

How To Apply

  • Download and fill the proforma (application form) attached with the notification for the post of Assistant Professor on Contract at IIRBS.
  • Scan and attach the following original documents:
    – Proof of age and date of birth,
    – Community and Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for community reservation, PH/EWS as applicable),
    – Educational qualification mark lists and degree certificates (UG, PG, Ph.D.),
    – Proof that journals are UGC-approved / peer-reviewed and impact factor details of published articles,
    – Experience certificates,
    – Awards and other additional qualifications,
    – Proof for CGPA to percentage conversion,
    – Equivalency/eligibility certificate for degrees from outside Kerala, if applicable.
  • Email the duly filled proforma and all necessary scanned documents to:
    [email protected]
  • The email subject must be labelled exactly as:
    “Application for the post of Assistant Professor on Contract(Physics) at IIRBS”
  • Applications must reach by email within 15 days from the date of this notification (24/12/2025).
  • Applications without scanned copies of certificates to prove age, community, creamy layer status, qualification, experience, CGPA conversion, impact factor, equivalency/eligibility etc. will be summarily rejected.

  • Finally selected candidates by the department shall be considered for deployment on a purely contractual/outsourced basis for a fixed period or till expiry of contract or till regular incumbents join posts.
  • ICSIL does not guarantee deployment of all shortlisted candidates.
  • No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for appearing for the interaction/documents verification etc.
  • The place of deployment will be anywhere in Delhi/NCR and candidates may work in shift(s)/rotational basis as per departmental requirement; no extra conveyance will be paid by ICSIL.
  • The selection may include personal interview/skill test, or written test, depending on the position.
  • Mere appearance in the walk-in interview does not guarantee selection and the decision of the interview panel/committee shall be final and binding.

General Information/Instructions

  • Interested applicants are advised to go through the Eligibility Criterion carefully and ascertain themselves regarding their eligibility.
  • Candidates must produce original documents in respect of DOB, Qualification and Experience as per eligibility criteria on the date of document verification and interview/interaction; otherwise they will not be allowed to appear in the interview/interaction.
  • Candidates must bring 1 set of photocopies of all relevant documents and 2 photographs.
  • The details of the candidate in the application form must be the same as mentioned in Class 10th Certificate and PAN Card and Aadhar Card; if name is changed after Class 10th, evidence must be furnished at the time of interaction/documents verification.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate; no candidate is permitted to influence the recruitment process by approaching any official of the organization directly or indirectly.
  • ICSIL has right to accept or reject the application(s) without assigning any reason and has the right to withdraw this advertisement at any time without any notice.
  • Incomplete application shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must keep watching the ICSIL website (www.icsil.in) for any corrigendum/notification in respect of this vacancy.
  • If at any stage of recruitment process the documents/information provided by the candidate is found fake or misleading, his/her candidature is liable to be rejected.
  • Fifteen (15) days salary to be deducted from the selected candidate as security in two parts (50% in first month and 50% in second month); this shall be refunded with saving bank interest after receipt of No Dues certificate from client department and after completing contractual liabilities with ICSIL as per appointment letter.
  • The engagement is purely on a contractual/temporary basis for a fixed period and does not guarantee any claim for regular appointment in the organization.
  • The selected candidates will be engaged under specific project/scheme as per departmental requirements and statutory compliances will apply as per the laws of the land.
  • Candidates are expected to maintain professional behaviour during the process; any form of misconduct or indiscipline may result in disqualification.

How to Apply

The basic pension to be deducted from the Last pay drawn shall be pension as fixed at the time of retirement and, as such, if the employee has availed of the commuted value of pension, the commuted portion of pension shall also be included in the portion of pension to be deducted. The amount of remuneration so fixed shall remain unchanged for the term of the contract. No annual increment/percentage increase and Dearness Allowance shall be allowed during the term of the contract.

  • Candidates should ascertain, before applying, that they satisfy all the eligibility conditions as stipulated in the advertisement. Candidates, who do not satisfy the eligibility conditions, will be liable to be disqualified at any stage of recruitment/selection.
  • Application Forms not in the prescribed format or incomplete/unsigned or received without a copy of essential qualification certificates, experience certificates, copy of mark-sheet of Board/ University etc shall not be considered and are liable to be rejected.
  • SAI reserves the right to modify/alter/restrict/enlarge/cancel the recruitment process, if need so arises without issuing any further notice or assigning any further notice any reason thereof.
  • The decision of the SAI will be final and no appeal will be entertained against this issue.

S. No. Post Name Total Posts

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The applicant should possess a higher qualification (Masters’ and above) from a reputed Indian or International Institution/University in Economics, Development Cooperation, Development Partnership, International Relations, International Law, International Development, Strategic Studies, Public Administration, International Trade, Environment and Climate, Trade, Agriculture, Labour Economics, Energy, Health, Disaster Management, Anti corruption or a related subject.
  • The applicant should have one year’s experience as a Consultant in relevant field.
  • The applicant should possess good writing and analytical skills and have experience in policy making and advocacy, including experience in speech writing, analytical writing and preparing negotiation strategy.
  • The applicant must be proficient in use of computers (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
  • The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of applications.

Salary/Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 10 lakh per annum each, with deduction of applicable taxes.
  • The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidates, and no HRA shall be admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.

Age Limit 

  • The applicant should not be more than 35 years of age as on the last date of submission of applications.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Advertisement Date (Advertisement No. Q/PF/575/55/2025) 24/12/2025
Last date for receiving applications 16/01/2026 (up to 17:30 Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/Instructions

  • The period of consultancy is 01 (one) year; the contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement.
  • The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof; unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The selected Consultants will be attached to dedicated BRICS Working Groups like Trade, Industry, Finance, Agriculture, Energy, Environment, ICT, Labour etc., and will assist in developing concept notes, analytical notes and background documents for India’s BRICS Chairship.
  • They will assist in preparing draft outcome documents for BRICS meetings, help with the negotiation process including drafting documents during negotiations, and keep track of country positions on relevant subjects.
  • They will assist in preparing presentations, interventions, position papers, content for media and website for Ministerial meetings and Working Group meetings, take meeting records, coordinate with BRICS countries and International Organisations, and assist Sherpa meetings for work under different sectors.
  • They will keep track of the state of play on issues discussed in BRICS Working Groups and work towards proposals that may garner consensus in BRICS.
  • They will cover meetings and perform liaison duties with various Line Ministries/Departments of Government of India, Think Tanks, International Organisations and BRICS members and invitee countries.
  • They will undertake research and documentation work for BRICS in the run up to and during India’s BRICS Chairship including assessing key issues and country positions, and any other task assigned by Head of Division.
  • Job location will be Ministry of External Affairs (South Block/Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan/Sushma Swaraj Bhawan/Patiala House/ISIL Building/CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis; normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs, subject to change, with Saturdays/Sundays as weekend off.
  • In exigencies, the Consultant may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays; no extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise, in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with the Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service, subject to the conditions in the advertisement; leave encashment will not be permissible and unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format with effect from the actual date of engagement.
  • Applications received after the closing date and time or without the prescribed documents or otherwise found incomplete or not in the prescribed proforma will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.

How to Apply

  • Applicants who fulfil the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents/certificates in support of educational qualifications and experience in Government service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either offline or online mode.
  • Offline mode: By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in the MER Division of Ministry of External Affairs”, sent to: Under Secretary (PF&PG), Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011.
  • Online mode: Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted, to email address: [email protected].
  • Incomplete applications and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

Vacancy Details

Position Number
Senior Project Associate (03 UR)
Project Assistant 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification for Senior Project Associate: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sc/BVSc / BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent AND Four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&I organizations and scientific activities and services OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent AND Two year's experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent
  • Desirable skills with expertise and publications in assay system for Senior Project Associate: 1. Harnessing different chemical libraries like Zinc 15/20, Pubchem etc for virtual screening 2. Analysis of protein-ligand binding interactions using Molegro, Maestro etc 3. Utilizing in-silico tools like Swiss Target Prediction, Swiss ADME to find drug like molecules using Lipinski rule of 5 and further eliminating the toxic molecules from the developed library 4. Synthesis, purification and characterization of novel heterocyclic compounds 5. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 6. Analytical method development & validation HPLC/LC-MS 7. Development & optimization of the conventional & novel formulations (using QbD/Gastroplus) 8. Physicochemical & biological characterization (ex vivo, in vivo) of formulations 9. In vitro studies and analysis of formulations: study of in vitro drug release mechanism (kinetics study) 10. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 11. Sample Tracking & Data collection- clinical metadata entry, Tissue Quality Control, Blood/Fecal Sample Processing: PBMC isolation using Ficoll gradient, Data Coordination. 12. Transcriptomics and Proteomics Profiling : RNA extraction. Library preparation. RNA-Seq workflow. Sample QC. Next-generation sequencing: data visualization. 13. Proteomics (Metaproteomics / Tumor Proteome): Protein extraction, protein quantification, trypsin digestion. Sample prep for LC-MS/MS. GO term enrichment and pathway mapping (e.g., DAVID, Metascape). Maintain sample record. QC records, and experiment run sheets, document SOPs 14. In Vivo Animal Modeling. In Vitro Efficacy Assays. Pharmacokinetics (PK) : Dosing and Sampling, Plasma separation, LC-MS/MS-based assay. Pharmacodynamics-Biomarker Evaluation. Documentation: logbooks with ethics compliance. 16. R package for analysis of biological data, R for meta, PhVID for disproportionality analysis (frequency based and Bayesian methods). GRADE pro for GRADE analysis, Evidence Gap Map Analysis. Genome-wide association analysis with longitudinal phenotypes using fGWAS of R package. GROMAC for molecular simulation studies includes DCCM and PCA analysis, Network creation and analysis.
