    • Computer Literacy: candidates will be required to transcribe shorthand notes on computers.
  • Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) Stenographers:
    • Should have rendered not less than six years’ approved service as per IFS Branch “B” Rules, 2017 and have undergone and successfully completed mandatory training programme(s) as prescribed by Ministry of External Affairs.
    • Eligibility service continues to be five years’ approved service for persons holding Stenographer Grade “D” posts on regular basis before commencement of these rules.
  • Armed Forces Headquarters Stenographers Service:
    • On the crucial date, should have rendered not less than three years’ approved and continuous service in Grade “D” of the service.
    • If appointed on the result of a competitive or Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, the result should have been announced not less than three years before the crucial date and at least two years’ approved and continuous service in that grade is required.
    • Stenographers Grade “D” on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval of competent authority and those having lien in Grade “D” are eligible if otherwise fulfilling conditions.
  • Railway Board Secretariat Stenographers Service:
    • Regularly appointed Stenographer Grade “D” with not less than six years’ approved service as on 01.07.2025.
    • If appointed on results of a competitive examination, the result should have been announced not less than six years before the crucial date and at least five years’ approved and continuous service in that grade is required.
    • Eligibility service continues to be three years’ approved service for officials holding Grade “D” posts on regular basis before commencement of the rules.
    • Stenographers Grade “D” on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval of competent authority and those having lien in Grade “D” are eligible if otherwise fulfilling conditions.
    • Computer Literacy: candidates will be required to transcribe shorthand notes on computers.
  • Election Commission of India Stenographers Service:
    • On the crucial date, should have rendered not less than three years’ approved and continuous service in Grade “D” of the service.
    • If appointed on result of competitive or Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, the result should have been announced not less than three years before the crucial date and at least two years’ approved and continuous service in that grade is required.
    • Stenographers Grade “D” on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval of competent authority and those having lien in Grade “D” are eligible if otherwise fulfilling conditions.
  • Central Vigilance Commission:
    • Five years of regular service in the grade of Stenographer Grade “D” in the Commission after appointment thereto as on the crucial date.
  • General conditions:
    • Candidates must be regularly appointed Stenographer Grade “D”/Grade-III in the respective participating cadres/services.
    • Eligibility is subject to verification of service records, satisfactory conduct, and fulfillment of all conditions mentioned in the notice.

Salary/Stipend

  • The notice refers to Grade “C” Stenographers of various Central Government services/cadres; specific pay scales/salary details are governed by respective service rules and are not detailed in this notification.

Age Limit 

  • The notice does not prescribe explicit minimum or maximum age limits; eligibility is based on length of approved service in Stenographer Grade “D” as on crucial date 01.07.2025.
  • Crucial date for counting approved service for all participating services/cadres is 01.07.2025.

Application Fee

  • The notice does not mention any examination fee; no specific application fee details are provided in the document.

Important Dates

Dates for submission of online applications 22.12.2025 to 11.01.2026
Last date and time for receipt of online applications 11.01.2026 (23:00 hours)
Schedule of Computer Based Examination To be intimated later
Last date and time for receipt of printed online applications with documents in SSC (NR) 27.01.2026 (18:00 hours)
Last date and time for receipt of printed online applications with documents for candidates abroad / A&N / Lakshadweep 03.02.2026 (18:00 hours)

Selection Process

  • The examination will comprise:
    • Part-A: Computer Based Examination (200 marks).
    • Part-B: Short Hand Skill Test in Hindi or English (200 marks).
    • Part-C: Evaluation of Record of Service (APARs) carrying a maximum of 100 marks.
  • Part-A – Computer Based Examination:
    • Subjects:
      • General Awareness – 100 questions, 100 marks.
      • Comprehension and Knowledge of English Language – 100 questions, 100 marks.
    • Time: 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe as per para 36(a), 36(b) & 36(c)).
    • Objective Type Multiple Choice questions; General Awareness in Hindi and English; English Language section in English only.
    • Negative marking: 0.25 marks for each wrong answer; no re-evaluation/re-checking.
  • Part-B – Short Hand Skill Test (Stenography Test):
    • Only candidates who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Computer Based Examination, as fixed by the Commission, will be called for Stenography Test.
    • One dictation for 10 minutes at 100 w.p.m. in English or Hindi (as opted) for Stenographer Grade “C”.
    • Transcription on computer:
      • English: 40 minutes (55 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe).
      • Hindi: 55 minutes (75 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe).
    • No exemption from Stenography test; medium once opted is final.
  • Part-C – Evaluation of Record of Service:
    • Evaluation of APARs of such candidates as decided by the Commission on the basis of performance in Computer Based Examination and Stenography Skill Test, carrying a maximum of 100 marks.
    • No change in APAR grading etc. will be entertained after evaluation.
  • Mode of Selection:
    • Category-wise qualifying standards in Skill Test will be fixed by the Commission.
    • Candidates qualifying Skill Test will be considered for final selection on the basis of merit in Computer Based Examination, Skill Test and APAR evaluation.
    • Separate select lists will be prepared for each participating cadre/service to the extent of available vacancies, subject to reservation.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online on the new SSC website https://ssc.gov.in; earlier OTR on https://ssc.nic.in will not be functional for the new website.
  • Online application process has two parts: One Time Registration (OTR) and filling of Online Application Form; detailed instructions are given in Annexure-IV and Annexure-V.
  • Candidates should submit only one application; multiple applications may lead to rejection.
  • OTR requires mobile number, email ID, Aadhaar or other ID, and Matriculation details; data must match Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication; Aadhaar-authenticated candidates will not be required to produce recent colour photographs or original valid photo-identity proof at examination venue for CBT, and their applications will not be rejected for minor photograph/signature issues.
  • Photograph will be captured live through camera/mobile with plain background and without cap/mask/spectacles; applications with unacceptable photographs can be rejected.
  • Signature must be uploaded in JPEG/JPG format (10–20 KB, 6.0 cm x 2.0 cm, 300 DPI); blurred/miniature signatures will be rejected.
  • Candidates must ensure correctness of details; no change in entries will be allowed at any stage and incomplete/incorrect applications will be rejected.
  • Admission Certificates (AC) will be issued online only on SSC (Northern Region) website https://sscnr.nic.in; candidates must regularly visit SSC-HQ and SSC-NR websites for updates.
  • Examination will be conducted at Delhi only; no request for change of centre will be entertained and appearing at a centre other than allotted will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates (non-Aadhaar-authenticated) must carry Admission Certificate, two recent colour photographs and original valid Photo ID with date of birth; if DOB mismatch occurs, entry will be denied.
  • PwBD/PwD candidates availing scribes/compensatory time must produce requisite medical certificates; failure will lead to cancellation.
  • The Commission reserves the right to cancel centres, change schedule, divert candidates and take necessary actions; decisions of the Commission are final and binding.
  • Detailed rules on reservation, compensatory time, use of scribes, tie resolution, malpractices and debarment periods are provided in the notice.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online on SSC’s new website https://ssc.gov.in; applications through any other mode will not be accepted.
  • Part I – One Time Registration (OTR):
    • Access ‘Register Now’ under ‘Login or Register’ on https://ssc.gov.in.
    • Provide Aadhaar or other permitted ID details, name, parents’ names, date of birth, Matriculation board, roll number, year of passing, highest qualification, mobile number and email ID.
    • Verify mobile and email through OTP; create password; fill additional details such as category, nationality, identification mark, disability, permanent and present address; submit declaration and complete OTR within prescribed time.
  • Part II – Online Application Form:
    • Login using Registration Number and password; click “Apply” link under Grade “C” Stenographers LDCE 2025 in “Live Exam” tab.
    • Most personal data will be auto-filled from OTR; remaining fields include Department/Cadre, year of examination, date of joining feeder service/cadre and length of service, centre (Delhi), PwBD details and requirement of scribe, medium of Stenography Test, service/cadre name, service particulars, experience details and details of Stenography Test.
    • Capture live photograph following prescribed instructions and upload scanned signature as per specifications.
    • Upload required documents: certified true copy of first page of Service Book, particulars of service, disability certificates (if applicable) and any other relevant documents.
    • Preview the application, verify all details, complete declaration by ticking “I agree” and entering captcha, and submit the application; take printout of the application for record.
  • Forwarding of Printed Application:
    • After online submission, printed copy of the application, complete in all respects and accompanied with necessary documents, must be forwarded by respective Service/Organisation/Cadre Controlling Authority to:
      “The Regional Director, Staff Selection Commission (Northern Region), Block No.12, C.G.O. Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003”.
    • It must reach by 27.01.2026 (18:00 hrs); for candidates abroad/Andaman & Nicobar Islands/Lakshadweep, by 03.02.2026 (18:00 hrs).
    • Only applications forwarded by the Head of Department/Head of Office will be considered; late applications will be summarily rejected.

SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the starting date to apply for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: The dates for submission of online applications are from 22.12.2025 to 11.01.2026.

2. What is the last apply date for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: The last date and time for receipt of online applications is 11.01.2026 (23:00 hours).

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: Regularly appointed Stenographer Grade “D”/Grade-III in the respective participating services/cadres with prescribed length of approved service and other conditions as detailed for each cadre in the notice.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: No specific maximum age limit is prescribed; eligibility is based on length of approved service as on the crucial date 01.07.2025.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: Tentative vacancies are 267 for Central Secretariat Stenographers Services, 8 for Railway Board Secretariat Stenographers Service, 37 for Armed Forces Headquarters Stenographers Service, 1 for Election Commission of India Stenographers Service, 13 for Indian Foreign Service Branch (B) Stenographers, and vacancies for Central Vigilance Commission will be intimated later.

6. What is the mode of application for this examination?

Ans: Candidates must apply online on the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in, complete One Time Registration and fill the online application form, and then get the printed application forwarded through proper channel.

7. Where will the Grade “C” Stenographers LDCE 2025 examination be conducted?

Ans: The Limited Departmental Competitive Examination will be conducted at Delhi only.

8. What is the exam pattern for this recruitment?

Ans: The selection comprises a Computer Based Examination of 200 marks, a Stenography Skill Test of 200 marks and evaluation of Record of Service (APARs) for 100 marks.

9. Is there any negative marking in the Computer Based Examination?

Ans: Yes, there will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the Computer Based Examination.

10. How will the final selection be made for SSC Grade C Steno (LDC) 2025?

Ans: Candidates qualifying the Skill Test will be considered for final selection on the basis of their merit in the Computer Based Examination, Stenography Skill Test and APAR evaluation, and will be recommended for inclusion in select lists of the participating cadres/services to the extent of available vacancies.

3. Candidate should read the complete advertisement carefully & ensure that he /she fulfills the eligibility criteria for the post advertised in all respects.
4. The selected candidate is liable to be posted PAN India.
5. The candidate’s date of birth as recorded in the school leaving/matriculation/higher secondary certificate will be taken as proof of age.
6. Copies of all necessary pass certificates and mark sheets of essential educational qualifications which make the candidate eligible for the post and other qualifications must be attached along with the application.

10. The qualification regarding experience is relaxable at the discretion of the Competent Authority in the case of candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribes, if at any stage Competent Authority is of the opinion that sufficient number of candidates from these communities possessing the requisite experience are not likely to be available to fill up the vacancies reserved for them. 12. 13. Summary of grading of ACR (Annual Confidential Report/Annual Performance Report) with supporting documents, or any document indicating the performance of the candidates issued by the concerned Department/Institution is to be made available by candidate applying through Govt/CPSE for the last 3 years, prior to his/her candidature is considered for appointment in NSTFDC.
14. 16. 20. The invitation to candidates for interview merely indicates that it is felt that he/she with others may be suitable for the post and conveys no assurance whatsoever that he/she will be recommended or selected or his/her conditions specified in the application will be accepted.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications:

  • System Administrator / Network Administrator:
    • Essential Qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT/EC)/MCA/MSC (IT/CS/EC) from any recognized University/Institute
    • All qualifications should be full time in nature
  • PKI Administrator:
    • Minimum Qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT/EC)/MCA/MSC (IT/CS/EC) from any recognized University/Institute
    • All qualifications should be full time in nature
  • System Security Officer:
    • Minimum Qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT/EC)/MCA/MSC (IT/CS/EC) from any recognized University/Institute
    • All qualifications should be full time in nature
  • CA Administrator:
    • Minimum Qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT/EC)/MCA/MSC (IT/CS/EC) from any recognized University/Institute
    • All qualifications should be full time in nature
  • Resident Engineer:
    • Essential Qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT/EC)/MCA/MSC (IT/CS/EC) from any recognized University/Institute
    • All qualifications should be full time in nature

Experience Requirements:

  • System Administrator / Network Administrator:
    • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on technical experience in system/network administration, troubleshooting, switching, and routing
    • Relevant experience in system administration/Network Administration in an organization for general domain system administration with user accounts management, network administration, security administration, web-server and database administration
  • PKI Administrator:
    • Minimum at least five (5) years of experience with public key infrastructure (PKI)
  • System Security Officer:
    • Minimum 5 years relevant experience in respective area
  • CA Administrator:
    • Minimum 5 years relevant experience in respective area
  • Resident Engineer:
    • Minimum 3+ years of hands-on technical experience in network administration, troubleshooting, switching, and routing
    • Relevant experience in system administration/Network Administration in an organization for general domain system administration with user accounts management, network administration, security administration, web-server and database administration

Desirable Qualifications:

  • For System Administrator/Network Administrator & Resident Engineer:
    • CCNA/CCNP certification
    • Strong understanding of computer network infrastructure, LAN, and WAN administration
    • Experience with network security, firewall management, and VPN implementations
    • Proven ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices such as routers, switches, and firewalls
    • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, MPLS, VLANs, and QoS)
    • Experience with network monitoring tools and performance optimization
    • Hands-on experience with common industry frameworks and troubleshooting methodologies
  • For PKI Administrator:
    • Must understand the requirements set forth in the WebTrust audit criteria
    • Solid experience in enterprise information security
    • Certificate Authority Administration experience
    • Proficient with PrimeKey EJBCA or Active Directory Certificate Services (ADCS)
    • Experience with routing, switching, load balancing, web application firewalls, network protocols, and network security
    • Windows Server 2019 and above, Linux server and latest version
    • Understanding of Microsoft Active Directory, LDAP, WSUS, group policies, and DNS
    • Proficient with Cloud technologies
  • For System Security Officer:
    • Certified as CEH, CISA, CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001
    • Experience in building and maintaining security systems
    • Detailed technical knowledge of database and operating system security
    • Hands-on experience in security systems including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, anti-virus software, authentication systems, log management, and content filtering
    • Thorough understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols
  • For CA Administrator:
    • In-depth knowledge and practical experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) principles
    • Previous experience in a senior engineering or leadership role within cyber security
    • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and managing Certificate Authority systems
    • Extensive experience in managing cryptographic key lifecycles
    • Proven ability to conduct risk assessments related to CA systems

Salary/Stipend

  • System Administrator / Network Administrator: Rs.50,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • PKI Administrator: Rs.70,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • System Security Officer: Rs.50,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • CA Administrator: Rs.70,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Resident Engineer: Rs.33,000/- per month (Consolidated)
  • Important Note: No other allowances are applicable apart from the consolidated salary mentioned above
  • Annual Increment: Annual increment shall be applicable based on satisfactory performance of candidates

Age Limit (as on 16-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 40 years as on the date of advertisement (16/12/2025)
  • Applicable for All Posts: The maximum age limit of 40 years is applicable for all positions including System Administrator, PKI Administrator, System Security Officer, CA Administrator, and Resident Engineer
  • Age Relaxation: Age relaxation details are not mentioned in the official notification
  • Note: Candidates should ensure they meet the age criteria as on the date of advertisement

Event Date
Advertisement Release Date 16/12/2025

  • Interview Venue: Venue shall be intimated separately to the shortlisted candidates via email
  • Final Selection: Selection will be based on performance in the interview and verification of documents

  • The posts advertised are meant for different locations in India
  • Candidates should possess a valid email ID which should be kept active for at least one year

NCRTC Dy. General Manager (Electrical) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name UR Total
Dy. General Manager (Electrical) 1 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: B.E./ B. Tech. (Electrical) or its equivalent (Full Time).
  • Desirable: Having Electrical Engineering background, experience in Metro system/ Railways, experience in Energy Management, Project Management and Power sector, Corporate working and Project Monitoring.
  • experience: Minimum 08 years of post-qualification experience (of the level of E2 (Rs. 50000-160000)/ L9 (Rs. 53100-167800) or above) for officers working in Central/ State Government/ CPSEs/ PSUs/ Autonomous Bodies/ Government Instrumentalities or; Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience for Private sector candidates. Experience in Energy Management, Optimization of electricity tariff, Power sector background, framing of bid documents for solar related projects, green round the clock power.

Salary/Stipend

  • 70000-200000 (IDA)
  • Basic Pay as applicable in the grade, HRA/Lease, Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA) at the applicable rates and Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach.
  • Other Benefits like Laptop, Mobile Phone, Headset, Uniform, Briefcase, etc., as per extant Company Rules.

Age Limit

  • Not exceeding 45 years as on 16/12/2025. (Age Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and all others as per Central Government Rule).
  • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribes (SC/ ST): 05 Years
  • Other Backward Class- Non-Creamy Layer (OBC-NCL): 03 Years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 Years
  • Ex-serviceman and Commissioned Officers including Emergency Commissioned Officers or Short Service Commissioned Officers who have rendered at least five years military services and have been released on completion of assignment (including those whose assignment is due to be completed within one year) otherwise than by way of dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency or physical disability attributable to military service or on invalidment: 05 Years

 

Selection Process

  • Based on the eligibility, candidates meeting the criteria will be called for Interview.
  • The Venue, Date and Time of Interview will be informed in advance.
  • Any request for change in date or venue shall not be entertained.
  • The document verification of candidates shall be done before the Interview. The candidates are required to carry their original certificates to facilitate the document verification, failing which the candidate shall not be allowed to attend the Interview.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on score of Interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before applying, the candidates shall ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria as mentioned in the Vacancy Notice for the post/ (s). NCRTC will verify the eligibility with reference to the original documents on the date of interview. If the candidates are not found eligible during document verification, they will not be considered for the next stage of selection process and their candidature will be rejected. Their admission to all the stages of selection process will be purely provisional, subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria. Applicants who do not fulfil the age and minimum education qualification as on closing date of receipt of applications need not apply for the post.
  • Essential Education Qualification(s) required as indicated above is mandatory.
  • Only Full Time Regular Courses will be considered.
  • All essential qualification(s) must be from UGC recognized Indian University/ UGC recognized Indian Deemed University or AICTE approved course from Autonomous Indian Institutions/concerned statutory council (wherever applicable).
  • Candidates claiming equivalence in qualification shall be required to produce a copy of equivalence certificate.
  • In case of Degree/ Diploma in Management qualifications where there is a mention of Dual Specialization, one of the specializations necessarily needs to be function specific for which the post has been advertised.
  • Wherever CGPA/ OGPA/ CPI or grade as a degree is awarded, equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated in the application as per norms adopted by the University/ Institute. Candidates will be required to submit documentary proof/ certificate to this effect from the University/ Institute at the time of interview, if called for the same.
  • Candidates seeking reservation as SC/ ST/ OBC-NCL, shall have to produce a certificate in the prescribed proforma, meant for appointment to posts under the Government of India, from the designated authority indicating clearly the candidate’s caste, the Act/ Order under which the caste is recognized as SC/ ST/ OBC-NCL and the Village/ Town the candidate is ordinarily a resident of.
  • The OBC candidates who belong to ‘Creamy Layer’ are not entitled for concession admissible to OBC-NCL candidates and such candidates will have to indicate their category as ‘General’.
  • A person who wants to avail the benefit of PwBD reservation will have to submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority as prescribed in the RPwBD Act, 2016.
  • Candidates seeking reservation as EWS shall have to produce an ‘Income and Asset Certificate’ valid for the current financial year, issued by a Competent Authority based on gross annual income of the previous Financial Year in the format prescribed by the Government of India. Candidates are advised to be in possession of an ‘Income and Assets Certificate’ as mentioned above issued on or after the start of the current financial year at the time of the interview.
  • Age concession to PwBD candidates shall be admissible irrespective of the fact whether the post is reserved for PwBD or not.
  • Ex-Servicemen who have already secured regular employment in the Central/ State Government/ CPSEs/ Autonomous Bodies/ Govt instrumentalities for any post are permitted the benefit of age relaxation as admissible to Ex-servicemen for securing another employment in any higher post or service. However, such candidates will not be eligible for the benefit of reservation, if any for Ex-Servicemen.
  • Cumulative relaxation in age for one/ more than one category (mentioned in the table above) taken together shall be admissible.
  • If the SC/ ST/ OBC-NCL/ PwBD/ EWS certificate has been issued in a language other than English/ Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi.
  • Candidates belonging to the SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS category can apply against unreserved posts, provided they meet the eligibility criteria specified for the post prescribed for unreserved candidates. In such case, the SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS candidates will not be considered for any relaxation in age and/ or qualifying marks in the Written Test/ CBT/ Interview or at any stage in the entire recruitment process, if they apply against unreserved posts.
  • The above guidelines are subject to change in view of any Government of India guidelines/clarifications issued from time to time.
  • The selected candidate may be posted at any office/ workplace/ Project units of NCRTC or any of the subsidiaries/ Joint Ventures of NCRTC.
  • The selected candidate may be assigned jobs/ functions/ assignments as per the business requirements of the Company, including working in shift operations.
  • Appointment to the above post/(s) will be subject to the candidate being medically fit as per the medical standards prescribed for the post by the Company.
  • The candidate appointed to a post in the Company shall be required to get his/ her pre-employment medical examination done from NCRTC nominated hospital/ Centre or a Central/ State Government Hospital.
  • Acceptance of joining will be subject to the Medical Fitness Certificate issued by the Medical Authority. NCRTC reserves the right to re-examine or review the Medical Examination report submitted by the candidate without assigning any reason and the decision of NCRTC in this regard shall be final and binding.
  • Candidates suffering following critical diseases shall not be considered: a. Cancer. b. Kidney/ Liver Failure & Transplantations.
  • This shall, however, not apply to an internal candidate of the Corporation who has already been medically examined or declared fit at the time of his initial appointment.
  • The selected candidate/(s) shall have to execute a Service Bond of Rs. 2 lakhs plus GST and cost of training, if any, to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of two (02) years.
  • After joining, an employee has to undergo a probation period as per Company Policy.
  • The success in the selection process does not confer any right to appointment unless the character & antecedents are found satisfactory after such an inquiry, that the candidate having regard to his/ her character & antecedents is suitable in all respects for appointment to the service.
  • The above requirement shall be relaxed in case of employees drawn from other Government Departments/ CPSEs/ SPSEs/ Metro/ Railways/ instrumentalities of Government or on deputation/ absorption.
  • Verification of new inductee who has stayed abroad during the last five years shall be sent to Indian Embassy of concerned country. In case the stay abroad is for study/ employment, request may also be sent to Head of Department/ Institution/ previous employer, as the case may be issuing of character certificate. Clearance from any of the above authorities viz., Indian Embassy/ Academic Institution or employer will be accepted for the purpose of verification of character/ antecedents.
  • The employees recruited under the Ex-servicemen quota are exempted from verification of character and antecedents, if the period intervening their date of discharge from Armed Forces and their date of joining the Company is less than one (01) year.
  • The employee will be required to fill an Attestation Form, at the time of initial appointment, wherein any information suppressed or wrongly declared will render his/ her removal from service summarily, as well as make him/ her liable for other implications, as provided under the rules of the Corporation and the laws of the land.
  • For the purpose of computation of overall experience for candidates having combined experience of Government and Private sector, as on the reckoned date of eligibility of vacancy notice, the experience in private and government sector will be given weightage of 80% and 100%, respectively.
  • Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.
  • The candidates should ensure that they fulfill all the eligibility criteria and other conditions of this Vacancy Notice and that all particulars furnished by them in the online application and the documents submitted by them later on are correct in all respects. Mere admission to the selection process does not imply that NCRTC has been satisfied about the candidate’s eligibility. In case it is found at any stage of the recruitment process that a candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility criteria, and/ or that he/ she has furnished any incorrect information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/ her candidature will stand cancelled. In any of these shortcoming(s) is/ are found even after the appointment, his/ her services shall be summarily rejected.
  • The details entered by the candidate at the time of online registration are final and binding. While applying, the candidates should enter their name as it appears in the SSC/ Matriculation Certificate. Further, request for change of Mailing Address/ E-mail Id/ Category/ Posts as declared in the online application shall not be entertained.
  • Candidates should possess a valid e-mail ID. Candidates are advised to keep the email ID (to be entered compulsorily in the online application form) active for at least one year. No change in e-mail ID will be entertained. All correspondence with candidates shall be done through email only. NCRTC will not be responsible for any loss of email sent, due to invalid/ wrong e-mail ID provided by the candidate and no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • To determine the equivalency of required pay scales with pay scales in other Government Organizations, the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale will be compared with the minimum basic pay of pay scale in question. In such cases, if the minimum basic pay of the pay scale being compared is equal to or higher than the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale in which recruitment is being carried out, the candidate will be treated as working in equivalent pay scale. As an extension, if the minimum basic pay of the pay scale being compared is lower than the minimum basic pay of the NCRTC pay scale in which recruitment is being carried out, the candidate will be treated as working in the lower pay scale, irrespective of maximum basic pay of such a pay-scale (only for the purpose of eligibility in scrutiny).
  • The candidature of the registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of the recruitment process or after recruitment or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or is not found in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned above.
  • NCRTC reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards. NCRTC also reserves the right to fill or not to fill all or any of the above positions and cancel/ restrict/ enlarge/ modify/ alter the recruitment/ selection process without any further notice or assigning any reasons whatsoever.
  • Experience on a post/ level shall be counted from the date of assumption of charge.
  • In case of MBA/ PG Diploma in Management/ MMS Qualifications having mention of Dual Specialization, one of the specializations necessarily needs to be function specific for which the post has been advertised.
  • Candidates once selected but did not join for any reason shall be debarred to apply for any positions in NCRTC for a period of two (02) years from the date of Offer of Appointment issued to them.
  • No person shall be eligible for appointment who has previously been dismissed, removed, or compulsorily retired from the service of the Corporation or from a department of a state or the Central Government or a local authority or from public sector undertaking, or from an autonomous corporation.
  • No person shall be eligible for appointment who has previously been convicted in a Court of Law for any offence involving moral turpitude.
  • No candidate who has more than one spouse living or who having a spouse living contracts another marriage which is void by any reason of it taking place during lifetime of such spouse, shall be eligible for any appointment to any post/(s) in the Corporation except where this may be permitted under the Central Government Rules of its employees.
  • In case of dispute arising on account of interpretation in versions of language other than English, the English version shall prevail.
  • Teaching or freelancing experience shall not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • The prescribed qualification/ experience criteria are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate for participating in the Selection Process. NCRTC’s decision shall be final in this regard.
  • Candidates working with Government entities/ CPSEs/ SPSEs will be considered for pay protection. However, candidates working on contract basis shall not be considered for pay protection, and their pay on selection in NCRTC will be fixed at the minimum of the pay scale.

NDMA Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Nature of Post No. of Vacancies
Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) Contractual 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian nationals having requisite qualification and experience are eligible to apply.
  • Essential educational qualification: Master’s degree in Water Resources Management, Hydrology, Erosion (River/Coastal) Risk Management, Disaster Management or any other disciplines related to disaster management such as geography, geology, environment, civil/geo-technical engineering.
  • Desirable educational qualification: A research degree (M.Phil./Ph.D.) in disaster management or related field.
  • Post-qualification experience: Minimum 5 years’ experience in Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management or related subject.
  • Duration of research work (Ph.D./Post Doctoral) will be counted for work experience (actual duration or 5 years, whichever is less).
  • Field experience in community-based approaches to Erosion (River/Coastal) risk management and in projects with substantial use of disaster risk reduction and mitigation will be given more weightage in the selection process.
  • Both educational qualifications and work experience must prove the credentials of the applicant as an established expert in the field.
  • The applicant should not be more than 50 years of age for Senior Consultant; in case of retired Government employee, maximum age limit is 62 years.

Salary/Stipend

  • Remuneration band: Rs. 1,25,000/- to Rs. 1,75,000/- per month for Senior Consultant.
  • Remuneration in respect of retired Government employee engaged as a Consultant shall be regulated as per Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.III.A dated 09 December 2020.
  • The remuneration is consolidated and inclusive of all applicable taxes and no other allowance shall be provided, as per the recruitment handbook description and ToR.

Age Limit (as on last date of application)

  • Maximum age limit is 50 years for Senior Consultant.
  • In case of retired Government employees, maximum age limit is 62 years for engagement as Senior Consultant.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Date of advertisement 24/12/2025
Application window Within 20 days from date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website

Selection Process

  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experiences will be verified with original certificates.
  • Applications will be considered only when submitted through NDMA job portal; incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.
  • Detailed terms and conditions and eligibility criteria are available in the Terms of Reference (ToR) on the NDMA website; selection will be based on the criteria and processes outlined therein.

General Information/Instructions

  • NDMA is the apex-level institution for disaster management in India, mandated under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 to lay down policies, plans and guidelines for disaster management and implement related programmes.
  • The Disaster Management Act, 2005 provides for constitution of National, State and District Disaster Mitigation Funds to allocate resources for mitigation measures; large-scale structural interventions should be pursued through regular development schemes, while local and community-based interventions are supported by mitigation funds.
  • The position of Senior Consultant (Erosion-River-Coastal) is in the Mitigation Division, focusing on Erosion (River/Coastal) as one of the key areas of mitigation due to its frequency, geographical impact, and associated human and physical losses.
  • Senior Consultant will work full time and shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with NDMA.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required; high-order skills in operating spreadsheets and databases and skill in making presentations are required competencies.
  • Allowances such as TA/DA, lodging and boarding expenses etc. for official tours/visits will be provided as per rules/regulations of Government of India/NDMA.
  • The engagement is temporary; NDMA can terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason, though normally one month’s notice will be given; Senior Consultant can also seek termination by giving one month’s notice.
  • Senior Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period not exceeding three years, with continuation contingent on satisfactory Annual Performance Review; extension beyond three years may be considered under exceptional circumstances, but no extension will be given beyond age 65 years.

How to Apply

  • Interested individuals may apply for the position online through NDMA website (http://ndma.gov.in) within 20 days from the date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website.
  • Applications will be considered only when applicants apply through the NDMA job portal; no other means of application will be considered.
  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experience documents must be uploaded and will be verified with original certificates at the appropriate stage.
  • For any assistance to apply online, applicants may call 9958136496 or 9873997934.
  • Incomplete applications will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.

Delhi 120

Rajasthan 90

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications:

  • Trade Apprentice - Fitter (Code 107): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Fitter) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Electrician (Code 108): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Electrician) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Electronics Mechanic (Code 109): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Electronics Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Instrument Mechanic (Code 110): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Instrument Mechanic) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Trade Apprentice - Machinist (Code 111): Matriculation with regular full time 2 years ITI (Machinist) course recognized by NCVT/SCVT. Pass marks required.
  • Technician Apprentice - Mechanical (Code 101): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electrical (Code 102): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Instrumentation (Code 103): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Civil (Code 104): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electrical & Electronics (Code 105): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Technician Apprentice - Electronics (Code 106): 3 years regular full time Diploma in Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Graduate Apprentice (Code 112): Regular full time Graduate in any discipline (BBA/BA/B.Com/B.Sc.) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate for General, EWS and OBC-NCL & 45% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates from Institute/University recognized by AICTE/UGC.
  • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator Fresher (Code 113): Class 12th (but below graduate).
  • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator Skill Certificate Holders (Code 114): Class 12th (but below graduate). Additionally, candidates should possess Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Government.

Essential Qualifications:

  • The qualification prescribed shall be from a recognized University/Institute as a full-time regular course in relevant disciplines.
  • Qualification acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning mode shall render the candidate NOT ELIGIBLE.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade is awarded, its equivalent aggregate percentage of marks must be indicated in the Online Application as per the norms adopted by Board/University/Institute.
  • Diploma under recognized Institute/University lateral entry scheme (Class XII/ITI) admitted in the second year of Diploma course shall also be considered eligible subject to meeting prescribed percentage of marks.
  • Candidates must be registered with NAPS/NATS portal with valid and active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number.
  • Candidates must have an Aadhaar seeded bank account enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
  • Candidates must possess PAN Card and Aadhaar Card.
  • Candidates must be medically fit as per Indian Oil's pre-engagement medical standard.

Desirable:

  • Preference shall be accorded to candidates applying for Apprenticeship training for the first time.
  • Candidates registered with Local/State Employment Exchange(s)/Vocational Rehabilitation Center for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) and meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria are required to apply through NAPS/NATS portal.

Experience:

  • A candidate who has already undergone one apprenticeship training is eligible to apply for a second apprenticeship training, provided that the second apprenticeship is in a different trade from the first.
  • There shall be a minimum gap of one year between the completion of the first apprenticeship training and commencement of the second apprenticeship training.
  • No gap shall be required in case of termination of previous apprenticeship training due to failure on the part of the employer.
  • Diploma Holder or Vocational Certificate holder Candidates having job experience for a period of one year or more after the attainment of the qualification shall not be eligible to be engaged as Apprentice.
  • Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as B.E or equivalent, MBA or equivalent or MCA/CA/ICWA, LLB or any such equivalent or pursuing higher qualification and having completed the same on or before joining the apprenticeship training shall NOT be considered eligible.
  • Candidates applying under NATS/NAPS who have completed five years as on 31.12.2025 in relevant discipline after acquiring the prescribed qualification shall NOT BE ELIGIBLE for engagement as apprentices.

Salary/Stipend

  • Graduate Apprentice: Rs. 4,500/- per month from Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) + Remaining amount from IOCL + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Technician Apprentice: Rs. 4,000/- per month from Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) + Remaining amount from IOCL + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Trade Apprentice: Stipend as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019 (paid in full by IOCL) + Rs. 2,500/- as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • Rate of stipend payable to apprentices per month shall be as prescribed under Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, Apprentices Rules 1992/2019 as amended from time to time.
  • Over and above the statutory stipend, an additional amount of Rs. 2,500/- shall be paid to the Apprentices as Miscellaneous expenses.
  • The cost of stipend borne by the Central Government shall be restricted to the first-time training only.
  • Part of the Graduate and Technician apprentice stipend is disbursed by Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) directly in their bank accounts under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • General/UR/EWS: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 24 years
  • SC/ST: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 29 years (Relaxation of 5 years)
  • OBC-NCL: Minimum 18 years and Maximum 27 years (Relaxation of 3 years)
  • PwBD (General): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 34 years (Relaxation of 10 years)
  • PwBD (SC/ST): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 39 years (Relaxation of 15 years)
  • PwBD (OBC-NCL): Minimum 18 years and Maximum 37 years (Relaxation of 13 years)

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee is required for applying to IOCL Apprentice positions.
  • Candidates can apply free of cost through NAPS/NATS portal.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Notification Date 27.12.2025
Date of Opening of Application (NAPS/NATS Portal) 27.12.2025 from 10:00 AM onwards
Last Date of Submission of Application (NAPS/NATS Portal) 12.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
Last Date for Microsoft Office Form Submission 12.01.2026 up to 05:00 PM
Cutoff/Reckoning Date (Qualification & Age Criteria) 31.12.2025
Document Verification Date To be intimated on registered email ID
Period of Apprenticeship Training 12 Months

Selection Process

  • There will be no written Test/Interview for selection.
  • Merit list of all candidates who have applied against respective posts in the portal and meeting the eligibility criteria shall be prepared based on the percentage of marks secured in the prescribed qualification for the post.
  • In case of two candidates securing same percentage of marks, the candidate with earlier date of birth (older in age) shall be considered.
  • In case of same date of birth, candidates having a higher percentage marks in matriculation shall be considered.
  • Preference shall be accorded to candidates applying for Apprenticeship training for the first time.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification.
  • Candidates will have to complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test for being adjudged suitable for engagement.
  • Candidates successfully qualifying document verification and Pre-engagement medical fitness shall be adjudged suitable for engagement and shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • An amount of maximum up to Rs. 3,000/- shall be reimbursed to the candidate towards expenses incurred for conducting tests/investigations during pre-engagement medical, on production of receipt for the same.

General Information/Instructions

  • IndianOil Corporation Limited proposes to engage Technician, Graduate and Trade Apprentice under Apprentices Act, 1961 at its Locations in States and UTs (Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttarakhand).
  • Reservation will be applicable as per the prescribed percentage for recruitment applicable to the States/UT.
  • For PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) category, Government of India Guidelines shall apply.
  • The reservation for PwBD shall be applied on horizontal basis, across all categories, as per the Government guidelines.
  • PwBD are not eligible to apply for Discipline Codes 101-111 (Technician and Trade Apprentice - Technical).
  • Candidates are required to submit a Disability Certificate issued by competent authority as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must be capable of performing the task assigned to them/take instructions using suitable aids and appliances.
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL-Non Creamy Layer) candidates applying for Unreserved (UR) seats shall be considered subject to their fulfilling the standards applicable to candidates belonging to General category.
  • Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE from the advertisement. Candidates applying for more than one discipline code will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • The candidature of the applicant would be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates and testimonials.
  • In case it is detected at any stage that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and/or has furnished any incorrect/false information/certificate, his/her candidature will stand cancelled.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Corporation.
  • The decision of the Management will be final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process.
  • Applications which are incomplete or received in any other mode/form, or not fulfilling the eligibility criteria shall not be considered "Eligible".
  • Upon completion of the apprenticeship period, the Corporation shall have NO obligation to offer regular employment to such apprentices NOR can an Apprentice claim right for employment.
  • All ex-apprentices will have an equal opportunity along with other candidates to appear
  • Candidates must have an active email ID and Mobile number which must be valid for at least 1 year as all future communications will take place through email/SMS alerts.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum or updates shall be made available on official website: https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships ONLY.

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register as Graduate/Technician/Trade Apprentice online in the following portals under the respective State as per their Trades:
    • Trade Apprentice - ITI at NAPS portal: http://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Trade Apprentice - Data Entry Operator at NAPS portal: http://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/
    • Technician Apprentice - Diploma at NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
    • Graduate Apprentice at NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in/student_register.php
  • Step 2: Ensure that your profile (Personal Details, Educational Details, Category etc) along with aggregate percentage are appearing correctly in the portal. Ensure 100% completion/updation of profile.
  • Step 3: LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using User ID/Email ID.
  • Step 4: APPLY for the apprenticeship Openings/Opportunities with the Establishment ID of Indian Oil Corporation Limited (MD)-Northern Region Office:
    • NATS - NDLSDC000005
    • NAPS - E05200700003
  • Step 5: After applying on respective NATS/NAPS portal, candidate MUST also submit their details along with preferred State and three preferred locations in Microsoft Office Form by visiting: https://forms.office.com/r/JtB9aJALr9 (Latest by 12.01.2026, 05:00 PM)
  • Important: Candidates must submit only one response. Multiple submission of Microsoft Form shall NOT be entertained.
  • Step 6: Keep checking official website https://www.iocl.com/apprenticeships and registered email/mobile for updates regarding document verification.
  • Step 7: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated about document verification on registered email ID.
  • Step 8: Appear for document verification with all original documents and self-attested copies.
  • Step 9: Complete Pre-engagement medical fitness test.
  • Step 10: Candidates successfully qualifying document verification and medical fitness shall be issued offer of Engagement for Apprenticeship Training.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully read the full advertisement for details of Educational Qualification and other eligibility criteria before applying.
  • Candidates are requested to apply sufficiently in advance before the closing date.
  • Candidates are advised to periodically visit official website as all future correspondence and latest information shall be only on website and/or by e-mail/SMS-alerts.

  • Essential qualifications: Specific degree/diploma depending on the post. CA/ICWA is not considered for these roles. Engineering courses via ODL mode are generally not accepted.
  • Desirable: Experience in the Travel business for most roles. IT related qualifications for specific roles.
  • Experience: Varies by post. Freshers may apply for FTO-1 roles. Other roles require 2 to 11 years of minimum relevant experience depending on degree level and position.

Salary/Stipend

Compensation will be linked to the candidate's qualification and experience. The positions are on a three-year fixed-term contract.

  • Selected candidates are entitled to statutory benefits including PF, ESI (if covered), Bonus as per Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 (if covered), and Gratuity as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 04-01-2026)

General Information/Instructions

  • Locations mentioned are indicative; selected candidates can be placed anywhere in India or outside the Country depending on business requirements.
  • Only online applications submitted through the official portal will be considered. Applications sent via email or post will be rejected.

How To Apply

  • Applicants must apply online through the e-recruitment portal on the Balmer Lawrie website (www.balmerlawrie.com).
  • First, candidates need to register on the portal to create a profile.
  • After creating the profile, apply against the appropriate position under the “Employment Opportunities” tab.

  • Mere fulfilling the prescribed conditions would not entitle one to be called for interview
  • Corporation reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for personal interview depending upon number of vacancies
  • Decision of Selection Committee shall be final and binding

  • Interested candidates fulfilling eligibility criteria may apply in prescribed format (Annexure-I)
  • Application should be filled completely with all facts properly
  • Submit application along with:
    • Self-attested photocopies of all documents
    • Recent passport size photograph
    • Application fee (Bank Draft)
    • All relevant certificates (Qualification, Experience, Caste, Income, Aadhar)

  • Private Sector candidates can send application directly with all requisite self-certified documents
  • Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees may submit advance copy and produce NOC at time of interview
  • Super-scribe clearly on envelope the name of post applied for
  • Send hard copy of application to:
    "The Chief General Manager (HR & Admin.), NBCFDC, 5th Floor NCUI Building, 3, Siri Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi-110016"
  • Application must reach on or before closing date (30 days from posting on website)
  • Applications received after last date will not be entertained

Instructions

  • Candidates should read complete advertisement carefully and ensure they fulfill eligibility criteria in all respects
  • Copies of pass certificates and mark sheets of essential educational qualifications must be enclosed
  • Candidates must produce all necessary documents: Experience Certificate, pay slips, Relieving orders, Form 16 or any other proof confirming experience
  • Private Sector candidates with CTC of Rs. 22.00 lakh are eligible. It shall be candidate's responsibility to calculate CTC and submit documentary evidence
  • Candidates are advised to give specific, correct, full information
  • All original certificates/documents must be produced at time of verification, failing which candidate will be disqualified
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
  • Any request to add additional information after submission shall not be entertained
  • Provide active e-mail ID and mobile phone number for easy contact
  • Invitation for interview conveys no assurance of selection
  • No correspondence will be entertained regarding reason for not being called for interview/outcome of interview
  • If any information given in application is found incorrect/false, candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated
  • Selected candidates must convey acceptance by stipulated date and report for duty as mentioned in offer
  • Selected candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from recognized institutions prior to joining
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for period of one year
  • Selected candidates will be required to serve in any part of India as per discretion/requirement of Corporation
  • Any canvassing, directly or indirectly, will disqualify candidature
  • NBCFDC reserves right to reject candidature at any stage if found ineligible or furnished incorrect information
  • The above positions will be filled on regular basis

Documents Required

  • Prescribed Application Form (Annexure-I) duly filled
  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Self-attested photocopies of:
    • 10th onwards educational qualification certificates
    • Mark sheets of all examinations
    • Professional qualification certificates (CA/ICWA/PG in Commerce)
    • MBA certificate (if applicable)
    • Experience certificates from all employers
    • Pay slips/Relieving orders/Form 16
    • Caste certificate (if applicable)
    • Income certificate (if applicable)
    • Aadhar card copy
    • Date of birth proof (School leaving/Matriculation certificate)
    • NOC from current employer (for Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees)
    • Vigilance clearance (for Government employees)
  • Bank Draft for application fee

Travel Allowance for Interview

  • Outstation candidates called for interview shall be entitled to reimbursement of single return 3rd AC rail/AC bus fare by shortest route
  • Fare from railway station nearest to normal place of residence or from where actually performs journey, whichever is nearer
  • Reimbursement for travel to place of interview and back to same station

Important Notes

  • Any corrigendum/addendum will be made available only on Corporation's official website www.nbcfdc.gov.in under "Recruitment Notice"
  • No separate intimation/advertisement will be issued in case of any change/update
  • Candidates are advised to visit NBCFDC website regularly for updates
  • Decision of NBCFDC in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding
  • No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained
  • NBCFDC reserves the right to cancel this recruitment at any time/stage without assigning any reasons

About NBCFDC

  • National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation is a Government of India undertaking
  • Under the aegis of Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
  • Working for upliftment of economic status of poor amongst Backward Classes
  • Provides concessional financial assistance through Channel Partners, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Public Sector Banks (PSBs)
  • Additionally undertakes Skill Development and other promotional activities for target groups

Date Description
09/12/2025 Advertisement Date

General Information/Instructions

  • The contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and depending on the requirement. The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidate.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.
  • No HRA shall be admissible.

Saturdays/Sundays will remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, he/she may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible. He/She shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with this Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be allowed. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave. Unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period. No other leave of any kind shall be admissible to him/her. In case he/she remains absent from duty beyond entitled leave, a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee as applicable will be made.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of his/her duties, the Ministry will take care of his/her travel, accommodation and per-diem costs, as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format w.e.f. the actual date of engagement as Consultant.

  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either of the following modes:
  • OFFLINE MODE:- By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in the ED Division of Ministry of External Affairs”. This is to be sent to the following address. Under Secretary (PF&PG) Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011
  • ONLINE MODE:- Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted. The email is to be sent to the following email address: [email protected]

  • The Competent Authority in the office of C-NEST may require the individual Young Professional to submit a statement of good health from a recognized physician prior to commencement of work in the office of C-NEST, Bengaluru.
  • The individual Young Professional shall be solely responsible for taking out and for maintaining adequate insurance required to meet any of its obligations under the contract, as well as for arranging, at the individual Young Professional’s sole expense, such as life insurance, health insurance and other forms of insurance as the individual Young Professional may consider to be appropriate to cover the period during which individual Young Professional provides services under the contract.

Un-availed leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Further, leave up to one month can be considered without remuneration with the prior approval of controlling Officer. However, in exceptional cases like need for professional development, training etc. this condition may be relaxed with the approval of Competent Authority, subject to official exigencies. Apart from this, the women Young Professional may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017 issued by Ministry of Labour & Employment vide letter No.S36017/03/2015-SS-1 dated 12th April, 2017.

  • Young Professionals shall not represent themselves or otherwise make public with the intent to make a commercial advantage of their engagement with DGFT CNEST. He/she shall not, in any manner whatsoever, use the name, emblem or official seal of the Government of India or DGFT or any abbreviation of the name of DGFT, in connection with business or otherwise without the prior written permission of the competent authority of DGFT.
  • Young Professional shall be expected to conduct him/her in accordance with the rules and regulations of the Government of India. He/she will be expected to demonstrate high moral character, integrity, secrecy of office and dedication to work while discharging his/her duties. In case his/her services are not found satisfactory or found to be in conflict with the interest to the DGFT/Government of India, his/her services will be terminated forthwith, without any notice period or compensation.
  • In the unfortunate event of the death, injury or illness while serving DGFT CNEST, Young Professional/Consultant or the next of kin shall not be entitled to any compensation or appointment.
  • Young Professionals will be required to submit a police verification report from their concerned police station and also submit a medical-cum-fitness certificate issued by any authorized Medical Practitioner prior to engagement.
  • The engagement can be terminated at any time by the Department by giving 30 days' notice or pay in lieu thereof. Similarly, Young Professional may also disengage after giving notice for a similar period.
  • The period of engagement would commence from the date of joining at DGFT CNEST.
  • The period of engagement as Young Professional will not confer any claim or right for subsequent engagement/employment with DGFT or any other Government Department at a later date.
  • The Competent Authority in DGFT CNEST reserves the right to terminate Young Professional at any stage in event of a serious failure to perform the task assigned or of failure to observe any standards of conduct.
  • Young Professionals may be required to travel to any place in India. While on tour TA/DA will be admissible as to Assistant Section Officer of the Central Government.
  • The Young Professionals will be required to submit a Non-Disclosure Agreement & Noncompete Agreement with cooling-off period on a Rs. 10/- stamp paper on the date of joining.

  • The Young Professional will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 60,000/- per month.

Advertisement
Company Name BEML Limited (BEML)
Post Name Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC – Group ‘A’ (Dy. General Manager, Asst. General Manager, Sr. Manager, Manager, Officer/Engineer), Group ‘B’ (Asst. Engineer) & Group ‘C’ (Diploma Trainees, Office Assistant Trainees) Backlog Vacancies

Age Limit Grade VII – 50 years (SC/ST), 48 years (OBC); Grade VI – 47/45 years; Grade V – 44/42 years; Grade IV – 39/37 years; Grade II – 34/32 years; Grade I – 34/32 years; Wage Group S1 & B – 34/32 years; PwD: additional 10 years; maximum age with relaxation not beyond 57 years.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, Qualification and Experience should be as on 07th January 2026.
  • Under qualifying marks, First Class is reckoned at 60% aggregate (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST & PwD); candidates with CGPA/credits must provide conversion formula.
  • SC/ST candidates must submit SC/ST Caste Certificate in the prescribed format for Government of India posts.
  • OBC candidates must submit OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed Government of India format and a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status; OBC certificate should not be older than six months as on last date.
  • PwD candidates must submit PwD certificate in the prescribed format; age relaxation of additional 10 years is applicable for PwD with minimum 40% disability.
  • Post Qualification Experience (PQE) is counted only after obtaining the required qualification; only employment after the requisite qualification is considered.
  • Private sector candidates must be employed in regular capacity and submit experience certificate on company letterhead.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Govt., Autonomous bodies, Quasi-Govt. and PSUs must apply through proper channel or produce NOC, and should have worked at least one year in immediate lower scale (not applicable to Grade II, Group B & C).
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD as applicable); any false information or discrepancy leads to cancellation/termination.
  • Post-wise essential qualifications include: First Class full-time Degree in Engineering in relevant disciplines; CA/ICWA/CMA; First Class full-time MBA with Finance as major; two-year full-time First Class PG degree/diploma in HR/IR/Personnel Management/MSW/MA Social Work (HR/IR); First Class Master’s Degree in Hindi with English at degree level; Three years First Class Diploma (for Diploma Trainees); First Class full-time Graduate Degree (for Office Assistant Trainees), with additional desirable qualifications and experience as per each post description.

Salary/Stipend

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Pay Scale Rs. 90,000 – 2,40,000.

  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Pay Scale Rs. 40,000 – 1,40,000.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Pay Scale Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 23,910 – 85,570; stipend Rs. 17,000/- PM during 1 year training; Rs. 20,500/- PM & Rs. 25,500/- PM during first and second year of contract.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B on absorption): Pay Scale Rs. 16,900 – 60,650; stipend Rs. 20,000/- PM in first year and Rs. 23,500/- PM in second year of contract.
  • Besides Basic Pay, eligible for Variable Dearness Allowance, Perquisites & Allowances (currently 13.78% of Basic Pay under Cafeteria System), Company Accommodation/House Rent Allowance, Provident Fund, Gratuity, PRP etc. as per Company rules.

Age Limit (as on 07-01-2026)

  • Dy. General Manager (Grade VII): Upper age limit – 50 years for SC/ST, 48 years for OBC.
  • Asst. General Manager (Grade VI): Upper age limit – 47 years for SC/ST, 45 years for OBC.
  • Sr. Manager (Grade V): Upper age limit – 44 years for SC/ST, 42 years for OBC.
  • Manager (Grade IV): Upper age limit – 39 years for SC/ST, 37 years for OBC.
  • Officer/Engineer (Grade II): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Asst. Engineer (Grade I): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Diploma Trainees (Wage Group S1 – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • Office Assistant Trainees (Wage Group B – on absorption): Upper age limit – 34 years for SC/ST, 32 years for OBC.
  • For PwD candidates, upper age limit relaxable by additional 10 years over and above SC/ST/OBC relaxation; maximum age with relaxation shall not exceed 57 years.
  • Upper age limit can be relaxed for candidates of all categories subject to equivalent years of excess PQE, within the maximum limit of 57 years.

Application Fee

  • Eligible and interested OBC candidates applying for the above positions (not applicable for SC/ST/PwDs) must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/-.
  • Fee payment link is provided at the end of the online application form.
  • SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from payment of application fee as per the notification.

Important Dates

Event Date / Details
Date of Advertisement 03/12/2025 (Advt. No. KP/S/28/2025).

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be shortlisted for assessment based on eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age, category, PwD etc.).

  • For post codes L036, L037, L038 and L039, selection will be based on written exam at Bangalore (to & fro fares reimbursed based on eligibility) assessing domain ability (not for L039), reasoning ability, general awareness and English ability.

  • Only candidates meeting all eligibility norms need apply; receiving call for assessment/interview does not guarantee selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST & OBC for Group ‘A’ (9th Attempt), Group ‘B’ & Group ‘C’ (7th Attempt) backlog vacancies.
  • BEML Limited is a multi-technology company under Ministry of Defence with core sectors Defence & Aerospace, Rail & Metro, Power, Mining & Construction; the drive is aligned with expansion initiatives like Vande Bharat sleeper trains, Metro coaches, high mobility vehicles, special application engines, AI-based mining equipment etc.
  • Only Indian Nationals may apply.
  • Age, qualification & experience are counted as on 07/01/2026; First Class is 60% aggregate (relaxable for SC/ST & PwD).

  • No request for change in category, address, e-mail, mobile number, test centre location etc. as declared in online application will be entertained.
  • Any canvassing or influencing related to recruitment/selection will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be hosted only on BEML website.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only (mandatory) after going through guidelines and ensuring correctness of data entered.
  • Online application form can be accessed in the career page at www.bemlindia.in; online registration site is available till 18:00 Hrs on 07th January 2026.
  • Candidates must have a valid e-mail ID and mobile number for registration and further correspondence; change of e-mail or mobile will not be entertained during the recruitment process.
  • A Registration number will be generated and should be noted for all future correspondence.
  • While filling online application, experience section should first list latest experience, followed by previous experiences; a brief pen picture of experience relevant to the position must be written.
  • Candidates must upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, category certificates, academic certificates and mark sheets, identity proof, experience documents, detailed resume, current reporting structure and latest pay-slip as per checklist.
  • Experienced candidates must provide detailed pen picture of each experience; all experience documents must clearly indicate start and end dates of each employment.
  • OBC candidates (except SC/ST/PwD) must pay the non-refundable Rs. 500/- fee through the link at the end of application form.
