AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and other academic staff posts must ensure that they satisfy the eligibility criteria as per UGC Regulations 2018 and applicable NCTE/AICTE/other regulatory body norms. The notification clearly states that eligibility conditions regarding qualifications, experience, research publications and research score will be as per the latest UGC/NCTE/AICTE rules and the detailed discipline-wise criteria given in the advertisement.

✨ Educational Qualification

The educational and professional qualifications vary by post and discipline but broadly follow UGC Regulations 2018 and related bodies.

For Professor (various disciplines):
An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, actively engaged in research with minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018, along with at least 10 years of teaching/research experience at University/National Level Institutions including supervision of doctoral candidates. Alternatively, an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and significant contribution to the field with at least 10 years’ experience and a national award instituted by Government of India and conferred by the President of India may be considered in specific cases as detailed in the notification.

For Associate Professor (various disciplines):
A good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), and minimum 8 years of teaching/research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University/College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with at least 7 publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations 2018. Additional discipline-specific desirable qualifications such as experience with quantitative techniques, data handling, or interdisciplinary law and social science backgrounds are mentioned for some posts.

For Assistant Professor (various disciplines):
A Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent foreign degree, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or exemption through Ph.D. in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations 2009/2016, with detailed conditions for candidates registered before 11 July 2009 (including viva voce, external evaluation, publications, and paper presentations) certified by the concerned University. In professional/technical disciplines such as Design or Management, qualifications include Ph.D. with First Class at Bachelor’s or Master’s level, specified industry/teaching experience, and minimum numbers of SCI/UGC/AICTE-approved journal publications, as detailed in relevant sections of the advertisement.

For Librarian and Assistant Librarian:
Librarian requires a Master’s Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science with at least 55% marks, at least 10 years’ experience as Librarian at University/College/teaching level or College Librarian, evidence of innovative library services including ICT, and a Ph.D. in Library/Information/Documentation/Archives & Manuscript-Keeping. Assistant Librarian requires Master’s in Library/Information/Documentation Science with at least 55%, knowledge of computerization, and NET or exemption through Ph.D. meeting UGC norms, with detailed pre-2009 Ph.D. conditions.

For Assistant Director of Physical Education & Sports (Women only):
Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks, record of representing University/College at Inter-University/Inter-Collegiate competitions or State/National championships, and NET (or Ph.D.-based exemption) in Physical Education/Physical Education & Sports/Sports Science. An alternative qualification is being an Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a Post-Graduation degree, along with physical fitness test norms detailed for women candidates.

AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Selection Process 2025

The selection process for AUD Teaching & Academic Staff Recruitment 2025 is based on merit through all-India advertisement and recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees, as per UGC Regulations 2018 and AUD norms. Applications will be scrutinised and shortlisted according to academic qualifications, research publications, research score, and other criteria, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, presentation or seminar or a combination thereof as decided by the University.

The selection process is carried out in the following stages:

1. Scrutiny / Screening of Applications: A Scrutiny/Screening Committee will examine all applications and prepare a list of eligible and not-eligible candidates based on stipulated guidelines, eligibility conditions and shortlisting criteria as per UGC Regulations and University norms. The lists of eligible and not-eligible candidates (with reasons for ineligibility) will be uploaded on the University website, and candidates shown not-eligible will have an opportunity to submit grievances/clarifications with documentary evidence within a stipulated time.

2. Final Shortlisting & Interview Call: After considering grievances, the Committee will finalise the list of eligible candidates, and on the basis of academic record, publications, experience and research score, a reasonable number of candidates will be called for interview. If the number of applications is large, the University may restrict candidates by applying higher qualifications/experience than minimum prescribed, and in some cases may postpone interviews if there are not enough candidates.

3. Interview / Presentation / Seminar: Shortlisted candidates will be required to appear before the Selection Committee for interview and may be asked to give a presentation or seminar as part of the selection process. Candidates residing outside India may be interviewed via video conferencing (e.g., Skype or other modes) if requested in advance.

Final Merit: Final selection will be based on performance in the interview (and presentation/seminar where applicable), with academic/research scores used only for shortlisting, not for final selection. Appointments will be made in accordance with UGC Regulations 2018 and subsequent amendments, and the University reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel posts, and any dispute will fall under the jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

BEL Director (Human Resources) 2026 Vacancy Details

The PDF is an advertisement for a single, specific Board-level position (Director-Human Resources) which is vacant as of 01.04.2026. It is focused on the eligibility for this high-level post rather than multiple vacancies or category-wise distribution.

Eligibility Criteria for BEL Director (Human Resources) 2026

1. Educational Qualification

The applicant should be a graduate with a good academic record from a recognized University/Institute. Preference would be given to applicants with a Post Graduate Diploma or Degree in Personnel Management/Human Resources Management or an MBA/PGDM in a related field, and also to those with an Engineering degree.

2. Age Limit

The age criteria are based on residual service until the age of superannuation (60 years):

  • Minimum Age: 45 years.
  • Maximum Age: 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy (01.04.2026) for internal candidates, and 3 years residual service for others.

3. Experience

The applicant should possess at least five years of cumulative experience/exposure during the last ten years in various aspects of HR, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations in an organization of repute. Experience in defence, aerospace, and heavy engineering would be desirable.

4. Employment Status

Applicants must, on the date of application and interview, be employed in a regular capacity (not contractual/ad-hoc) in a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), Central Government (Group 'A' Officer level), a State Public Sector Enterprise (SPSE) or Private Sector company with an annual turnover of \(\mathbf{Rs. 5,000}\) crore or more.

Salary/Stipend

The position is in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 180000 – 340000.

Selection Process for BEL Director 2025

The selection process is based on an Interview conducted by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB). The Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for the interview. Selected candidates must provide an undertaking that they will join if selected; unwillingness to join can result in debarment for a period of two years.

How to Apply for BEL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates must submit their applications online only through the PESB website by the specified deadline.

  1. Visit the official PESB website: pesb.gov.in.
  2. Find the job description for "Director (Human Resources)" in Bharat Electronics Limited.
  3. Fill up the application form online.
  4. After online submission, applicants must forward the application through their proper channel (e.g., Cadre Controlling Authority, Administrative Ministry, or directly to PESB for private sector applicants).

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The applicant should possess a higher qualification (Masters’ and above) from a reputed Indian or International Institution/University in Economics, Development Cooperation, Development Partnership, International Relations, International Law, International Development, Strategic Studies, Public Administration, International Trade, Environment and Climate, Trade, Agriculture, Labour Economics, Energy, Health, Disaster Management, Anti corruption or a related subject.
  • The applicant should have at least five years of experience in handling multilateral work in UN agencies or International Organizations or International consultancy organizations or Government of India, in relevant fields.
  • The applicant should preferably have experience of participating in international meetings.
  • The applicant should possess good writing and analytical skills and have experience in policy making or advocacy, including experience in speech writing, analytical writing and preparing negotiation strategy.
  • The applicant must be proficient in the use of computers (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
  • The applicant should not be more than 45 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

Salary/Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 2.75 lakh per month each, with deduction of applicable taxes.
  • The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidates, and no HRA shall be admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.

Age Limit (as on last date of submission of application)

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Advertisement Date (Advertisement No. Q/PF/575/55/2025) 24/12/2025
Last date for receiving applications 16/01/2026 (up to 17:30 Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/Instructions

  • The period of consultancy is 01 (one) year; the contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement.
  • The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof; unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The selected consultants will be attached to dedicated BRICS Working Groups like Trade, Industry, Finance, Agriculture, Energy, Environment, ICT, Labour etc., and will develop concept notes, analytical notes and background documents for India’s BRICS Chairship.
  • They will assist in preparing draft outcome documents for BRICS meetings, help with negotiation process including drafting documents during negotiations, and keep track of country positions on relevant subjects.
  • They will keep track of the state of play on issues discussed in BRICS Working Groups and work towards proposals that may garner consensus in BRICS.
  • They will cover meetings and perform liaison duties with various Line Ministries/Departments of Government of India, Think Tanks, International Organizations and BRICS member and invitee countries, and perform any other task assigned by the Head of Division.
  • Job location will be Ministry of External Affairs (South Block/Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan/Sushma Swaraj Bhawan/Patiala House/ISIL Building/CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis; normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs, subject to change, with Saturdays/Sundays as weekend off.
  • In exigencies, the Consultant may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays; no extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise, in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with the Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service, subject to conditions in the advertisement; leave encashment will not be permissible and unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format with effect from the actual date of engagement.

  • Online mode: Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted, to email address: [email protected].

FSSAI 11th Food Analyst Exam (FAE) 2025-26 Overview

Advertisement
Examination Name Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) 11th Food Analyst Examination
Exam Short Name FSSAI 11th FAE 2025-26

FSSAI 11th Food Analyst Exam 2025-26 Details

Examination Stage Details
Computer Based Test (CBT) 8th March 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-I) 25th & 26th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-II) 2nd & 3rd May 2026
Mandatory Training 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026 (Two Weeks)
Certificate Issuance 5th June 2026

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Educational Qualification

  • The candidate should hold a Bachelor's or Master's or Doctorate degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry or Microbiology or Dairy Chemistry or Agriculture Science or Animal Science or Fisheries Science or Biotechnology or Food Safety or Food Technology or Food and Nutrition or Dairy Technology or Oil Technology or Veterinary Sciences from a university established in India by law
  • Or is an associate of the Institution of Chemists (India) by examination in the section of Food Analysts conducted by the Institution of Chemists (India)

Essential Experience

  • The candidate should possess not less than three years' experience in the analysis of food in any institution, research institutions, or research laboratory after attaining the minimum essential academic qualification specified above for 11th FAE 2025
  • The qualified Junior Analysts after acquiring 3 years' mandatory experience in analysis of food can appear only in Practical Examination of 11th FAE 2025 conducted after the Computer Based Test
  • The opportunity for appearing in Practical examination for Junior Analysts after acquiring 3 years of experience will be provided only once
  • Upon qualifying the practical examination, the Junior Analyst will become eligible to be declared as Food Analysts
  • This opportunity is available to qualified JAE only once in a lifetime

Age Limit (as on 22nd January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: No Age Limit
  • Maximum Age: No Age Limit
  • There is no age limit for appearing in the 11th FAE 2025

Application Fee

Examination Stage Fee Amount
Computer Based Test (CBT) ₹2,500 plus 18% GST (Total: ₹2,950)
Practical Examination ₹5,000 plus 18% GST (Total: ₹5,900)
  • The fee should be submitted through online mode which is non-refundable
  • There is no reservation in whatsoever form since this is not for employment

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening of online portal for application submission 23rd December 2025
Last date for receipt of online application 22nd January 2026
Date of issue of admit card for CBT (online downloadable) 24th February 2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) Examination Date 8th March 2026
Publication of Answer Key and opening of challenge window 10th March 2026
Closing of Answer Key challenge window 20th March 2026
Announcement of CBT results 23rd March 2026
Opening of online portal for Practical examination application 3rd April 2026
Last date for receipt of Practical examination application 10th April 2026
Date of issue of admit card for Practical Examination 10th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-I) 25th & 26th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-II) 2nd & 3rd May 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-I) 26th April 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-II) 3rd May 2026
Two Weeks Food Analysts mandatory training 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
Issuance of certificate after training completion 5th June 2026

Selection Process

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination will be conducted in two stages: Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Practical Examination
  • Only candidates who qualify the Computer Based Test (CBT) as per the laid down criteria and fulfil the eligibility requirements will be allowed to appear in Practical Examination
  • Dates of Practical examination will be intimated separately to qualified candidates
  • The examination comprises both theoretical knowledge assessment through CBT and practical skills evaluation through hands-on practical examination
  • Upon successful completion of both CBT and Practical Examination, candidates must complete a two-week mandatory Food Analysts training from 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
  • Certificates will be issued to successful candidates after completion of the mandatory training on 5th June 2026
  • Candidates successfully completing all stages will be certified as Food Analysts by FSSAI

General Information/Instructions

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination is conducted under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standards (First Amendment) Rules, 2022
  • This is a certification examination and not for employment purposes
  • There is no reservation in whatsoever form since this is not for employment
  • Candidates must have relevant educational qualifications from universities established in India by law
  • Three years of mandatory experience in food analysis is essential after obtaining the required educational qualification
  • Junior Analysts who have acquired 3 years of mandatory experience can appear only in the Practical Examination after qualifying CBT
  • The opportunity for Junior Analysts to appear in Practical examination after acquiring 3 years of experience will be provided only once in a lifetime
  • All application fees are non-refundable once submitted
  • Candidates must complete the registration and application process online through the official portal only
  • Admit cards will be available for download from the official website on the specified dates
  • Answer key will be published after the CBT examination and candidates can submit challenges during the specified window period

How to Apply

Step 1: Registration Process

  • Visit the official Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Portal at https://fssai.formsubmit.in
  • Click on the "Register" menu on the homepage
  • Enter your full name as per official documents
  • Create and set your username for profile login
  • Provide a valid and active email ID
  • Enter your mobile number during registration
  • Set a strong password for profile login
  • Click on the "Sign Up" button to proceed
  • Enter the OTP received on your registered email and mobile number to complete the registration process
  • Once registration is successful, you will receive a user ID and password via email
  • After successful verification of email ID and mobile number, you will be redirected to the login page

Step 2: Login to Portal

  • Click on the "Login" menu on the homepage of FSSAI Portal at https://fssai.formsubmit.in
  • Enter the user ID and password received via email after successful registration
  • Click on the "Login" button to access your dashboard
  • If you forget the password, click on the "Forget Password" button and follow the password recovery steps

Step 3: Fill Application Form

  • After successful login, you will see the candidate dashboard
  • In the dashboard, you can view current exam openings, previous/incomplete applications, and admit card details
  • To apply for 11th Food Analyst Examination (11th FAE) 2025-26, click on the apply button in the corresponding examination row

Step 4: Complete Application Steps

  • Fill Personal Details accurately as per your official documents
  • Enter Details of Academic Qualification with proper certificates
  • Provide complete Work Experience Details with supporting documents
  • Select your preferred Examination Centre Choice
  • Upload all required Document Details in the specified format
  • Read and accept the Declaration by Candidate
  • Make Payment for Application Form through online payment gateway
  • Download and save the completed Application form for future reference

Important Points While Applying

  • Ensure all information entered is accurate and matches your official documents
  • Keep scanned copies of all required documents ready before starting the application
  • Complete the application process before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues
  • Take a printout of the completed application form for your records
  • Note down your application number for future correspondence

Eligibility Criteria

Event Date
Commencement of Online Application 15th December, 2025 (10:00 AM IST)
Closing Date for Online Application 13th January, 2026 (06:00 PM IST)
Crucial date for determination of age Last date prescribed for the receipt of ONLINE application

Selection Process

  • As per The Selection Tests Rules, 2025, through a two-stage process as under:
  • Stage 1: Eligibility Test - A multiple-choice questions (MCQ) based screening test examining general awareness, analytical ability, aptitude, and logical ability
  • Stage 2: Selection Test - Qualifiers from Stage 1 (or exempted) will appear for a grade-specific written test on domain knowledge in civil engineering, infrastructure projects, and related areas
  • Personal Interview - Conducted by a nominated Selection Committee for shortlisted candidates based on written test scores
  • Special Provision: Applicants with experience of working in NHIDCL for a total period of 5 years (i.e. 1825 days or more) as on the date of this advertisement shall be exempted from Stage-1: Eligibility Test. However, they must undergo Stage-2: Selection Test (Specific Written Test and meet all other eligibility criteria
  • Syllabus for Eligibility Test and Specific Written Test: The detailed syllabus is available on the NHIDCL website
  • Final Selection: Final selection shall be based on NHIDCL Cadre Rules

General Information/Instructions

  • One post of Sr. Manager for category D (autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc.) and one post of Dy. General Manager for category B (deaf & hard of hearing) under PwBD reservation will be made applicable for the above vacancies horizontally
  • Eligibility for Availing Reservation: To avail community reservation, candidates must belong to a caste listed in the Central Government reserved communities list. Candidates would be required to submit valid SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificates at the time of document verification
  • PwBD category reservation will be limited to under mentioned disabilities: B. Deaf & hard of hearing D. Autism, intellectual disability, Specific Learning Disability, mental illness etc
  • Functional Requirements for PwBD Categories are: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Bending, Jumping, Climbing, Manipulation by Fingers, Reading & Writing, Seeing (SE), Communication (C)
  • Reserved Category candidates applying for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any relaxations
  • Name variations in certificates should be supported by such legal documents, as may be required under provisions of law/guidelines
  • Government/PSU candidates are required to submit NOC / relieving letter from their current organizations at the time of document verification prior to issuance of "Offer of Employment"
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease based on NHIDCL requirements
  • Selected Candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad. NHIDCL at present operates through 14 Regional Offices in different States/UTs with its Corporate HQ at New Delhi
  • NHIDCL at any stage may cancel the advertisement or selection process without assigning any reasons
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year; no change in the email ID would be allowed
  • Corrigendum/addendum/errata will be posted only on NHIDCL's website at www.nhidcl.com under the heading "Career/Current Vacancies"
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen / recruitment agents / consultants and fraudulent job promises
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation
  • All appointments in NHIDCL shall be subject to the successful completion of a background verification process (BGV). The BGV may inter alia include verification of the candidate's identity, address, educational and professional qualifications, character antecedents and any other information as deemed necessary by NHIDCL
  • If at any point of time, before or after the appointment, the outcome of the background verification is found to be unsatisfactory, NHIDCL reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the offer of employment/ appointment
  • The personal information collected during the verification process/selection process shall be handled in accordance with applicable laws, rules, and NHIDCL's policies. It shall be used only for purpose of assessment and verification relevant to employment
  • For detailed information, candidates may refer to NHIDCL Cadres (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Rules, 2025, which are available on the NHIDCL website. It may be noted that provisions of these rules shall apply and supersede any of the instructions given in this Recruitment Notice, if found to be contradictory
  • In case of any doubt & queries please contact to: [email protected]

How to Apply

  • Visit the official NHIDCL website: www.nhidcl.com → Career → Click on "Current Vacancies 2025 - Apply Online"
  • Register using valid email ID and mobile number. Upload scanned copies of recent passport-size photo, signature, 10th Certificate/DoB proof, educational certificates

Candidates will be shortlisted for Interview based on the scrutiny of application as per the criteria laid down in the advertisement.

Verification of eligibility claims of the candidates with original documents will be done on the day of interview. However, candidates, at the discretion of Management, may be called for documentation on any other day before scheduling the personal interview.

Details of candidates shortlisted for Documentation/ Personal Interview will be posted on PHL website only. Call Letters to shortlisted candidates will also be sent to their registered e-mails IDs.

During Document Verification, the candidate will have to produce his/her all Original Certificates in support of age, caste, qualification, experience etc. along with a proof of identity and one set of self-attested photocopies of the Certificates. If the identity of the candidate is in doubt or he/she is not able to produce the requisite documents or there is mismatch of information in the documents, his/her candidature will be rejected. No additional time will be given for producing original documents.

Candidates already working in Central Government/State Government/Autonomous Body/Public Sector Undertaking are required to submit their application through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer on the day of interview, failing which his/her candidature will not be considered. Other claims such as undertaking to resign in the event of selection, acknowledged copy of application for NOC/resignation letter, experience certificates etc. shall not be considered in place of NOC.

In case a candidate does not appear for Document Verification along with original documents, he/she shall not be eligible for further selection procedure and his/her candidature shall summarily be rejected.

After Document Verification, the provisionally shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by an approved panel of 5-6 members.

Final selection will be made in order of merit prepared on the basis of marks obtained by the candidates in interview subject to meeting all other eligibility criteria prescribed for the post.

Name of the candidates provisionally selected for appointment will be declared on PHL website. The Offer of Appointment shall be issued to the provisionally selected candidates on their Registered email IDs only.

Selection of candidates shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character and antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/her meeting the requisite medical standards for the post and other requirements applicable for appointments under the rules of PHL.

Appointment of successful candidates will be subject to further verification of concerned documents related to Age, Qualification, Caste & Medical fitness certificates etc. from the issuing authorities so that the candidate is suitable in all respects for appointment to the service/post.

How to Apply

  • Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria may apply online through the link available on www.pawanhans.co.in  under tab "Careers". No other mode of submission of applications will be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Before filling online application, the candidate should keep scanned copies of all educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, CTC/ Pay scale, Salary Slips, Photograph, caste, class etc. at hand.
  • Candidates should enter their Name, Father's Name and Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation certificate only. In case of subsequent change in name, candidates should indicate their changes only in the Online Application. However, other details should match with the Matriculation Certificate. Gazette Notification or any other legal document as applicable should be submitted at the time of Document Verification.
  • After filling online application form, applicants are required to take print out of duly filled-in & signed online application form and send the same after affixing a recent passport size photograph accompanied with copies of self-attested testimonials in support of age, caste/class, qualification, experience, Pay/CTC, etc. and proof of payment of application fee of Rs. 295/- to Head (HR), Pawan Hans Limited, (A Government of India Enterprise), Corporate Office, C-14, Sector-1, Noida - 201 301, (U.P.) on or before 02.01.2026. Candidates belonging to SC, ST and PwBD are exempted from payment of application fee.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Scrutiny of Applications - All applications will be scrutinised subject to eligibility criteria and necessary documents
  • Stage 2: Shortlisting - Only candidates whose applications are shortlisted will be issued admit card

Written Examination Pattern

Subject No. of Questions Marks Duration Passing Marks (UR/EWS)
Mathematics 20 20 01 Hour 40
English 20 20
General Awareness 20 20
Mental Ability/Reasoning 20 20
Total 80 80 1 mark per correct answer, No negative marking

Written Examination Syllabus

  • Mathematics: Problems relating to integers and whole numbers, LCM and HCF, Decimals and Fractions, Relationship between numbers, Fundamental Arithmetic Operations and BODMAS, Percentage, Ratio and Proportions, Work and Time, Direct and inverse Proportions, Averages, Simple Interest, Profit and Loss, Discount, Area, Distance and Time, Lines and Angles, Square and Square Roots
  • English: Understanding of basics of English language, vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and correct usage. Comprehension based on simple paragraph
  • General Awareness: Social Studies (History, Geography, Art and Culture, Civics, Economics), General Science and Environmental studies up to 10th standard
  • Reasoning: Alpha-Numeric Series, Coding and Decoding, Analogy, Following Directions, Similarities and Differences, Jumbling, Problem Solving and Analysis, Non-verbal Reasoning based on diagrams, Age Calculations, Calendar and Clock etc.

  • Candidature liable to be rejected at any stage if information provided is found false

  • Mechanical Fitter (Skilled Tradesman): Will form core team of tradesmen towards carrying out repairs, maintenance and overhauling of all MT vehicles
  • MTS (Peon): Physical maintenance of records, general cleanliness & upkeep, carrying files & papers, photocopying, sending fax, other non-clerical work, assisting in routine office work including computer work, delivering dak outside building, watch and ward duties, opening & closing of rooms
  • MTS (Sweeper): Cleaning of rooms, dusting of furniture, cleaning of building fixtures, any other work assigned by superior authority
  • Above mentioned duties are only illustrative and not exhaustive. Indian Coast Guard may add duties of similar nature ordinarily performed by officials at this level

  • Separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp pasted on it addressed to yourself
  • Date of issue of all documents must be on or prior to closing date 20-01-2026
  • EWS/OBC(NCL) certificate should be valid for current Financial Year

Applications Will Be Rejected For

  • Applicants found overaged on the last day of receipt of applications
  • Overwriting/cuttings/corrections/incorrect information according to enclosures
  • Photocopies of self-attested documents not enclosed
  • Separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp not enclosed

Paper II Examination Date (Subject Papers) Will be informed through Commission's website
Age Limit Reckoning Date 01/07/2025

Selection Process

  • The Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts) comprises of two stages: Written Examination and Interview
  • Candidates shall be admitted to the written examination based on the claims made in the online application
  • Onscreen certificate verification will be conducted before admission to the physical certificate verification and interview
  • Candidates will be admitted to onscreen certificate verification in the ratio of 1:3/1:4 (posts not requiring experience) and 1:10 (posts requiring experience)
  • After onscreen certificate verification, based on the marks obtained in the written examination and subject to the rule of reservation of appointments, candidates shall be admitted to physical certificate verification and interview
  • The objective of the Interview is to assess the suitability of the candidate for the post by judging the candidate's personality, bearing, aptitude, general knowledge, technical knowledge etc.
  • Marks obtained by the candidates in the Written Examination (Part B and Part C of Paper I and Paper II) and Interview would determine final ranking
  • Appearance in Paper I, Paper II and the Interview is compulsory

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies and distribution of vacancies are tentative and liable for modification before the publication of results
  • The Commission reserves the right to include additional posts with different nomenclature and having similar eligibility conditions
  • Candidates should possess adequate knowledge in Tamil on the date of notification
  • Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s, and BCMs, who have put in 5 years or more of service are not eligible to apply (except for posts requiring experience and Accounts Officer Class-III)
  • Persons with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Deputy Manager (Mechanical), Deputy Manager (Electrical), and Deputy Manager (Materials) posts
  • Candidates selected for appointment will be required to submit a certificate of physical fitness to the Appointing Authority at the time of joining
  • The admission to all stages of examination will be purely provisional, subject to satisfying eligibility conditions
  • The Commission reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage after due process
  • All recruitments by TNPSC are purely merit-based
  • Candidates are solely responsible for their claims in the online application
  • Mobile phones, pagers, electronic equipment, programmable devices, or any banned items are not allowed in the examination hall

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates are required to apply online using the Commission's website www.tnpscexams.in
  • Step 2: Register at the One Time Registration (OTR) platform by paying Rs. 150 as registration fee (valid for five years). If already registered, proceed to fill online application
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all relevant correct details. Choose the subject paper(s) in which you have obtained educational qualification
  • Step 4: Upload recent colour photograph (20KB-50KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) and signature (10KB-20KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) as per specifications
  • Step 5: Upload all required documents including educational certificates, community certificate (if applicable), experience certificates (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents
  • Step 6: Choose two district centres as preference for Written Examination (candidates with benchmark disability can choose only one)
  • Step 7: Pay examination fee of Rs. 200 through online mode (Net Banking/Credit card/Debit card/UPI) unless exemption is claimed
  • Step 8: Preview the application carefully and make necessary corrections if required
  • Step 9: Finally submit the application by clicking the 'SUBMIT' button
  • Step 10: Take printout of the application for future reference
  • Important: Candidates need not send the printout of online application or any supporting documents to the Commission by post unless specifically asked
  • Note: Linking the Aadhaar number with One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for candidates

  • Coimbatore (Code: 0201)
  • Tiruchirappalli (Code: 2501)
  • Madurai (Code: 1001)
  • Tirunelveli (Code: 2601)

8. Is there any negative marking in the examination?

Ans: The notification does not mention negative marking. The examination is Computer Based Test (CBT) with objective type questions.

9. What is the selection process for TNPSC CTS Examination 2025?

Ans: Selection process consists of Written Examination (Paper I and Paper II), Onscreen Certificate Verification, Physical Certificate Verification, and Interview.

The ISRO Propulsion Complex (ISRO IPRC), Mahendragiri, has announced the latest Graduate and Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2025 notification. A total of 85 vacancies are available across various engineering and non-engineering disciplines for eligible Indian candidates. These positions are for a one-year training period under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates must apply via an off-line walk-in interview process, not online. Walk-in interviews are scheduled for 10/01/2026 and 11/01/2026.

The selection for these apprenticeship positions is based purely on the highest marks secured in the qualifying examination. Applicants need to download the application form from the official IPRC website and bring the completed form, along with original and self-attested copies of certificates and a valid photo ID, to the walk-in interview venue. These roles offer monthly stipends of Rs. 9,000/- for graduates and Rs. 8,000/- for technicians, but do not guarantee permanent employment within ISRO after the training period.

  • The Written Test will be for 100 marks with three parts: Part-I (40 questions of General Awareness), Part-II (30 questions of Quantitative Aptitude) and Part-III (30 questions of Logical Reasoning), comprising 100 objective type questions with equal marks and no negative marking; duration is 120 minutes and the question paper will be in English language only.
  • Service Weightage is awarded based on years of service: above 20 years – 10 marks; above 18 years and up to 20 years – 8 marks; above 15 years and up to 18 years – 5 marks; Performance Rating based on entry in Discharge Book: Excellent/Outstanding – 10 marks, Very Good – 8 marks (maximum 20 marks).
  • Physical Test consists of Walk/Run (1.6 kms), Sit-up and Push-up, each graded as Excellent, Good and Pass with marks 10, 7 and 5 respectively, for a maximum total of 30 marks; candidates must pass all three tests to be considered for final selection.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are 50 out of 100 for UR/EWS candidates and 40 out of 100 for SC/OBC(NCL) candidates against reserved posts; only those who secure minimum qualifying marks in Written Test are eligible for Physical Test.
  • Project Affected Persons (PAPs) of NLCIL Neyveli Projects will be allowed 20 bonus marks in the Written Test, limited to one beneficiary per award, subject to prescribed conditions and supporting documents.
  • Final selection will be in order of merit based on total marks in Written Test, Service Weightage & Performance Rating and Physical Test, subject to candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in each component and meeting category-wise requirements; tie cases will be resolved first by date of birth (elder candidates placed higher) and then by alphabetical order of first name.

General Information/Instructions

  • NLC India Limited is a premier ‘NAVRATNA’ Government of India Enterprise, and applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Security Guard in W-3 grade for NLCIL Neyveli Units.
  • Only Indian Nationals who have passed the notified qualification are eligible to apply, and the notified qualification must have been acquired from appropriate statutory authority in India.
  • NLCIL reserves the right not to fill up any or all posts notified and vacancies may be increased or decreased depending upon organizational requirements.
  • Candidates permitted to appear for the Written Test are eligible for reimbursement of to and fro travelling expenses to the extent of sleeper class rail fare by shortest route, on production of travel proof including reservation and tatkal charges, if any.
  • Candidates removed, terminated or who deserted their employment from any organisation will not be considered; persons already resigned from NLCIL may apply if they fulfil eligibility criteria.
  • Scrutiny of applications and shortlisting will be based solely on documents/certificates uploaded at the time of online application; failure to upload legible and complete documents may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Any legal proceedings arising out of this advertisement or related to applications can be instituted only in Chennai, and the jurisdiction will be courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai.
  • NLCIL’s Appointing Authority’s decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, selection, posting and related issues will be final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply

  • Candidates should apply only through online mode in NLC India Limited website www.nlcindia.in.
  • Before registering or applying online, candidates should ensure that they have a mobile number and valid, active personal email ID and keep them active for the entire selection process, as all communications will be sent via SMS/email.
  • Candidates have to upload required scanned copies of documents/certificates in prescribed format to establish their eligibility; applications without required documents are liable for rejection.
  • Candidates should submit only a single application for the post; in case of multiple applications, the last registered application will be considered.
  • After uploading required documents, candidates should submit their application online, take a printout of the registration-cum-application form and produce it along with self-attested copies of certificates/documents at the time of document verification.
  • No manual or paper applications will be entertained and candidates should not send hard copies to NLCIL.

3. What is the eligibility to apply for NLCIL Security Guard Recruitment 2025?

Ans: A total of 30 Security Guard vacancies in W-3 grade are notified, with reservation of UR-15, EWS-2, OBC(NCL)-8 and SC-5.

6. What is the pay scale and CTC for NLCIL Security Guard?

Ans: The pay scale is ₹ 20,000 – 81,000 in W-3 grade with approximate CTC per annum of ₹ 5.47 lakhs, plus Unified Incentive Scheme, medical facilities, Group Insurance and eligible residential accommodation as per rules.

Ans: Selection is based on Written Test (100 marks), Service Weightage & Performance Rating (20 marks) and Physical Test (30 marks), with prescribed minimum qualifying marks and category-wise merit.

Ans: Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from application fee but must pay a non-refundable processing fee of INR 236/- including 18% GST.

Ans: Candidates must apply online through the NLCIL website www.nlcindia.in, register with valid mobile number and email ID, upload required documents, pay the processing fee and submit the application within the specified dates.

  17. Calling a candidate for test/interview merely indicates that it is felt that the candidate with others may be suitable for the post and conveys no assurance whatsoever that they will be recommended or selected or their conditions specified in the application will be accepted.
  18. Candidates will be short-listed for Test/Interview on the basis of the information provided by them in their online applications. They must ensure that such information is true. If at any subsequent stage or at the time of Test/Interview any information given by them or any claim made by them in their online applications is found to be false, their candidature will be liable to be rejected.
  19. The Institute shall verify the antecedents or documents submitted by a candidate at any time at the time of appointment or during the tenure of the service. In case, it is detected that the documents submitted by the candidates are fake or the candidate has clandestine antecedents/background and has suppressed the said information, then their services shall be liable to be terminated.
  20. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which may be detected at any stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify/ withdraw/ cancel any communication made to the candidates.
  21. Applicants who are working in any one of the Project at IIT Madras, must apply through proper channel otherwise they will be required to produce No-Objection Certificate at the time of document verification/Test/Interview. Candidates without NOC will not be permitted to appear for Test/Interview.
  22. Candidates may send testimonials from persons intimately acquainted with their work and character. If the applicant is in employment, the candidate should submit testimonials from the most recent employer or immediate superior as a referee.
  23. The Institute has a right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicant for short listing and selection.
  24. The Institute solely reserves the right not to fill any advertised position without assigning any reason
  25. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
  26. No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of test/interview and reasons for not being called for interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  27. The crucial date for determining the eligibility criteria for all candidates in every respect shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application.
  28. The Institute strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.
  29. Any corrigendum/clarifications on this advertisement, if necessary, shall be uploaded on website and no separate communication will be sent for this purpose.
  30. If there is any issue to submit the application please send E-mail to : [email protected] / [email protected] Contact: 044- 2257 9796 on all working days from 9.00 AM to 05.30 PM (Monday to Friday – except National Holidays). Eligibility Criteria for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, one of the following must be met:

  • ITI certificate or national/state trade certificate in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 2 years’ full-time experience as an apprentice trainee in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 3 years of work experience in the relevant trade in a government organization/PSU/Autonomous Body.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for CSIR-CMERI Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years (as on the last date of online application: 21.01.2026)
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10-15 years for PwBD, 5 years for Departmental/Govt. employees, and for Ex-Servicemen and Widows/Divorced Women as per government norms.

Application Fee for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

A non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only) is mandatory for applicants other than Ex-servicemen, SC/ST, Women, and PwBD candidates. The fee must be deposited online through the State Bank Collect system; payment through any other mode will result in application rejection.

Salary/ Stipend

The post is in the Pay Level – 2 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix (₹19,900-₹63,200). The total emoluments (Basic Pay + DA + HRA + TA etc.) are approximately ₹ 37,000/- per month at the minimum of the scale when stationed at Durgapur/Ludhiana.

Selection Process for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

The selection process consists of two stages:

  • Trade Test: Online applications will be screened, and shortlisted candidates will be called for a trade test, which is qualifying in nature.
  • Competitive Written Examination: Candidates who qualify in the trade test will be called for a written examination (OMR or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination). The final merit list will be prepared solely on the marks obtained in Paper-II and Paper-III of this examination.

How to Apply for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I Recruitment 2025?

Eligible candidates are required to apply ONLINE only through the CSIR-CMERI website.

  1. Visit the official website: www.cmeri.res.in.
  2. Register with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, ensuring all details are accurate.
  4. Pay the application fee online through State Bank Collect and upload the e-receipt.
  5. Upload scanned copies of a recent photograph, signature, and all relevant certificates (education, ITI, experience, category, Aadhaar Card, NOC if applicable).
  6. Submit the application online before the deadline. Candidates should not send a hard copy after online submission.

Selection Process

  • However, Management reserves the right to conduct additional screening test/ trade test / skill test/ Psychometric Test etc. as deemed fit.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Before applying online /appearing for document verification, the candidate should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this advertisement hosted on the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in In case, it is detected at any stage of the recruitment process that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material/fact(s), his/her candidature shall stand automatically cancelled. If any of the above shortcomings is/are detected even after the appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated without notice.
  • The candidature of candidates at all stages of the selection process will be purely provisional subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Essential qualification should be recognised / approved by Indian University/Institute recognized by UGC/AICTE/AIU/appropriate statutory authority. Candidates with qualifications acquired from foreign university should produce order / letter in this regard under which it has been approved/ recognised by AIU.
  • Candidates are advised to bring proof of approval in the form of a print-out of notification from their website showing the name of the College/Institution and the course or any other documentary proof issued by the College/University/Institution. The onus lies on the candidate to prove his/her eligibility in all respects by submitting the required documents.
  • Wherever the essential educational qualification has a mention of dual specialization, one of the specializations necessarily needs to be function specific for the post notified.
  • Wherever Post Graduation is specified as prescribed qualification, their Graduation shall also be a full-time regular course.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Bodies are required to produce a “No Objection Certificate” from their present employer at the time of Documents verification positively.
  • DVC reserves the right to cancel/ restrict/ enlarge/ modify/ alter the recruitment/selection process, if the need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • The decision of DVC in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of online applications, the penalty for false information, mode of selection, selection and allotment of posts and places of postings to the selected candidates shall be final and binding on the candidate. No enquiry/ correspondence or telephonic discussion will be entertained in this regard. If any shortcoming is detected even after the appointment, the services of such candidates are liable to be terminated without notice.
  • During physical verification, all signatures should be identical. Different styled Signature on various occasions during Recruitment activities may lead to the rejection of the candidature. Mere being called for Interview shall not vest any right in a candidate to be called for further selection process i.e. Documents Verification.
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised to apply early enough. DVC will not be responsible for network problems or any other problem in submission of Online Application.
  • In case any dispute arises on account of interpretation in language versions other than English, English version shall prevail.
  • The eligibility of the candidate for final selection will be confirmed after Document Verification.
  • Any subsequent amendment/notice/clarification etc., if any, shall be made available on the DVC website only. As such, candidates are advised to keep visiting the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in regularly for important updates till the completion of the recruitment process for the posts.
  • No interim correspondence will be entertained on any account during the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification.
  • Only Xerox copies of documents will be retained. However, records of other than selected candidates are not maintained after the completion of the recruitment process.
  • While preparing the final merit list, if two or more candidates secure equal marks, the merit of such group of candidates will be as per their date of birth (i.e. more senior in age will be placed first before junior in age).
  • If any certificate etc. is issued in a language other than Hindi / English, candidates are advised to submit a certified translation of the same in either Hindi or English language at the time of documents verification or whenever called for.

How to Apply

  • Interested and Eligible candidates shall have to apply only through ONLINE registration system of DVC. To apply log on to the DVC website www.dvc.gov.in (Career Section-> Recruitment Notices).
  • Before applying ONLINE, candidates are advised to read the Detailed Advertisement/Notification carefully and will ensure that they must fulfil the essential requirements of the Post and other conditions as mentioned in the Notification.
  • No other means/mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Following Information /documents to be kept ready before applying Online:
  • One recent scanned photograph of size 3.5cm X 3.5 cm and signature to be uploaded while applying. The photograph should be with a clear front view of the candidate without a cap or sunglasses. Identical photos shall be used throughout the selection process.
  • Certificates/Mark sheets relating to Academic & Professional qualifications, etc. to be kept ready for entering marks.
  • The E-mail ID & Contact No. entered in the online application form must remain valid for at least one year from the date of the Notification for all future correspondences. Please enter email correctly since all important communications shall be through emails only.
  • After having arranged all information/documents, candidates should visit the DVC website: www.dvc.gov.in and follow the instructions given in this detailed Notification/Advertisement. Step 1 is to fill in all the particulars in the Online Application Form. Step 2 is to upload the photograph, signature and other relevant documents/certificates. Step 3 is to Preview the application form and the data can be edited if required and updated, Step 4 is to pay the application fee (if applicable) and then final Step 5 is to SUBMIT the application with the payment receipt number. Application once submitted cannot be edited. Only Submitted applications will be accepted.

  • Essential qualifications: Candidates must have passed their Graduation not earlier than 01.07.2021. Candidate with 100% complete profile on the Apprenticeship portal only are eligible to apply.
  • Experience: The candidate possesses one year or more of work experience in any Government, Government Undertaking, or Private Organization as on 01.12.2025. (Not eligible if have experience)

Salary/Stipend

  • A monthly stipend of Rs. 9,000/- shall be paid to the apprentice during the period of apprenticeship training. The Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances/ benefits.
  • United India Insurance Company will make a payment of 4,500/- into the apprentices account on a monthly basis.
  • Government share of Stipend of Rs. 4500 will be directly credited to the Apprentices Bank account through DBT mode as per extant guidelines.
  • The stipend shall be paid to Apprentices each month after adjusting Loss of pay, If any.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Minimum Age—21 years
  • Maximum Age -28 years
  • [i.e. candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.12.1997 and not later than 01.12.2004 (both days inclusive)]
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application Starting Date 18.12.2025
Last date for applying “UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD” 20.01.2026
Physical appearance for verification of documents of shortlisted candidates at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd Call letter will be sent through Registered Email ID

Selection Process

  • The shortlisting shall be carried out based on the percentage of marks (up to two decimal places) secured in the qualifying Graduate Degree Examination, subject to the candidate fulfilling all the prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Where the result of the qualifying examination is declared in the form of CGPA / OGPA / GPA, the same shall be converted into percentage by multiplying the obtained grade by a factor of 10 (ten), and such converted percentage shall be indicated in the online application form.
  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish the details while filling in application.
  • Company reserves right to reject ineligible candidate's applications at any stage of the selection process.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

This is a great opportunity for engineering graduates, diploma holders, ITI holders and graduates in management, finance, HR, marketing and languages to work with India’s leading public sector telecom and technology company across multiple locations. The online application process is through the career section of the official website www.itiltd.in and the last date for submission of application is 12-01-2026 (23:59 hrs).

ITI Young Professional Notification 2026 Out

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by ITI Limited to recruit eligible candidates as Young Professionals – Graduate, Young Professionals – Technician, Young Professionals – Operator and YP Generalist/Official Language in various domains. Before applying, candidates must carefully read the detailed notification PDF to understand eligibility criteria, vacancies, posting locations, selection process, service conditions and application guidelines. Candidates can use the direct notification PDF available on the ITI Limited careers page to download the complete advertisement for Young Professional 2026.

Department Corporate Office & Various Units of ITI Limited
Exam Name Young Professional Recruitment 2026
Post Young Professional – Graduate / Technician / Operator / Generalist / Official Language

Selection Process Shortlisting + GD & PI for Graduates; Shortlisting + Skill Test for Technicians & Operators
Official Website itiltd.in

Young Professional Recruitment 2026

The Young Professional Recruitment 2026 invites young and talented professionals in engineering, technology, IT, HR, marketing, finance and official language who seek a career in the telecom, IT and allied technology sector with ITI Limited. The selection process includes a two-stage procedure for Young Professional – Graduates comprising shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview, while Technicians and Operators are shortlisted and then assessed through a Skill Test. Selected candidates will be engaged on a full-time contract basis initially for one year, extendable on a year-to-year basis up to a maximum of three years based on satisfactory performance.

This recruitment offers structured exposure in high-growth areas such as IS & IT, Projects, Production, Telecom Security Testing Lab, HR, Marketing and Finance with a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 60,000 for Young Professional – Graduate, Rs. 35,000 for Young Professional – Technician/Generalist and Rs. 30,000 for Young Professional – Operator. The Young Professionals will be posted across multiple locations including Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini (Prayagraj), Palakkad, Rae Bareli and various project/marketing locations like Leh-Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati and other centres as per organizational requirement. The roles involve execution of projects, production, network and IT support, marketing, finance and HR operations in line with ITI’s business needs.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the careers section of the official website www.itiltd.in by filling the application form under “Career > Notification > Application format” on or before 12-01-2026, 23:59 hrs. Candidates must provide valid email ID and mobile number as all important communications related to shortlisting, selection process and further instructions will be sent via email only. No other mode of application is accepted and a single latest application per post will be considered where multiple submissions are made.

ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Young Professional Selection Process 2026

The Young Professional selection is based on a two-stage process involving shortlisting through a quantifiable point-based methodology followed by assessment via Group Discussion & Personal Interview for graduates or Skill Test for technicians/operators. Only those who qualify in the shortlisting stage are called for the assessment stage, and no TA/DA is paid for attending interview/skill test or for initial joining.

The Young Professional selection process is carried out in two main stages for each stream as explained below.

1. Screening / Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on a quantifiable point-based methodology derived through a component weightage system considering parameters like qualification, experience and other relevant factors. The shortlist is prepared separately for Young Professional – Graduates and Young Professional – Technicians/Operators as per domain requirements.

2. Assessment Stage:
(i) For Young Professional – Graduates: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process consisting of Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI). Final merit is prepared based on performance in GD and PI as per corporate norms.
(ii) For Young Professional – Technicians & Operators: Shortlisted candidates will appear for a Skill Test relevant to their domain/role as part of the assessment stage.

Final Merit: The final selection of Young Professionals is based on performance in the assessment stage (GD & PI for graduates, skill test for technicians/operators) subject to verification of documents and fulfilment of all eligibility and medical fitness norms.

  • Candidature may be rejected at any stage if information is found false, misleading or not in conformity with eligibility criteria.

  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending interview/skill test or for joining if selected.
  • Young Professionals are engaged on contract, do not acquire any right to regular appointment and cannot take up other assignments during the contract period.
  • Company reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts or not to fill any of the notified posts.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
A1. The last date to submit the online application is 12-01-2026 up to 23:59 hrs.

Q2. What is the age limit for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Q3. How many vacancies are available in ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Q5. What is the application fee for ITI Young Professional Recruitment 2026?

Q7. Is this a permanent job in ITI Limited?

Posting locations include ITI units at Bengaluru, Mankapur, Naini, Palakkad, Rae Bareli and multiple project/marketing locations such as Leh/Ladakh, J&K, Jalandhar, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Bareilly, Kolkata, Tezpur, Delhi, Lucknow, Chennai, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ahmedabad and North Eastern states, subject to company requirements.

A9. Young Professionals are engaged full time to provide professional services in specific spheres and will follow the same working hours as ITI employees; no extra remuneration is paid for work beyond office hours or on holidays.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Online Written Test: The test will consist of 100 questions for 100 marks with total duration of 90 minutes
  • Test Components:
    • General / Financial Awareness: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • English Language: 25 questions, 25 marks (Qualifying nature only)
    • Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude: 25 questions, 25 marks
    • Computer Knowledge: 25 questions, 25 marks
  • Language: All tests except English Language will be available bilingually (English and Hindi)
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by Bank. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates entitled to 5% relaxation
  • Stage 2 - Test of Local Language: Conducted after qualifying the online written examination. Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the local language of the state
  • Exemption from Language Test: Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language
  • Final Merit List: Drawn state wise and category wise based on marks obtained in online examination in descending order
  • Tie Breaker: If marks are equal, merit order will be on the basis of Date of Birth (senior by age placed higher)
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Medical Fitness: Candidate must be declared medically fit as per Bank requirements

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for engagement in only one state and choose only one zone under that state
  • The number of training seats mentioned is provisional and may vary according to actual requirements of the Bank
  • Bank has right to post apprentices in any Branch/Offices within the state as per operational requirements
  • This is neither an employment nor a contract employment in the Bank. Engaged apprentices will only be "Trainees" and not treated as employees/workers
  • Period of engagement shall be restricted to One Year Apprenticeship Training Programme
  • Apprenticeship period shall not give the apprentice any lien/right on permanent employment with the Bank
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice and there is no reservation for them
  • Apprentices are prohibited from joining/forming any Union Body
  • Bank may issue certificate to candidate upon successful completion of Apprenticeship
  • Successful Apprentice will be issued a proficiency certificate by Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)
  • Bank has the rights to cancel the engagement of apprenticeship at any point of time without prior notice in case of any misconduct
  • No change of category as well as any other details will be permitted at any stage after registration on the apprenticeship portal
  • Multiple applications will result in only the latest valid application being retained
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Any resulting dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Mumbai

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in by navigating to "Student Register/Login" section
  • Step 2: After registration, login to the NATS portal using user ID and password at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php
  • Step 3: Apply for Apprenticeship against the advertisement published by "Bank of India" by going to the section "Apply against advertised vacancies"
  • Step 4: Eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] within 48 hours of applying on NATS portal
  • Step 5: Fill the final "Application cum Examination Fee Form" by providing personal data, choice of zone, category, PWBD status
  • Step 6: Make online payment of the requisite examination fee
  • Step 7: Note down the Enrolment ID issued by NATS portal for future reference
  • Step 8: After successful payment, you will receive an email from [email protected] with copy of "Application cum Examination Fee Form" within 48 hours

  • Mode of Application: Online only through NATS Portal
  • Important: Application process is complete only when examination fee is deposited with BFSI SSC
  • For Help: Refer to the help manual available at https://nats.education.gov.in/assets/manual/student_manual.pdf or email queries to [email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Assistant (Mechanical)
    • Three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with minimum 60% marks from a State Board of Technical Education.

    • Pass in VII Standard and up to XII Standard from a recognized Board.
    • Experience not mandatory; preference to candidates with relevant experience and job exposure.

    • Upper age limit not to exceed 30 years as on 20 January 2026 (applicants should be born on or after 21 January 1996).

  • Project Assistant (Mechanical) on contract basis:
    • Consolidated pay ₹24,400/- per month for candidates meeting minimum experience requirement of 2 years.
    • Compensation for extra hours of work up to ₹6,100/- per month.
    • For each completed year of on-roll experience over and above the minimum required in CSL or similar shipyards, higher pay may be offered.
  • Office Attendant on contract basis (as per Contract Period):
    • 1st Year: Monthly consolidated pay ₹20,200/- plus compensation for extra hours of work ₹3,600/- per month.

  • After applying all age relaxations, age shall not exceed 45 years.

Application Fee

  • Application fee: ₹300/- (Non-refundable) plus bank charges, to be remitted using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI etc.) through online application facility from 30 December 2025 to 21 January 2026.

Event Date Details

  • Project Assistant (Mechanical):
    • Selection through Objective Type Offline Test (Phase I – 80 marks) and Descriptive Type Test (Phase II – 20 marks); total 100 marks.
    • Objective test (Multiple Choice Questions) – areas: General Knowledge (5 marks), Reasoning (5 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (10 marks), General English (10 marks), Discipline related (50 marks); duration 90 minutes; no negative marking.
    • Descriptive Test – Writing skills in English (20 marks); duration 45 minutes.
    • Minimum pass marks: 50% of total marks in each test for all categories (except PwBD); 40% for PwBD candidates.
    • Discipline-wise merit list prepared based on aggregate marks of Objective and Descriptive tests; tie resolved by Discipline-related marks and then seniority in age.
    • Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called for certificate verification; only those successfully completing verification and found medically fit will be provisionally selected.
  • Office Attendant:

    • Minimum pass marks: 50% of total marks for unreserved posts (except PwBD); 40% for PwBD candidates.
    • Candidates scoring minimum pass marks and above in Phase I will be shortlisted for certificate verification and Phase II Practical Test.
    • Phase II Practical Test – held at CSL-Kolkata Ship Repair Unit or other centre; minimum pass marks same as above.
    • Rank list prepared based on marks of candidates who meet eligibility and pass both Phase I and Phase II; tie resolved on Objective Test marks and then seniority in age.

    • Tests will be held in West Bengal as decided by CKSRU on behalf of CSL; exam centre allocation at sole discretion of CSL.
    • CSL/CKSRU reserves right to scrutinise applications and permit only shortlisted candidates to attend selection process.

    • Exposure in HPC (High Performance Computing) is preferable
    • Proven publication record in molecular docking, molecular dynamics, quantum medicinal chemistry, virtual screening QSAR (all from own independent work)

    • Preference to candidates with ability to collaborate with experimental pharmaceutical scientists
    • Experience in establishing computational facilities, software installation, system administration, bug fixing
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent Research in terms of guided Masters' students and minimum of 2 PhD students

T-02: Associate Professor (Pharmaceutical Analysis)

  • Essential Qualifications: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent grade at the preceding degree in the appropriate branch with very good academic record throughout

    • Hands-on experience in handling sophisticated instruments like HPLC, LC-MS-MS and GC-MS
    • Experience in using instruments for analysis of API/finished dosage forms as per IP, USP, BP
    • Knowledge in characterization of biological products and stability testing, trouble shooting skills
    • Demonstrated adequate experience of independent research in terms of guided Masters' students and at least one Ph.D. student
